papers.title: WeMM-Embedding: WeChat Multi-Modal Embedding Technical Report
papers.authors: ["Junjie Zhou", "Ke Mei", "Lei Li", "Tianyi Wang", "Fengyun Rao", "Jing Lyu"]
papers.tags: ["多模态基座", "Embedding", "检索/推荐", "内容理解", "中强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 26, "results": 14, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 22, "total": 87, "rationale_zh": "作为多模态 embedding 基座对电商内容理解/相似召回/治理都具备高杠杆价值；评测覆盖广且有线上 A/B，且已开源代码与权重，满足 >=80 的“高质量”标准。", "rationale_en": "High-leverage multimodal embedding foundation for ecommerce retrieval/similarity/governance; broad evaluations plus online A/B, and open-sourced weights/code, meeting the >=80 high-quality bar."}
papers.rationale_zh: 作为多模态 embedding 基座对电商内容理解/相似召回/治理都具备高杠杆价值；评测覆盖广且有线上 A/B，且已开源代码与权重，满足 >=80 的“高质量”标准。
papers.rationale_en: High-leverage multimodal embedding foundation for ecommerce retrieval/similarity/governance; broad evaluations plus online A/B, and open-sourced weights/code, meeting the >=80 high-quality bar.
papers.method_overview_zh: WeMM-Embedding 是一套通用多模态 embedding 基座（2B/4B/9B），支持文本、图像、视频、视觉文档及任意交织输入，并支持多输出维度（Matryoshka）。训练分两阶段：大规模多模态对齐预训练 + 以 curated 数据、细粒度相关性监督与跨尺度知识迁移为核心的精炼阶段。报告在 MMEB-v2/v3 等多任务评测上取得领先，并给出在微信多业务（含电商服务）的大规模线上 A/B 结果，同时开源权重与代码。
papers.method_overview_en: WeMM-Embedding is a family of universal multimodal embedding models (2B/4B/9B) supporting text, images, videos, visual documents, and interleaved multimodal inputs, with flexible Matryoshka output dimensions. Training has two stages: large-scale multimodal alignment followed by refinement with curated data, fine-grained relevance supervision, and cross-scale knowledge transfer. The report shows leading performance on MMEB benchmarks and large-scale online A/B gains in WeChat products (including ecommerce services), and releases model weights and code.
papers.story_zh: 电商内容生态与治理场景里，检索/相似/聚类/召回常常需要一个稳定、可泛化的多模态向量空间。现有模型要么规模过大成本高，要么在视频/文档等模态上不均衡。WeMM-Embedding 的思路是做‘全模态统一表示 + 可裁剪维度 + 两阶段训练’：先对齐，再用高质量监督把细粒度相关性与跨模态检索能力补齐，并通过跨尺度迁移让小模型也接近大模型效果。
papers.story_en: Ecommerce content ecosystems and governance rely heavily on robust multimodal embeddings for retrieval, similarity, clustering, and recall. Existing models are either too costly or imbalanced across modalities. WeMM-Embedding aims for unified cross-modal representations with dimension truncation for efficiency, trained via alignment + high-quality refinement and cross-scale transfer.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 在同一模型族内同时覆盖 text/image/video/document/interleaved，并提供 Matryoshka 维度裁剪，利于线上成本控制；2) 训练流程强调 curated 监督与跨尺度知识迁移，提升可用性；3) 评测覆盖面广且提供线上 A/B（含电商）证明。局限：作为技术报告，部分训练数据与线上评测细节不可完全公开，外部复现全流程仍有门槛。
papers.innovation_en: (1) Unified support for multiple modalities and interleaving, plus Matryoshka dimension control for serving efficiency. (2) Curated refinement + cross-scale transfer improves usability and small-model quality. (3) Broad evaluations and online A/B evidence. Limitation: full training data and online evaluation details are not fully reproducible externally.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 报告给出：9B 在 MMEB-v2 overall 达到 80.6（SOTA）；2B 已超过此前领先的 8B 开源基线；并在 26-task in-house benchmark 与 14 次线上 A/B 中取得持续收益。
papers.key_metrics_en: Reported MMEB-v2 overall: 9B reaches 80.6 (SOTA); 2B surpasses the prior leading 8B open baseline; plus consistent gains on a 26-task in-house benchmark and 14 online A/B tests.

papers.title: CVE-SAI: Counterfactual Visual Evidence-Guided Selective Attribute Indexing for Risk-Controlled E-commerce Search
papers.authors: ["Xiaolong Sun", "Qichao Wang", "Hangyu Li", "Liang Chen"]
papers.tags: ["属性补全", "风控", "电商搜索", "多模态", "治理", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 24, "results": 11, "exp_quality": 11, "efficiency": 6, "generalization": 3, "relevance": 24, "total": 79, "rationale_zh": "非常贴合“治理”：把属性补全做成风险可控的索引准入决策，思路清晰且有可解释的证据审计；扣分主要在于关键数值未在摘要给出、公开复现细节不明，且更多是框架/策略而非标准模型代码。", "rationale_en": "Highly aligned with governance via risk-controlled index admission and evidence auditing. Points deducted due to missing concrete numbers in abstract, unclear public reproducibility details, and being more of a policy/framework than a standard model release."}
papers.rationale_zh: 非常贴合“治理”：把属性补全做成风险可控的索引准入决策，思路清晰且有可解释的证据审计；扣分主要在于关键数值未在摘要给出、公开复现细节不明，且更多是框架/策略而非标准模型代码。
papers.rationale_en: Highly aligned with governance via risk-controlled index admission and evidence auditing. Points deducted due to missing concrete numbers in abstract, unclear public reproducibility details, and being more of a policy/framework than a standard model release.
papers.method_overview_zh: CVE-SAI 关注“属性预测一旦写入索引就会形成长期污染”的治理问题：多模态模型能补全属性，但不一定有视觉证据支撑。方法把流程拆为“先推断（freeze candidate）再决定是否入索引（admission）”。它提出 Focus-Zone Distortion (FZD) 做受控反事实扰动，估计该属性对视觉区域的依赖；再用 Evidence-Guided Attention Redistribution (EGAR) 利用该依赖度重分配注意力，提升 evidence localization 与候选评分。随后在候选被冻结的前提下做多项 audit（证据必要性/证据保留/抗 nuisance 变换稳定性/与目录文本冲突等），并用 family-level calibration 在 5% unsafe-admission budget 下选择策略，给出有限样本的一侧界约束。
papers.method_overview_en: CVE-SAI tackles a governance issue: attribute predictions become persistent contamination once indexed. It decouples inference from index admission: first infer and freeze an ontology-constrained candidate from the primary image and attribute question (without catalog text), then decide whether to admit it. Focus-Zone Distortion (FZD) builds an attribute-specific visual-dependence proxy via controlled counterfactual interventions, and Evidence-Guided Attention Redistribution (EGAR) uses it to refine scoring and evidence localization. With the candidate frozen, the method audits evidence necessity/retention, nuisance stability, and catalog-text conflicts, and uses family-level calibration to select a policy under a 5% unsafe-admission budget with finite-sample bounds.
papers.story_zh: 现有属性补全往往只追求问答准确率，却忽视“是否真的由图片证据支撑”，更把一次性预测与持久化索引写入混为一谈，导致错误属性长期影响检索曝光与治理。CVE-SAI 将‘推断’与‘入库’分离：先从主图和属性问题得到一个不被文本修正的 canonical 候选，再用反事实证据检查与风险控制，决定是否允许该属性进入索引。
papers.story_en: Prior work optimizes attribute-answer accuracy but does not verify visual evidence, and conflates one-off prediction with persistent indexing. CVE-SAI separates these concerns: produce a canonical candidate from visual evidence, then run counterfactual evidence checks and risk-controlled admission before writing to the index.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 把 attribute completion 从生成/预测问题升级为“风险可控的索引准入”问题，非常贴合电商治理；2) 反事实扰动构造属性相关的视觉依赖 proxy，并用 EGAR 做证据导向的注意力重分配；3) 显式给出 unsafe-admission 预算与有限样本保证，更易与业务风控阈值对齐。局限：需要清晰的 ontology 与审核规则；在复杂多图/视频商品与更长尾属性上的扩展尚需验证。
papers.innovation_en: (1) Frames attribute completion as risk-controlled index admission, aligning with ecommerce governance. (2) Counterfactual perturbations provide an attribute-specific evidence proxy; EGAR redistributes attention accordingly. (3) Explicit unsafe-admission budgets with finite-sample guarantees make it policy-friendly. Limitations include reliance on ontology/audit rules and validation needed for multi-image/video and long-tail attributes.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文在 Amazon Berkeley Objects 派生的 5 个视觉属性上实验：提升属性推断与证据定位，并在 5% unsafe-admission 预算下取得最高的 certified admission coverage，同时降低 unsafe exposure（摘要未给出具体数值）。
papers.key_metrics_en: On five visual attributes derived from Amazon Berkeley Objects, CVE-SAI improves inference and evidence localization and achieves the highest certified admission coverage under a shared 5% unsafe-admission protocol (numbers not provided in abstract).

papers.title: ProRetrieval: Learning to Orchestrate Hybrid Search via Executable Program Synthesis
papers.authors: ["Chengsong You", "Zhen Sun", "Yunhai Hu", "Junwei Zhou", "Xiaoyu Cao", "Binyu Li", "Ziyan Zhao", "Weiyao Wang", "Liren Lu", "Zhijie Ye", "Yumo Cao", "Yitao Long", "Yiwei Xu", "Qiyi Jiang", "Xuanyi Fu", "Yufan Chen", "Yilun Li", "Rongkang Xiong", "Yiran Zou", "Nan Du"]
papers.affiliations: ["East China Normal University", "New York University", "Matter Innovation Inc.", "ThinRedLine", "Shandong University of Science and Technology", "Jinan University", "Independent Researcher", "Fudan University"]
papers.tags: ["检索", "Hybrid Retrieval", "Text-to-SQL", "RAG", "电商搜索", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 26, "results": 14, "exp_quality": 11, "efficiency": 7, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 17, "total": 79, "rationale_zh": "与电商搜索/RAG/结构化+语义混合检索强相关，且给出明确指标；但代码链接为匿名仓库且本轮无法稳定验证内容完整性，且线上落地约束（字段/权限/延迟）需要额外工程，因此不进入 >=80 的“必须复现/验证代码”队列。", "rationale_en": "Highly relevant to ecommerce search and hybrid retrieval with strong reported gains. Points deducted because the listed code link is an anonymous repo and cannot be robustly validated in this run, and production constraints (schema/access/latency) require extra engineering."}
papers.rationale_zh: 与电商搜索/RAG/结构化+语义混合检索强相关，且给出明确指标；但代码链接为匿名仓库且本轮无法稳定验证内容完整性，且线上落地约束（字段/权限/延迟）需要额外工程，因此不进入 >=80 的“必须复现/验证代码”队列。
papers.rationale_en: Highly relevant to ecommerce search and hybrid retrieval with strong reported gains. Points deducted because the listed code link is an anonymous repo and cannot be robustly validated in this run, and production constraints (schema/access/latency) require extra engineering.
papers.method_overview_zh: ProRetrieval 把“混合检索编排”建模为可执行程序合成：LLM 不再只是生成 query，而是生成一段混合 DSL 程序。DSL 以 SQL 的逻辑代数（AND/OR/NOT、嵌套子查询等）作为骨架，并引入向量检索原语（文本/图像）作为一等公民；执行引擎先调用向量后端拿候选集合，再把候选集合注入 SQL 占位符里完成最终逻辑融合与排序。训练上先用专家 DSL 例子做 SFT，再用 GRPO/DAPO 做 RL，并设计“格式/可执行/结果/长度”四项分层 reward 来保证可执行性与检索质量。
papers.method_overview_en: ProRetrieval treats hybrid retrieval as executable program synthesis. Instead of emitting a single query, the LLM generates a hybrid DSL program whose backbone is SQL (AND/OR/NOT, nesting) and whose primitives include text/image vector retrieval. The runtime first executes vector primitives to obtain candidate sets, injects them into SQL placeholders, and lets SQL perform the final logical fusion. Training uses SFT on expert DSL traces followed by RL (GRPO/DAPO) with a hierarchical reward over format, executability, result quality, and program length.
papers.story_zh: 现有混合检索往往依赖固定 pipeline（如 RRF）或只支持简单 conjunction 的 self-query retriever，表达不了真实电商检索中的复杂布尔逻辑；而 RL retriever 多是“对单一后端生成更好 query”，缺少跨结构化字段 + 向量检索的编排能力。于是 ProRetrieval 把动作空间升级为“可执行检索程序”，用 SQL 提供完备逻辑表达，用向量检索提供语义匹配能力，从而在一个统一框架里做 AND/OR/NOT 与多模态检索组合。
papers.story_en: Real ecommerce queries mix structured constraints with semantic intents and complex Boolean logic. Fixed fusion pipelines and self-query retrievers lack expressiveness, while RL retrievers usually optimize query generation for a single backend. ProRetrieval expands the action space to an executable hybrid program: SQL provides logical completeness and vector retrieval provides semantic matching, enabling per-query orchestration across heterogeneous stores.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 用“SQL 逻辑骨架 + 向量检索原语注入”的 DSL，把混合检索的逻辑组合问题转成程序合成问题，表达力明显强于固定融合或单后端 RL；2) reward 设计是可落地的：先保格式/可执行，再保结果，再压长度，适合工程化训练；3) 以 Amazon（电商）+ Enron（邮件）构造任务，覆盖结构化字段与语义检索混合。风险点：依赖 DSL 执行引擎与后端接口稳定；对真实线上索引字段/权限/时延约束仍需工程补齐。
papers.innovation_en: (1) A hybrid DSL (SQL skeleton + vector primitives) turns orchestration into program synthesis, strictly more expressive than fixed fusion or single-backend RL. (2) The hierarchical reward is engineering-friendly for executable programs. (3) New benchmarks spanning Amazon products and Enron email validate cross-backend composition. Practical risks include dependency on a stable DSL executor and production constraints (schema, latency, access control).
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文在 Amazon e-commerce 与 Enron email 两个新基准上报告 Hit@1：4B 模型在电商上 0.81（对比 GPT-5.5 的 0.69），在 email 上 0.91（对比 0.86），并超过 Claude Opus 4.7 与多类基线。
papers.key_metrics_en: On two new hybrid-retrieval benchmarks, the 4B model reaches Hit@1 0.81 vs 0.69 (GPT-5.5) on e-commerce and 0.91 vs 0.86 on email, also surpassing Claude Opus 4.7 and strong baselines.

papers.title: TAGR: Temporally Adaptive Generative Recommendation for Industrial Live-Streaming Advertising
papers.authors: ["Wencai Ye", "Guangyi Liu", "Chaoyi Wang", "Wenbin Luo", "Shengyu Wang", "Mingjie Sun", "Peng Wang", "Quanming Yao", "Wenjin Wu", "Peng Jiang"]
papers.tags: ["直播电商", "广告推荐", "生成式推荐", "时序建模", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 23, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 11, "efficiency": 6, "generalization": 3, "relevance": 23, "total": 79, "rationale_zh": "与直播电商/广告推荐强相关且有清晰线上收益；扣分主要在于缺少公开代码与更细分 ablation，外部复现与可迁移性尚待验证。", "rationale_en": "Highly relevant with strong online lifts; points deducted due to lack of open code and detailed ablations, with limited external reproducibility and transfer evidence."}
papers.rationale_zh: 与直播电商/广告推荐强相关且有清晰线上收益；扣分主要在于缺少公开代码与更细分 ablation，外部复现与可迁移性尚待验证。
papers.rationale_en: Highly relevant with strong online lifts; points deducted due to lack of open code and detailed ablations, with limited external reproducibility and transfer evidence.
papers.method_overview_zh: TAGR 面向直播电商广告的“强时变”场景：直播画面、主推商品、价格库存、以及用户反馈都在分钟级变化，静态语义 ID 与单尺度行为建模容易失效。它提出三层 temporal adaptation：1) token 层的 LSID（Live Semantic-Collaborative ID）定期根据当前直播场景与主推商品刷新 live-ad 的 SID 分配；2) intent 层的 IAG（Intent-Aware Generation）用多时间粒度的进直播间序列作为主意图，保留其他行为为独立通道，并按业务价值/后验意图证据加权 NTP；3) alignment 层的 IOPO（Intermittent On-Policy Preference Optimization）周期性采样新鲜候选组做 on-policy 偏好更新，并与监督 NTP 交错以保持稳定。
papers.method_overview_en: TAGR targets live-streaming ads where scenes, promoted products, and feedback change rapidly. It introduces temporal adaptation at three levels: (1) token: LSID periodically refreshes live-ad semantic IDs based on current scene and products; (2) intent: IAG models multi-granular live-room entry histories as the primary intent sequence, keeps auxiliary behaviors as separate channels, and value-weights NTP using post-request evidence; (3) alignment: IOPO intermittently samples fresh on-policy candidate groups for preference optimization, interleaved with supervised NTP to maintain stability.
papers.story_zh: 生成式推荐在静态 item 域表现好，但直播广告的 serving target 本身在变：同一个直播间随时切品，用户意图也随内容推进快速漂移。TAGR 认为需要同时让‘候选 token 表示’、‘意图序列建模’、‘偏好优化数据分布’都具备时间适配能力，于是分别在 token/intent/alignment 三个层面加入刷新与间歇 on-policy 机制，兼顾新鲜度与训练稳定。
papers.story_en: Generative recommenders struggle in live commerce because the serving target and user intent drift at minute scale. TAGR decomposes the problem into token drift, intent drift, and delayed preference signals, and addresses each with refreshable IDs and intermittent on-policy optimization.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 三层时序适配把直播广告的核心痛点拆得很清楚（token 漂移、意图漂移、反馈滞后）；2) LSID 是对‘语义 ID’在动态场景的关键补丁；3) IOPO 在工程上可操作：定期采样 + 交错训练，降低 on-policy 不稳定。局限：如果无开源实现，复现难；对不同平台/不同业务目标的迁移需要更多证据。
papers.innovation_en: (1) A clear three-layer temporal-adaptation decomposition for live ads. (2) LSID updates semantic IDs for dynamic content. (3) IOPO is a practical intermittent on-policy scheme to balance freshness and stability. Limitations include reproduction difficulty without open code and more evidence needed for cross-platform transfer.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文报告在大规模电商直播广告平台上线：live-room entry 提升 8.5%，shopping-cart click 提升 7.4%，收入提升 16.1%（相对线上 baseline）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Deployed results: +8.5% live-room entry, +7.4% shopping-cart click, and +16.1% revenue lift over the production baseline.

papers.title: Conversational Recommendation over Live E-Commerce Catalogues with Self-Refreshing Retrieval
papers.authors: ["Ante Kapetanović", "Tomislav Ðuričić", "Dionizije Fa", "Andro Merćep", "Emanuel Lacić"]
papers.tags: ["对话式推荐", "Catalog Freshness", "向量检索", "Agent", "电商", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 22, "results": 9, "exp_quality": 10, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 3, "relevance": 24, "total": 77, "rationale_zh": "强工程落地价值：直击电商 catalog freshness，且提供可运行 demo 与代码；扣分在于论文主要是系统说明，缺少更全面的离线/线上多维评测与 ablation。", "rationale_en": "Strong practical value for ecommerce catalogue freshness with runnable code. Points deducted because the paper is mostly a system/demo description with limited comprehensive evaluations and ablations."}
papers.rationale_zh: 强工程落地价值：直击电商 catalog freshness，且提供可运行 demo 与代码；扣分在于论文主要是系统说明，缺少更全面的离线/线上多维评测与 ablation。
papers.rationale_en: Strong practical value for ecommerce catalogue freshness with runnable code. Points deducted because the paper is mostly a system/demo description with limited comprehensive evaluations and ablations.
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文关注“电商商品库是活的”这一线上痛点：商品会新增/下架、变价、缺货，静态向量索引很快失真。作者给出一个 merchant-agnostic 的多轮对话购物助手，其核心是 self-refreshing retriever：每次同步时对每个商品计算 full/semantic hash，把商品分为新增/语义变更/仅元数据变更/删除/未变更，只对新增或语义变化的商品做 enrichment 与 embedding，避免全量重建。对话层采用 controller 方式：LLM 只做意图分类与偏好追问，检索、rerank、以及多样性选择走确定性函数，最终落地到 WhatsApp demo。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper addresses a production reality: ecommerce catalogues are dynamic, so static vector indexes drift quickly. It presents a merchant-agnostic multi-turn shopping assistant whose core is a self-refreshing retriever. Each sync run hashes every product to classify records into new / semantic-changed / metadata-only / deleted / unchanged, re-embedding only the necessary subset instead of rebuilding the full index. A controller-style dialogue layer uses an LLM only for intent classification and preference elicitation, while retrieval, reranking, and diversity selection are implemented as deterministic functions. The system is demonstrated via a WhatsApp shopping assistant.
papers.story_zh: 大多数 LLM-CRS 论文在静态 benchmark 上评测，忽略线上最常见的“catalog drift”。如果全量重建索引成本高且延迟大；如果不更新，又会推荐缺货/下架商品。于是该工作把问题拆成“增量同步（hash diff）+ 只对需要的商品重嵌入 + 控制器式对话编排”，把 freshness 作为生产可用的关键约束。
papers.story_en: Most LLM-based CRS work assumes a static corpus, but real catalogues change continuously. Full reindexing is expensive, while stale indexes cause out-of-stock or removed items to be recommended. The solution is to treat freshness as a first-class constraint: incremental sync via hashes + selective re-embedding + a controllable dialogue controller.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 把 catalogue synchronization 明确成可复现的增量算法（hash 分类 + 顺序写入 + deletion last），是对电商推荐落地非常实用的工程贡献；2) 对话层把 LLM 角色限制在 intent/elicitation，其他环节函数化，降低成本与不确定性，利于治理（可审计、可控）；3) 代码仓库提供 runnable synthetic sync demo，利于复现。局限：论文页数短，更多是系统/工程说明，对推荐效果提升的可量化实验较少。
papers.innovation_en: (1) A clean, reproducible delta-sync algorithm (hash-based diff + ordered writes) directly targets catalogue drift in ecommerce. (2) Restricting the LLM to intent/elicitation and keeping retrieval/rerank deterministic improves controllability and auditability for governance. (3) The released repo includes a runnable synthetic sync MVP. Limitation: as a short system/demo paper, it reports fewer quantitative recommendation gains.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文未主打传统离线指标提升，而强调同步机制：通过 per-item hash 做 delta 同步，只对新增/语义变更商品重嵌入；仓库提供 10k 规模 synthetic demo（本地毫秒级同步）与 WhatsApp 线上演示。
papers.key_metrics_en: The focus is robustness and freshness rather than offline SOTA metrics: per-item hashes enable delta syncing and selective re-embedding; the repo provides a runnable synthetic 10k-item demo and a WhatsApp walkthrough.

papers.title: DCEO: Direct Causal Effect Optimization for Long-Term User Value Modeling in E-commerce Search
papers.authors: ["Junzhao Zhang", "Tao Zhang", "Liren Yu", "Feiyi Dong", "Zhixuan Zhang", "Dan Ou", "Haihong Tang"]
papers.tags: ["电商搜索", "Learning-to-Rank", "多目标融合", "因果推断", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 22, "results": 12, "exp_quality": 10, "efficiency": 6, "generalization": 3, "relevance": 22, "total": 75, "rationale_zh": "与电商搜索长期价值优化高度相关且有线上增益；扣分点在于公开复现难（工业数据/系统）、离线 ablation 细节不易验证，且方法偏系统/优化框架而非通用可复用代码。", "rationale_en": "Highly relevant with an online gain, but hard to reproduce publicly (industrial data/system), and ablations/details are less verifiable; more of a framework than a reusable open implementation."}
papers.rationale_zh: 与电商搜索长期价值优化高度相关且有线上增益；扣分点在于公开复现难（工业数据/系统）、离线 ablation 细节不易验证，且方法偏系统/优化框架而非通用可复用代码。
papers.rationale_en: Highly relevant with an online gain, but hard to reproduce publicly (industrial data/system), and ablations/details are less verifiable; more of a framework than a reusable open implementation.
papers.method_overview_zh: DCEO 面向电商搜索“长期用户价值”（n-day purchase / GMV per user）优化，但排序打分却在 item 级别的粒度不匹配。它把多目标（click/cart/purchase/value）融合的权重学习成一个 actor-critic：actor 根据上下文动态产出融合权重，生成 item-level proxy score；再把 proxy 聚合到 user-level proxy metric，并用“相对因果效应（relative causal effect）”度量 proxy 与终极目标的一致性；critic 估计该 user-level proxy 对终极目标的影响，驱动 actor 直接最大化因果一致性而不是相关性。
papers.method_overview_en: DCEO targets long-term user value (e.g., n-day purchases / GMV per user) for ecommerce search, but ranking operates on item-level scores. It formulates a data-driven actor-critic: the actor outputs context-dependent fusion weights over multiple item-level objectives to form a proxy score; the proxy is aggregated to a user-level proxy metric; and alignment to the ultimate objective is measured via a relative causal effect. The critic estimates the ultimate objective given the proxy metric, training the actor to directly optimize causal alignment rather than correlation.
papers.story_zh: 传统做法靠人工调权把多个 item-level 目标拼成 ranking score，但权重少、个性化弱且需要频繁 A/B。DCEO 认为关键是：proxy 指标必须在“通过排序能提升终极目标”的因果意义上对齐，而不是仅相关；因此用因果效应作为优化目标，并让权重随请求/用户动态变化，从而更好地把 item 级信号对齐到 user 级长期价值。
papers.story_en: Hand-tuned multi-objective fusion is coarse and weakly personalized, and requires costly A/B iterations. DCEO argues the proxy should be aligned in a causal sense—improving the proxy via ranking should improve the ultimate metric—so it optimizes relative causal effect and learns context-dependent fusion.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 用“相对因果效应”作为学习 proxy 的对齐目标，避免仅优化相关性导致的‘提升 proxy 但不提升 GMV’；2) 动态融合权重提升个性化，与电商内容生态中不同用户/场景的偏好权衡一致；3) 给出线上 A/B 证据。可行性上，actor-critic 可复用现有多目标体系；难点在于因果估计的稳定性与在线策略变更引入的分布漂移需要持续监控。
papers.innovation_en: (1) Uses relative causal effect as the alignment objective to avoid proxy-gaming under pure correlation. (2) Context-dependent fusion improves personalization in multi-objective ranking. (3) Provides online A/B evidence. Challenges include stable causal estimation and monitoring distribution shifts under policy updates.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文报告在某大型工业电商搜索系统上线 41 天 A/B：相对传统 GMV proxy，GMV 提升 0.36%。
papers.key_metrics_en: Reported 41-day online A/B: +0.36% GMV over the conventional GMV proxy in a large-scale ecommerce search system.

papers.title: SWE-Prime: Fewer Trajectories, Better Performance
papers.authors: ["Dewu Zheng", "Ruizhe Ye", "Yanlin Wang", "Yang Ye", "Hongyu Zhang", "Ensheng Shi", "Xilin Liu", "Yuchi Ma", "Jianxing Yu", "Zibin Zheng"]
papers.tags: ["数据选择", "轨迹质量", "SFT", "数据清洗", "中强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 22, "results": 12, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 16, "total": 74, "rationale_zh": "与‘数据质量/数据清洗/大规模标注治理’中强相关，且有明确提升；但任务域偏 SWE，不是电商内容治理的直接任务，迁移需要额外设计。", "rationale_en": "Moderately relevant to data quality/cleaning for governance with clear gains, but the task domain is SWE rather than direct ecommerce governance, so transfer requires additional work."}
papers.rationale_zh: 与‘数据质量/数据清洗/大规模标注治理’中强相关，且有明确提升；但任务域偏 SWE，不是电商内容治理的直接任务，迁移需要额外设计。
papers.rationale_en: Moderately relevant to data quality/cleaning for governance with clear gains, but the task domain is SWE rather than direct ecommerce governance, so transfer requires additional work.
papers.method_overview_zh: SWE-Prime 关注一个常被忽略的问题：成功轨迹不等于高质量监督，成功解题过程可能仍包含冗余/无效/有风险步骤，直接 SFT 会把坏习惯蒸馏进模型。它提出两阶段、多粒度的数据筛选：先做 trajectory-level 筛选（过程质量、结果质量、代表性），再做 segment-level 选择（把连续步骤聚成语义段，评估对最终解的贡献/可学习性/风险）。训练时保留整段上下文，但只对被选中的 segment 计算 loss，从而既保上下文又减噪。
papers.method_overview_en: SWE-Prime argues that successful trajectories can still be noisy supervision, containing redundant or risky steps. It proposes a two-stage SFT data selection: trajectory-level screening by process quality, result quality, and representativeness; then segment-level selection by grouping steps into semantic segments and scoring each segment by contribution, learnability, and risk. During SFT, all segments remain for context but only selected segments contribute to the loss.
papers.story_zh: 在大规模轨迹数据里，‘成功’只是最低门槛，噪声与坏动作同样会被模型学走。SWE-Prime 将问题拆成‘先选好轨迹，再选好片段’，并用 segment-level 的 loss masking 保留上下文依赖但降低噪声监督。该思路可迁移到电商内容治理/达人治理中的数据清洗：例如只对高质量审核步骤或关键决策片段做学习。
papers.story_en: Success is not enough—noisy process steps can be distilled into undesirable behaviors. SWE-Prime decomposes selection into trajectory-then-segment and uses loss masking to keep context while reducing noise. This data-quality framing is relevant to governance training pipelines.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 把监督质量从结果导向提升到过程导向，并细化到 segment 粒度；2) 训练方式（保上下文、mask loss）在工程上很实用；3) 数据选择常常对业务收益杠杆很高。局限：评测集中在 SWE 领域；迁移到内容治理需要重建质量/风险打分器。
papers.innovation_en: (1) Process-quality supervision at segment granularity. (2) Practical training mechanism (keep context, mask loss). (3) Data selection often yields high leverage. Limitation: evaluations focus on SWE; governance transfer needs new quality/risk scorers.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文报告在 SWE-Bench Pro/Verified 上：仅用 10% 轨迹子集即可优于全量 resolved 数据训练，最高相对提升 12.2% 与 24.2%。
papers.key_metrics_en: On SWE-Bench Pro and SWE-Bench Verified, training on the selected 10% trajectory subset outperforms training on the full resolved dataset, with up to 12.2% and 24.2% relative gains.

papers.title: Native Multimodal Representation Learning for Click-Through Rate Prediction in E-Commerce Scenarios
papers.authors: ["Chao Yi", "Feifan Yang", "Jiawei Feng", "Sishuo Chen", "Zhangming Chan", "Xiang-Rong Sheng", "Han Zhu"]
papers.affiliations: ["Taobao & Tmall Group of Alibaba", "University of Science and Technology of China"]
papers.tags: ["CTR", "多模态", "推荐", "数据质量", "电商", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 20, "results": 9, "exp_quality": 10, "efficiency": 6, "generalization": 3, "relevance": 23, "total": 71, "rationale_zh": "电商 CTR 强相关且从‘数据质量’角度切入很实用；扣分在于公开摘要缺少关键提升数值，复现需要线上日志与业务特征，外部可复用性受限。", "rationale_en": "Highly relevant and practical via a data-quality lens, but key numbers are not visible in abstract and reproduction requires proprietary logs/features, limiting external reusability."}
papers.rationale_zh: 电商 CTR 强相关且从‘数据质量’角度切入很实用；扣分在于公开摘要缺少关键提升数值，复现需要线上日志与业务特征，外部可复用性受限。
papers.rationale_en: Highly relevant and practical via a data-quality lens, but key numbers are not visible in abstract and reproduction requires proprietary logs/features, limiting external reusability.
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文研究电商 CTR 预估里的“多模态表示如何更贴近下游目标”。常见两阶段范式是先预训练多模态 encoder，再把 item embedding 作为特征喂给 CTR 模型，但预训练目标与 CTR 目标分布不一致。作者发现直接端到端联合训练 encoder+CTR 也不一定更好，原因在于 CTR 行为由多模态语义与非多模态因素共同驱动，监督信号混杂导致 encoder 更新不稳定。为此提出 Mine-Then-Train：先从原始 CTR 数据中挖掘更“可由多模态解释”的高质量样本，再用这些样本微调多模态 encoder，使其对齐点击偏好；再用于 CTR 模型，离线与线上均有效。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper studies how to learn multimodal representations that better serve CTR prediction in ecommerce. The standard two-stage paradigm pretrains a multimodal encoder and feeds item embeddings into a CTR model, but objectives and data distributions differ. The authors also find end-to-end joint training does not necessarily help because CTR labels mix multimodal-semantic and non-semantic factors, making supervision ambiguous and encoder updates inconsistent. They propose Mine-Then-Train: mine high-quality, multimodally interpretable samples from raw CTR logs and use them to fine-tune the encoder for alignment with click preferences, leading to gains in offline and online experiments.
papers.story_zh: 两阶段预训练的语义表示未必对 CTR 最有效；而直接端到端会被非语义因素（促销、位置、用户短期噪声等）干扰。Mine-Then-Train 的思路是先把数据质量问题解决：从大规模行为里筛出‘点击主要由内容/多模态语义驱动’的样本，让 encoder 学到更稳定的下游相关表征，再回到 CTR 任务。
papers.story_en: Pretrained multimodal embeddings may not align with CTR, and end-to-end training can be corrupted by non-semantic drivers (position, promotions, noise). Mine-Then-Train reframes the bottleneck as data quality: filter behavior data to samples where multimodal content explains clicks, then train the encoder on cleaner supervision.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 识别并验证 CTR 场景下端到端训练失败的根因：监督信号混杂；2) 用数据挖掘方式做‘可解释样本’筛选，把 representation learning 的瓶颈转成 data quality/selection 问题；3) 与电商内容生态相关：对内容理解更准意味着更好的分发/治理基础。局限：挖掘策略是否对不同业务域通用需要更多实验；采样偏置可能影响长尾泛化。
papers.innovation_en: (1) Diagnoses why naive end-to-end training fails under mixed supervision. (2) Converts representation learning into a data-selection problem via mining interpretable samples. (3) Strongly relevant to content ecology because better content-aligned embeddings support distribution and governance. Limitations include robustness of the mining heuristic across domains and potential sampling bias.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文报告离线与线上实验均验证 Mine-Then-Train 的有效性（摘要未披露具体指标数值）。
papers.key_metrics_en: The paper reports consistent improvements in offline and online experiments (exact numbers not in the abstract).

papers.title: CEDAR: Controlled and Event-Driven Demand Forecasting via Residual Decomposition
papers.authors: ["Junjie Meng", "Ranxu Zhang", "Zi-an Zhang", "Shujun Liu", "Xiaoning Qi", "Xiaozhou Xu", "Yanyong Zhang", "Hui Xiong", "Chao Wang"]
papers.affiliations: ["University of Science and Technology of China", "Alibaba Group", "The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)", "The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology"]
papers.tags: ["需求预测", "决策条件模拟", "时间序列", "电商", "中强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 21, "results": 10, "exp_quality": 11, "efficiency": 5, "generalization": 3, "relevance": 20, "total": 70, "rationale_zh": "电商经营侧强相关且数据规模大；但公开可复现性较弱、关键指标细节在摘要不可见，且更多偏供给/运营预测而非内容理解/达人治理主线。", "rationale_en": "Relevant to ecommerce planning with large-scale data, but weaker public reproducibility and limited visible metrics in abstract; more operations/forecasting than core content understanding/governance."}
papers.rationale_zh: 电商经营侧强相关且数据规模大；但公开可复现性较弱、关键指标细节在摘要不可见，且更多偏供给/运营预测而非内容理解/达人治理主线。
papers.rationale_en: Relevant to ecommerce planning with large-scale data, but weaker public reproducibility and limited visible metrics in abstract; more operations/forecasting than core content understanding/governance.
papers.method_overview_zh: CEDAR 面向“可控预测/仿真”而不是被动外推：商家需要评估未来预算/投放动作序列下的销量走向。方法分两阶段：Stage I 的 Action-Interleaved Transformer 学习 action-conditioned state transition，用于在计划干预下 rollout；Stage II 的 Residual Correction Module 把外部事件信号引入，并用 LLM 辅助的文本表征将噪声事件描述与商品上下文对齐，对事件驱动的偏差做残差修正。论文使用阿里 1688 的超大规模真实数据（约 3200 万商品轨迹）并报告离线与线上受控实验收益。
papers.method_overview_en: CEDAR targets decision-conditioned demand simulation instead of passive forecasting: merchants need to evaluate sales under planned action sequences such as budget schedules. It uses a two-stage design: an Action-Interleaved Transformer learns controllable action-conditioned transitions for rollout, and a Residual Correction Module incorporates external events, using LLM-assisted text representations to align noisy event descriptions with product context and correct event-driven deviations. The study is enabled by a 32M-trajectory real-world dataset from Alibaba 1688 and includes offline + online controlled experiments.
papers.story_zh: 传统 TSF 即使加了动作 covariate，也仍在历史策略下做相关性外推，容易出现 autoregressive inertia，并把市场自演化与决策引起的变化混在一起，导致 counterfactual 不可靠。CEDAR 把“可控部分（动作驱动的状态转移）”与“外部事件扰动（事件描述噪声大）”拆开：先学可控动力学，再用事件残差修正把突然的节日/活动/热点冲击补回来。
papers.story_en: Most TSF models remain policy-insensitive: even with action covariates they extrapolate correlations under historical policies, suffering autoregressive inertia and confounding endogenous evolution with decision-induced transitions. CEDAR separates controllable action dynamics from exogenous event shocks: learn the former, then correct the residual using event signals aligned by LLM text representations.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 明确提出决策条件的 demand simulation，并用两阶段把 action dynamics 与 event residual 分解，思路贴近实际经营分析；2) 引入 LLM 文本表征对齐事件描述与商品上下文，解决事件噪声；3) 超大规模工业数据 + 线上受控实验提升可信度。局限：实现依赖事件信号链路与文本质量；跨平台/跨类目的泛化需要更多证据。
papers.innovation_en: (1) A clear decision-conditioned simulation framing with action-vs-event residual decomposition. (2) LLM-assisted event-text alignment to handle noisy descriptions. (3) Large-scale industrial data and online controlled experiments improve credibility. Limitations include dependency on event pipelines/text quality and the need for broader cross-domain generalization evidence.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 数据规模：Alibaba 1688 约 3200 万商品轨迹（state-action 序列 + 事件信号）。论文报告离线与线上受控实验均优于强 TSF 基线（但摘要未给出具体数值）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Dataset: ~32M product trajectories from Alibaba 1688 with state–action sequences and aligned events. The paper reports consistent gains over strong TSF baselines in offline and online controlled experiments (exact numbers not in the abstract).

papers.title: HMGCLIP: Heterogeneous Multi-Granularity Contrastive Learning for E-commerce Representation Learning
papers.authors: ["Qiuyu Zhu", "Yi Gao", "Zhichao Wan", "Mingyang Ma"]
papers.tags: ["多模态表征", "对比学习", "电商", "相似/聚类", "中强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 21, "results": 9, "exp_quality": 10, "efficiency": 5, "generalization": 3, "relevance": 21, "total": 69, "rationale_zh": "电商表征学习强相关且方向正确，但摘要缺少量化结果细节、复现信息不明确；方法偏结构化建模，工程落地需额外成本。", "rationale_en": "Strongly relevant direction, but limited quantitative details and unclear reproducibility; structured modeling may incur extra engineering cost in production."}
papers.rationale_zh: 电商表征学习强相关且方向正确，但摘要缺少量化结果细节、复现信息不明确；方法偏结构化建模，工程落地需额外成本。
papers.rationale_en: Strongly relevant direction, but limited quantitative details and unclear reproducibility; structured modeling may incur extra engineering cost in production.
papers.method_overview_zh: HMGCLIP 针对电商商品“细粒度属性可分辨性不足”的问题，提出一个统一的多模态 embedding 框架。它把电商数据的结构（类目层级、属性、商品组等）组织成 heterogeneous hypergraph，并利用超图拓扑挖掘结构感知的 hard negatives；训练时在 relation 与 hyperedge 两个粒度对齐多粒度语义。推理时采用 dual-granularity 机制，把 attribute evidence 动态融合到不同下游任务（细粒度属性判别、粗粒度检索/相似等）。同时发布一个新的细粒度电商数据集并在 MAVE 上评测。
papers.method_overview_en: HMGCLIP targets fine-grained attribute discrimination in ecommerce representation learning. It constructs a heterogeneous hypergraph from ecommerce structures (categories, attributes, product groups) and uses hypergraph topology to mine structure-aware hard negatives. Training aligns multi-granular semantics at both relation and hyperedge levels, and inference uses a dual-granularity fusion mechanism to combine attribute evidence for fine- and coarse-grained downstream tasks. The authors also release a fine-grained ecommerce dataset and evaluate on MAVE.
papers.story_zh: 通用 MLLM/CLIP 往往倾向把商品压成全局 embedding，导致对材质/工艺/细小差异不敏感；而随机负采样很难持续提供‘看起来很像但属性不同’的 hard negatives。HMGCLIP 用电商知识结构构建超图，系统性地产生结构化 hard negatives，并让表示在不同粒度上对齐，从而把‘可分辨性’作为核心优化目标。
papers.story_en: General-purpose CLIP/MLLM embeddings are often too global to capture subtle attribute differences, and random negatives rarely provide semantically confusable hard negatives. HMGCLIP leverages structured ecommerce graphs to systematically mine hard negatives and align representations across granularities.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 将电商结构信息以超图方式显式注入表示学习，用拓扑挖 hard negatives，更贴近业务（相似/去重/属性）；2) 多粒度对齐 + 双粒度推理，提高在属性与检索任务间的兼容性；3) 发布新数据集有利于后续 benchmarking。局限：细节依赖具体图构建策略与负样本挖掘成本；若无开源代码，复现门槛较高。
papers.innovation_en: (1) Injects ecommerce structure via a heterogeneous hypergraph to mine hard negatives aligned with business needs (similarity/dedup/attributes). (2) Multi-granularity alignment with dual-granularity inference improves task coverage. (3) Releasing a dataset helps benchmarking. Limitations include graph construction cost and potentially high reproduction barrier without open code.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文在新发布的细粒度电商数据集以及公开 MAVE benchmark 上实验，报告优于强 multimodal encoder、MLLM 与电商基线（摘要未给出具体数值）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Experiments on the released fine-grained ecommerce dataset and the public MAVE benchmark show improvements over strong multimodal encoders, MLLMs, and ecommerce baselines (numbers not provided in abstract).

papers.rationale_zh: 方法本身不错且有 SOTA 提升，但与电商内容理解/达人治理属于弱相关（更多是通用 OWOD）。
papers.rationale_en: Solid method with SOTA gains, but only weakly tied to ecommerce content/governance (general OWOD).
papers.method_overview_zh: CODE 提出一个推理期统一框架来改进基于多模态 foundation model 的开放世界目标检测（OWOD）。它包含三部分：Cross-Modal Joint Confidence Calibration 用全局视觉原型校准文本驱动的已知类预测；Uncertainty-Guided Universal Objectness Enhancement 用局部视觉响应的‘犹豫度’增强潜在未知目标；Dynamic Outlier Suppression via Confidence Margin 用 margin-aware 的方式替代刚性抑制，减少把边界附近未知目标过度压制。
papers.method_overview_en: CODE is an inference-time framework for open-world object detection (OWOD) built on multimodal foundation models. It includes: cross-modal confidence calibration using global visual prototypes; uncertainty-guided universal objectness enhancement; and dynamic outlier suppression via confidence margins to preserve ambiguous OOD instances.
papers.story_zh: OWOD 场景下，文本→视觉的单向匹配会造成语义歧义，而对未知目标的固定 outlier penalty 又会把‘靠近已知类边界的未知’误杀。CODE 通过校准已知类置信度、增强通用 objectness、以及动态抑制策略，把已知/未知的决策更平滑、更鲁棒。
papers.story_en: Unidirectional text-to-vision matching causes semantic ambiguity, and rigid outlier penalties can over-suppress unknown objects near known-class boundaries. CODE calibrates known-class confidence, strengthens universal objectness for unknowns, and replaces rigid suppression with a margin-aware adjustment.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 全部为 inference-time 组件，便于接入现有多模态检测 backbone；2) 兼顾已知类校准与未知类保留，思路清晰。与电商内容治理的关联主要在‘开放世界违规/新型商品/新型违规’的未知检测启发，属于弱相关。
papers.innovation_en: All components are inference-time, making integration practical. Relevance to ecommerce governance is indirect (unknown/new-object detection for emerging content), hence weaker.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文报告在 Real-World Detection benchmark 上：基于 OWL-ViT L/14，Task 1 达到 21.7 U-mAP 与 40.8 K-mAP，分别比先前 SOTA 提升 2.6 与 2.3。
papers.key_metrics_en: On the Real-World Detection benchmark with OWL-ViT L/14, CODE reports 21.7 U-mAP and 40.8 K-mAP in Task 1, improving prior SOTA by 2.6 and 2.3 points.

papers.authors: ["Liyan Tang", "Cyrus Rashtchian", "Chun-Sung Ferng", "Andrew Tomkins", "Da-Cheng Juan", "Tu Vu"]

papers.rationale_en: Methodologically useful for governance workflows, but less directly tied to ecommerce content understanding/creator governance, so relevance is lower.
papers.method_overview_zh: WikiSkill 提出把 agent 的执行经验沉淀为“可持续积累的 wiki 知识库”，并据此推动技能迭代。框架将 raw experience、accumulated knowledge（wiki）、以及 executable skills 三者解耦：每轮执行后把经验归纳进 wiki，下一轮技能更新读取 wiki 做更系统的演化。作者报告该策略在多种 benchmark 与模型上优于现有 skill-evolution 方法，并发现技能可跨模型迁移、且大模型往往更能从技能演化中获益。
papers.method_overview_en: WikiSkill co-evolves agent skills with a persistent knowledge base (wiki). It separates raw experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills: experience is continuously consolidated into the wiki, which subsequent skill updates build on. Across benchmarks and models, WikiSkill outperforms prior skill-evolution methods and shows transferable skills across model families.
papers.story_zh: 现有自动技能发现/演化往往把洞见散落在优化轨迹里，导致跨迭代复用差。WikiSkill 认为‘经验→知识→技能’需要显式分层，把经验结构化为可检索的 wiki，再用它指导下一轮技能更新，从而减少遗忘、提升可迁移性与可解释性。
papers.story_en: Insights for skill development are often scattered across optimization traces, limiting reuse. WikiSkill introduces an explicit experience→knowledge→skill layering by compiling experience into a persistent wiki that drives the next iteration.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 把‘技能演化’与‘知识沉淀’绑定成一个闭环，对企业场景（治理策略、审核 SOP、达人治理工作流）很有启发；2) 强调跨模型迁移与外部技能复用；3) 通过 ablation 说明 wiki 累积是关键组件。局限：与电商内容治理的直接任务相关性偏弱，更偏方法论；需要结合具体业务工具链落地。
papers.innovation_en: (1) Closing the loop between knowledge accumulation and skill evolution is useful for enterprise workflows (governance SOPs). (2) Emphasizes cross-model transfer. (3) Ablations highlight the importance of the persistent wiki. Limitation: weaker direct relevance to ecommerce content governance without domain integration.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文报告在多 benchmark/多模型上稳定提升并优于 SOTA skill evolution；并展示技能跨模型迁移有效（摘要未给出具体数值）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Reported consistent improvements over SOTA skill evolution across benchmarks/models and effective cross-model transfer (numbers not in abstract).

papers.title: UrbanGround: From Local Perception to Spatial Agency in a Real-Scale City
papers.authors: ["Tianjie Ju", "Zheng Wu", "Yueqing Sun", "Yuhan Cui", "Bobo Li", "Shengqiong Wu", "Pengzhou Cheng", "Haodong Zhao", "Zongru Wu", "Xinbei Ma", "Doris Zhang", "Kunling Li", "Mong-Li Lee", "Wynne Hsu", "Hao Fei", "Qi Gu", "Gongshen Liu", "Zhuosheng Zhang"]

papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 20, "results": 8, "exp_quality": 10, "efficiency": 5, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 10, "total": 57, "rationale_zh": "作为 MLLM agent 评测平台很有价值，但与电商内容理解/达人治理属于弱相关（主要是启发治理 agent 的长程可靠性），因此相关性得分较低。", "rationale_en": "Valuable benchmark for MLLM agents, but only weakly tied to ecommerce content/governance, so relevance is low."}
papers.rationale_zh: 作为 MLLM agent 评测平台很有价值，但与电商内容理解/达人治理属于弱相关（主要是启发治理 agent 的长程可靠性），因此相关性得分较低。
papers.rationale_en: Valuable benchmark for MLLM agents, but only weakly tied to ecommerce content/governance, so relevance is low.
papers.method_overview_zh: UrbanGround 构建了一个真实尺度城市（香港）3D 沙盒，用于评测 MLLM agent 能否把局部视觉感知可靠地转化为持续的空间行动。它提供第一人称闭环交互与可交互地图，围绕三类研究问题评测：主动观察后能否回答空间问题、目的地更远更隐式时能否导航、以及路网变化/行人运动扰动下行为是否稳定。结论指出现有 MLLM agent 在原子识别/短程推理上有用，但在长程探索中会累积误差，缺少有效纠错。
papers.method_overview_en: UrbanGround introduces a real-scale 3D city sandbox (Hong Kong) to evaluate whether MLLM agents can turn local perception into sustained spatial agency. It supports first-person closed-loop interaction and map-based navigation, and evaluates active observation Q&A, long-range navigation with implicit destinations, and robustness under route and pedestrian changes. Findings show strong atomic recognition/short-range reasoning but unreliable long-horizon goal-directed behavior with accumulating errors.
papers.story_zh: 很多 MLLM agent demo 停留在单步或短 horizon，难以判断其在复杂开放环境下是否可靠。UrbanGround 把问题拉长到真实城市尺度，并通过闭环交互把‘局部能力是否可组合成长期目标达成’作为核心挑战，暴露出 orientation、长程纠错与行人感知等短板。
papers.story_en: Short-horizon demos cannot reveal whether local abilities compose into reliable long-horizon agency. UrbanGround stresses agents in a real-scale city, highlighting failures in orientation, long-horizon correction, and pedestrian-aware movement.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 提供真实尺度城市沙盒与系统化评测维度，适合研究 agent 在复杂环境下的可靠性；2) 对电商内容生态的间接价值：长程 agent 的稳定性/纠错能力与‘自动化治理/巡检’类任务类似。局限：与电商内容理解/达人治理直接相关较弱；数据与环境构建成本高。
papers.innovation_en: (1) A real-scale city sandbox with structured evaluation dimensions for long-horizon agents. (2) Indirect relevance to governance automation where long-horizon reliability matters. Limitation: weak direct ecommerce relevance and high environment construction cost.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文主要贡献为 benchmark/分析结论：现有 MLLM agent 在长程探索中的组合性不足、误差累积明显（摘要未给出具体数值）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Main contribution is the benchmark and analysis: current MLLM agents show error accumulation and unreliable long-horizon behavior (no specific numbers in abstract).

papers.title: CARA: Cognitive Adaptive Recommendation Agent
papers.authors: ["Weijun Gao", "Jinyang Dong", "Chuanru Ren", "Hengxiao Li"]
papers.affiliations: ["The Chinese University of Hong Kong", "Tongji University"]
papers.tags: ["推荐", "Agent", "偏好建模", "电商", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 27, "results": 14, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 7, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 24, "total": 88, "rationale_zh": "与电商推荐/达人内容分发强相关，方法结构清晰、可解释性强且有较明显的指标提升；扣分主要在公开实验范围与生产级约束尚不充分。", "rationale_en": "Highly relevant to ecommerce recommendation and creator-content distribution; clear structured method with strong gains. Points deducted due to limited publicly verifiable production constraints and broader evaluations."}
papers.rationale_zh: 与电商推荐/达人内容分发强相关，方法结构清晰、可解释性强且有较明显的指标提升；扣分主要在公开实验范围与生产级约束尚不充分。
papers.rationale_en: Highly relevant to ecommerce recommendation and creator-content distribution; clear structured method with strong gains. Points deducted due to limited publicly verifiable production constraints and broader evaluations.
papers.method_overview_zh: CARA 将推荐建模成一个更接近人类决策的结构化过程：先做候选过滤（candidate filtering）缩小搜索空间，再用“双视角决策”对候选做最终判断。双视角包含直觉性的情绪/偏好（affective preference）与更审慎的理性评估（rational evaluation），并通过融合机制得到最终排序。训练阶段引入 boundary-aware KTO：优先采样模型“偶尔能做对但不稳定”的边界样本，让偏好信号更密集、学习更聚焦。整体目标是在推荐场景中让 agent 既能快速抓住用户偏好，又能通过理性判断避免局部最优。
papers.method_overview_en: CARA frames recommendation as a structured, cognitively inspired decision process: it first performs candidate filtering to narrow the search space, then applies a dual-perspective decision module to rank the remaining items. The dual perspective models intuitive affective preference and deliberate rational evaluation, and fuses them into the final ranking. During training, CARA introduces boundary-aware KTO that emphasizes borderline instructions/samples the model can solve occasionally but not consistently, increasing the density of informative preference signals. The overall goal is to make an agent both preference-sensitive and decision-stable for recommendation.
papers.story_zh: 现有 LLM/agent 推荐方法要么偏“语义匹配”，要么偏“生成式端到端”，但缺少对用户偏好如何被处理成最终决策的显式建模。CARA 认为用户决策由直觉偏好与理性评估共同塑造，于是把流程拆成候选过滤与双视角决策，并用 boundary-aware KTO 强化不稳定边界样本，从而提升推荐的稳定性与效果。
papers.story_en: Existing LLM/agent recommenders often rely on semantic matching or end-to-end generation without explicitly modeling how preferences become decisions. CARA argues decisions are shaped jointly by affective intuition and rational deliberation, implements a filter + dual-route decision pipeline, and uses boundary-aware KTO to focus learning on unstable borderline samples for better stability and quality.
papers.innovation_zh: 1) 把推荐 agent 的“决策流程”结构化为“过滤→双通路决策”，相比仅做语义匹配/端到端生成更可解释；2) 用 affective/rational 分解显式刻画“冲动喜欢 vs 理性权衡”的差异，这与电商内容生态中“种草-拔草-比价”链路更贴近；3) boundary-aware KTO 的价值在于把训练预算集中在不稳定区域，而不是把大量 easy 样本重复喂给模型。局限是论文对真实线上链路（召回、多目标约束、延迟/成本）的讨论较少，需要结合业务系统落地。
papers.innovation_en: (1) A structured filter→dual-decision workflow improves interpretability over pure semantic matching or end-to-end generation. (2) Explicit affective vs rational decomposition matches real ecommerce behavior such as impulse attraction vs careful trade-offs. (3) Boundary-aware KTO reallocates training budget toward unstable regions rather than repeatedly fitting easy samples. A limitation is that production constraints (multi-objective serving, latency, and retrieval stack) still need additional engineering for deployment.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文在 Amazon Reviews 三个域（CDs / Office / Beauty）上报告 HR@1/5 与 NDCG@5/10 等指标，CARA 在大多数指标上优于基线，最高相对提升达到 10.15%。
papers.key_metrics_en: On three Amazon Reviews domains (CDs/Office/Beauty), CARA reports improvements on HR@1/5 and NDCG@5/10, with up to 10.15% relative gain over baselines.

papers.title: Data-DPO: Direct Preference Optimization for Target Model Data Selection in LLM Post-Training
papers.authors: ["Peng Sun", "Yi Yang", "Antong Zhang", "Chunxiao Li", "Yanbo Wang", "Dianbo Liu", "Xin Chen", "Kai Yu", "Lu Chen", "Tianfan Fu"]
papers.affiliations: ["Nanjing University", "Brown University", "Fudan University", "National University of Singapore", "Shanghai Jiao Tong University"]
papers.tags: ["数据选择", "DPO", "LLM 后训练", "数据质量", "中强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 26, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 22, "total": 85, "rationale_zh": "对大规模数据筛选/清洗与后训练降本增效很有价值，尤其适合多业务、多模型并行的电商内容生态；扣分在于 probing 成本与组合权重的工程落地不确定性。", "rationale_en": "Very useful for large-scale data selection/cleaning and post-training cost reduction; particularly relevant for multi-domain ecommerce content ecosystems. Points deducted due to probing cost and engineering uncertainty of the combined selection objective."}
papers.rationale_zh: 对大规模数据筛选/清洗与后训练降本增效很有价值，尤其适合多业务、多模型并行的电商内容生态；扣分在于 probing 成本与组合权重的工程落地不确定性。
papers.rationale_en: Very useful for large-scale data selection/cleaning and post-training cost reduction; particularly relevant for multi-domain ecommerce content ecosystems. Points deducted due to probing cost and engineering uncertainty of the combined selection objective.
papers.method_overview_zh: Data-DPO 关注“数据价值并不是静态属性”，而是与目标模型当前能力分布强相关。方法先对目标模型做 one-step probing：对不同样本做一步局部训练，观察激活/训练反馈差异，把样本之间的差异转成 pairwise data preference。然后用轻量 reward model 通过 DPO 思路学习“目标模型视角的数据偏好”。最后在选择阶段把 reward、外部质量分（如去重/过滤器）以及边际多样性一起组合，得到更稳定有效的 SFT 子集，从而在更小数据预算下维持甚至超过全量训练表现。
papers.method_overview_en: Data-DPO argues that data value is not static; it depends on the capability distribution of the target model. It performs one-step probing on the target model to obtain local training feedback signals, converts activation/feedback differences into pairwise data preferences, and trains a lightweight reward model via a DPO-style objective to learn target-model-aware preferences. In the final selection stage, it combines reward, external quality scores, and marginal diversity to produce a stable and effective fine-tuning subset, enabling smaller data budgets to match or exceed full-data training.
papers.story_zh: 传统 SFT 数据选择往往把样本价值当作静态属性，忽视不同目标模型的能力差异，导致“选出来的数据”不一定补齐 target model 的短板。Data-DPO 因此用 one-step probing 直接观察目标模型对样本的局部反馈，把这种差异变成偏好对，并用 DPO 训练 reward model 学到 target-aware 的数据偏好，最终结合质量与多样性稳定筛选出更有效的数据子集。
papers.story_en: Classic SFT data selection treats sample value as a static property and ignores target-model differences, so the selected subset may not address the target’s weaknesses. Data-DPO observes target-side local feedback via one-step probing, turns it into pairwise preferences, learns a target-aware reward model with DPO, and finally selects a high-quality, diverse subset for more effective post-training.
papers.innovation_zh: 亮点在于把“数据筛选”从通用的静态打分（困惑度/长度/去重等）推进到“面向目标模型”的动态偏好学习。one-step probing 给出了可操作的局部反馈信号，比纯启发式更贴近 target model 的短板分布；DPO-style 的 pairwise 学习避免了显式回归绝对分数的不稳定。风险点是：真实大模型下 probing 的开销与方差可能较大，因此需要工程上做近似与缓存，并且 reward/quality/diversity 的组合权重需要业务数据调参。
papers.innovation_en: The key contribution is shifting from heuristic, static data scoring to target-aware preference learning. One-step probing provides actionable local feedback aligned with the target model’s weaknesses, while pairwise DPO-style training avoids unstable absolute-value regression. Practical concerns include probing cost/variance at LLM scale and tuning the reward/quality/diversity mixture.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文在 Vision-Flan 与 LLaVA-CoT 设置下报告：在多种 budget 下 Data-DPO 均优于数据筛选基线，并且在部分设置下稳定超过 full-data 训练。作者报告 Vision-Flan 的 ARP 达到约 100.76%–102.70%，LLaVA-CoT 最高约 103.93%。
papers.key_metrics_en: On Vision-Flan and LLaVA-CoT, Data-DPO outperforms prior data selection baselines across multiple budgets and can stably surpass full-data training in some settings. Reported ARP is around 100.76%–102.70% on Vision-Flan and up to ~103.93% on LLaVA-CoT.

papers.title: On the Fragility of Self-Improving Agents: Variance, Task Order, and Underspecification
papers.authors: ["Qinyuan Ye", "Yu Li", "Yada Pruksachatkun", "Jiaxin Zhang", "Chien-Sheng Wu"]
papers.tags: ["Agent 可靠性", "自我改进", "评测协议", "中相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 18, "results": 10, "exp_quality": 14, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 5, "relevance": 18, "total": 74, "rationale_zh": "对 agent 可靠性与评测协议很有价值，能直接指导治理 agent 的压测与上线准入；但与电商内容理解本体模型属于间接相关，因此未到复现阈值。", "rationale_en": "Highly useful for reliability protocol design of governance agents, but only indirectly tied to ecommerce content understanding models, so not in the reproduction threshold."}
papers.rationale_zh: 对 agent 可靠性与评测协议很有价值，能直接指导治理 agent 的压测与上线准入；但与电商内容理解本体模型属于间接相关，因此未到复现阈值。
papers.rationale_en: Highly useful for reliability protocol design of governance agents, but only indirectly tied to ecommerce content understanding models, so not in the reproduction threshold.
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文重新审视两类 memory-based self-improving agent（通过维护文本记忆库，在线任务流中持续改进），指出既有评测忽视了可靠性：只跑单次、固定任务顺序，导致结论脆弱。作者强调两点：一是复杂环境本身评测噪声大，自我改进循环会进一步放大方差；二是 agent 的提升高度依赖任务顺序，默认顺序隐含课程学习，成为“隐藏前提”。为理解原因，作者人工分析记忆内容，提出“任务/环境欠规格（underspecification）”是关键因素之一，并通过往记忆中加入更细的 rubric 与环境反馈做验证，虽能部分缓解但仍有差距。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper re-evaluates memory-based self-improving agents that learn from an online stream of tasks by maintaining a textual memory bank, and argues that prior evaluations overlook reliability by using single runs and fixed task orders. It shows agent evaluation is noisy and self-improving loops amplify variance, and that improvements are highly dependent on task order where default orderings impose an implicit hidden curriculum. The authors hypothesize underspecification of tasks/environments contributes to the fragility, and partially validate it by adding detailed rubrics and environment feedback into memory construction.
papers.story_zh: 自我改进 agent 看起来能“越做越好”，但现有评测往往只在固定顺序、单次运行下汇报结果。论文因此系统加上多次运行与任务顺序打乱，发现方法非常脆弱，并进一步追溯到任务与环境描述不充分导致记忆构造不稳定，从而呼吁更严格的评测与更可监督的接口设计。
papers.story_en: Self-improving agents appear to get better over time, but prior evaluations often rely on a single run with a fixed task order. By running multiple seeds and shuffling task orders, the paper exposes substantial fragility and traces it to task/environment underspecification, motivating more rigorous protocols and oversight-friendly interfaces.
papers.innovation_zh: 贡献不在新算法，而在“把坑挖出来”：如果要在电商内容生态里做持续学习/自改进的治理 agent（例如反复更新规则、纠错话术），评测必须显式报告多次运行的方差，并对 task order 做打乱压力测试，否则上线后容易出现不可预期退化。对治理来说，“欠规格”也很关键：没有明确 rubric/反馈，记忆库可能写入噪声或错误归因，导致越学越偏。
papers.innovation_en: The contribution is an evaluation and reliability lens: for continuously improving governance agents, you must report variance across runs and stress-test task order, otherwise real deployments can degrade unpredictably. The underspecification finding also suggests governance systems need explicit rubrics/feedback interfaces to avoid noisy memory accumulation.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文的核心指标是：多次运行与不同任务顺序下性能差异显著，表明既有方法对顺序与噪声高度敏感；加入更细 rubric/反馈能部分提升鲁棒性但仍未完全解决（具体数值以原文表格为准）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Key finding: performance varies significantly across runs and task order shuffles; adding richer rubrics/feedback partially closes the gap but does not fully solve the fragility (see paper tables for exact numbers).

papers.title: Cross-Model Memory Transfer via Target-Side Reader Adaptation
papers.authors: ["Mingyuan Li", "Guangsheng Yu", "Xu Wang", "Shaoxiong Ji"]
papers.tags: ["Agent 记忆", "外部记忆", "RAG", "弱相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 22, "results": 10, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 14, "total": 70, "rationale_zh": "对 agent 记忆与知识复用很有启发，但与电商内容理解/达人治理属于间接相关，且实验指标主要为受控 QA 协议。", "rationale_en": "Insightful for agent memory reuse, but only indirectly relevant to ecommerce content/gov, and results are mainly under controlled QA protocols."}
papers.rationale_zh: 对 agent 记忆与知识复用很有启发，但与电商内容理解/达人治理属于间接相关，且实验指标主要为受控 QA 协议。
papers.rationale_en: Insightful for agent memory reuse, but only indirectly relevant to ecommerce content/gov, and results are mainly under controlled QA protocols.
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文研究 Engram-style hashed external memory 在“跨模型迁移”时到底应该迁移什么：是外部 memory table，还是 reader 读出模块。作者构建 cross-model frozen-memory extraction：在 source model 上训练 memory table，然后冻结该表并挂到不同的 target model 上，只训练一个轻量 target-side reader。结果显示 memory 内容与正确寻址都重要，但外部表要真正可用必须依赖与 target interface 对齐的 reader；当 provider reader 与 target 兼容时，冻结 artifact 也能直接带来收益。论文提出 dual-layer four-branch reader 结构，能把 cross-model reuse 的差距进一步缩小。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper studies what really matters for cross-model reuse of Engram-style hashed external memories: the frozen memory table itself or the reader that consumes it. It proposes a controlled cross-model frozen-memory extraction setting: train a memory table on a source model, freeze it, attach it to a different target model, and train only a lightweight target-side reader. Results show the transferred table becomes useful only when the reader is aligned to the target interface; when provider readers are compatible, frozen artifacts can already provide utility. A dual-layer four-branch reader further closes the gap between same-model and cross-model reuse.
papers.story_zh: 参数内化（finetune）难更新、难审计，非参数检索（RAG）又有延迟与上下文开销，因此 Engram 式外部记忆成为折中方案。但当我们希望把这种外部记忆跨 backbone 复用时，效果并不稳定。论文因此固定 memory table、只调 reader，系统性验证 reader 对齐是跨模型复用的关键，并提出更强 reader 结构来弥合差距。
papers.story_en: Fine-tuned parametric knowledge is hard to update and audit, while retrieval adds latency and context overhead. Engram-style external memory is a middle ground, but cross-backbone reuse is fragile. The paper freezes the memory table and adapts only the reader to show that reader alignment is the core for effective transfer, and proposes a stronger reader design to reduce the gap.
papers.innovation_zh: 这篇更偏“把问题问清楚”：在 agent/检索增强系统里，我们常希望把知识作为可复用的外部 artifact 迁移给不同 backbone，但实际瓶颈可能在 reader 对齐而非存储本体。论文用受控实验拆分 memory content vs reader alignment，并给出了一个实用的 reader 设计思路。对电商内容治理的启发是：如果要把治理知识库或达人规则做成外部记忆，接口层（reader/schema）可能比存储层更决定可迁移性。
papers.innovation_en: This work clarifies an important bottleneck: for reusable external knowledge artifacts, reader/interface alignment can dominate over storage content. The controlled ablations disentangle memory content vs addressing vs reader alignment. For ecommerce governance knowledge bases, it suggests schema/reader compatibility may be the key to cross-backbone reuse.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 作者报告在 QA 任务的受控协议下，dual-layer four-branch reader 的 cross-model reuse 平均得分约 38.8，并能显著缩小 same-model 与 cross-model reuse 的差距。
papers.key_metrics_en: Under controlled QA evaluation, the dual-layer four-branch reader achieves an average score of ~38.8 and significantly narrows the same-model vs cross-model reuse gap.

papers.title: Harness the Memory: A Holistic Evaluation of Memory Substrates in Memory Agents
papers.authors: ["Wei-Chieh Huang", "Weizhi Zhang", "Yuchen Wu", "Yankai Chen", "Eric Hanchen Jiang", "Wooseong Yang", "Yiwei Yang", "Henry Peng Zou", "Hanrong Zhang", "Ying Nian Wu", "Haolun Wu", "Kai-Wei Chang", "Philip S. Yu", "Xue Liu", "Aylin Caliskan"]
papers.tags: ["Agent 记忆", "评测", "治理/可靠性", "弱相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 19, "results": 11, "exp_quality": 14, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 13, "total": 69, "rationale_zh": "评测方法学扎实，但与电商内容理解/达人治理的相关性更偏间接（可作为 agent 记忆治理的参考）。", "rationale_en": "Strong methodology as an evaluation study, but only indirectly relevant to ecommerce content/creator governance."}
papers.rationale_zh: 评测方法学扎实，但与电商内容理解/达人治理的相关性更偏间接（可作为 agent 记忆治理的参考）。
papers.rationale_en: Strong methodology as an evaluation study, but only indirectly relevant to ecommerce content/creator governance.
papers.method_overview_zh: 这篇工作不提出新记忆模块，而是对 memory agent 的“记忆基底（memory substrate）”做受控评测，覆盖 dense/sparse index、文本记录、结构化存储、分层存储、refinement-based memory、参数更新与 activation-compatible context 等路线。作者在统一 harness 下跨 3 个 backbone 与 4 套 benchmark，记录 26 个性能与效率指标，展示不同 substrate 在不同运行区间（长上下文 QA vs 顺序决策、短历史 vs 长历史）下的取舍。核心结论是：没有一种 substrate 能在所有场景压倒性胜出，需要做“substrate routing”。
papers.method_overview_en: Rather than proposing a new memory module, this work performs a controlled harness evaluation of memory substrates for memory-augmented agents, covering dense/sparse indices, text records, structural stores, hierarchical stores, refinement-based memories, parametric updates, and activation-compatible context mechanisms. Under a unified harness across three backbones and four benchmark suites, it reports 26 performance and efficiency metrics and shows that no single substrate dominates across regimes, motivating substrate routing.
papers.story_zh: 长时序 agent 越来越依赖外部记忆，但社区缺少“在什么运行区间该用哪种记忆介质”的统一指导。论文因此搭建统一 harness，把多种记忆 substrate 放在同一评测框架内进行全面对比，从而给出 substrate routing 的证据与设计建议。
papers.story_en: As long-horizon agents increasingly rely on external memory, the field lacks guidance on which memory substrate to use under which operating regime. The paper builds a unified harness and systematically compares multiple substrates, providing evidence for the need of substrate routing and regime-aware memory design.
papers.innovation_zh: 亮点在于把“记忆选择”从经验主义推进到可度量的系统评估：同一套 harness 下同时看效果、延迟、上下文开销、长历史稳定性等多维指标，并指出过度检索可能反而伤害 sequential decision-making（注意力被无关历史冲走）。对电商达人治理的启示是：当我们把规则、违规样例、达人历史行为写入记忆时，需要区分‘事实检索’与‘决策执行’两类任务，否则记忆过载会降低动作质量。
papers.innovation_en: The contribution is methodological: it turns memory-substrate choice into a measurable system trade-off across quality, latency, context overhead, and long-horizon robustness, and highlights that excessive retrieval can hurt sequential decision-making by distracting attention. For ecommerce governance agents, it suggests routing between factual retrieval and action-critical decision memory is necessary.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 作者报告在长历史下，层次化存储等方案可在保持任务效果的同时，将推理成本（如 context/检索开销）降低约 40%–60%（论文以多项指标呈现，具体以原文表格为准）。
papers.key_metrics_en: The paper reports that hierarchical storage can reduce inference cost by ~40%–60% under long histories while maintaining task quality (exact numbers depend on the benchmark/metric tables in the paper).

papers.title: StartupBench: Benchmarking General-Purpose Agents on Market-Validated End-to-End Workflows
papers.authors: ["Liya Zhu", "Xin Ma", "Tao Liu", "Haodong Wang", "Ge Zhang", "Jingzhe Ding", "Qingshui Gu", "Yongjie Zhong", "Jinxiang Meng", "Yuan Gao", "Yunqiu Zhou", "Hao Zhu", "Jifeng He", "Yongzhi Liao", "Xinyi Zhang", "Chaoxin Li", "Yi Zhu", "Xi Lin", "Duju Zeng", "Xiang Gao", "Wen Zhang", "Yunyang Wang", "Duo Wang", "Huan Zhou", "Zuo Wang", "Jin Chen", "Kaiyuan Zhang", "Chuqian Yu", "Tianhao Yu", "Longxiang Liu", "Jianbo Xue", "Huimin Che", "Jiahao Wang", "Yujia Qin", "Jiaheng Liu", "Shen Yan", "Xiaolong Chang", "Wenhao Huang"]

papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 18, "results": 9, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 10, "total": 62, "rationale_zh": "benchmark 价值明确，但对电商内容理解/达人治理属于启发式间接相关；且当前缺少明确可复现开源资源。", "rationale_en": "Clear benchmark contribution, but only indirectly relevant to ecommerce content/creator governance, and public reproducibility is unclear."}
papers.rationale_zh: benchmark 价值明确，但对电商内容理解/达人治理属于启发式间接相关；且当前缺少明确可复现开源资源。
papers.rationale_en: Clear benchmark contribution, but only indirectly relevant to ecommerce content/creator governance, and public reproducibility is unclear.
papers.method_overview_zh: StartupBench 构建一个以“市场验证的 AI 产品工作流”为基础的端到端 agent benchmark。它不是研究者拍脑袋挑任务，而是系统性研究真实 AI startup 产品、产品 workflow 与用户需求，把这些 workflow 翻译成以 deliverable 为导向的完整任务，并用细粒度 rubric 来评估 agent 的复杂约束满足。作者在统一 agent harness 下评测多个代表性模型，发现即使最强模型也只完成约 30% 任务，失败主要来自复杂指令遵循与领域专精不足。
papers.method_overview_en: StartupBench is an end-to-end agent benchmark grounded in market-validated AI startup product workflows. Instead of researcher-selected tasks, it studies real products and users to identify workflows with practical demand, translates them into deliverable-oriented tasks, and evaluates agents with fine-grained rubrics under a unified harness. Even the strongest model completes only ~30% of tasks, with major failures attributed to complex instruction following and domain-specific expertise gaps.
papers.story_zh: 当前 agent benchmark 多由研究者主观挑选任务，难代表真实用户需求。StartupBench 反过来从市场已经验证的 AI 产品 workflow 出发，构造可交付的端到端任务与 rubric，并用它检验当前通用 agent 是否真的能完成真实工作流，从而揭示能力缺口。
papers.story_en: Many agent benchmarks are defined by researchers and may not reflect what real users demand. StartupBench instead derives tasks from market-proven product workflows, builds deliverable-level rubrics, and evaluates general-purpose agents to expose the remaining gap to reliable end-to-end completions.
papers.innovation_zh: 对治理价值在于：它把“能否做完真实业务 workflow”量化成可评测任务，避免 benchmark 与真实需求脱节。对电商内容生态&达人治理来说，可以把类似的“达人审核/违规处置/内容质检/策略配置”做成 StartupBench 风格的可交付 workflow，作为治理 agent 的准入门槛。缺点是如果不开源 harness/数据，外部难复现。
papers.innovation_en: Its value for governance is aligning benchmarks with real-world deliverable workflows rather than synthetic tasks. For ecommerce content and creator governance, similar workflow-based benchmarks could be built for auditing, violation handling, and content quality loops. A limitation is that reproducibility depends on whether the harness and data are released.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文报告在统一 harness 下，最强模型仅能成功完成约 30% 的 StartupBench 端到端任务（其余任务多能部分推进但难闭环）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Under a unified harness, the strongest evaluated model successfully completes only ~30% of StartupBench end-to-end tasks.

papers.title: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness
papers.authors: ["TaoLive AIGC LLM Team", "Yuhan Sun", "Wenhao Lin", "Yongdong Luo", "Yibo Hu", "Meiguang Jin", "Junfeng Ma", "Weihang Pan", "Jiaxin Zhao", "Zulong Chen"]
papers.tags: ["直播电商", "数字人", "Agent", "合规治理", "强相关"]

papers.rationale_zh: 与达人直播、数字人话术和合规脚本治理直接相关，方法新意与工程价值都很强；扣分主要因为公开实验透明度和可复现性不足。
papers.rationale_en: 与达人直播、数字人话术和合规脚本治理直接相关，方法新意与工程价值都很强；扣分主要因为公开实验透明度和可复现性不足。
papers.method_overview_zh: TaoLive 关注直播电商数字人 agent 在低时延下如何持续适配不断变化的脚本、工具与合规规则。论文提出 Harness-Aware Training，将 Skill 文本、Tool schema、Prompt 结构与 Hook 约束都视为会演化的执行环境，并在训练中显式采样这些 Harness 状态。核心训练分为 HSA-SFT、General OPD 与 HSA-RL 三段：先让模型在扰动后的 Harness 上学习语义稳健性，再用通用 on-policy distillation 拉回泛化能力，最后在 live-room simulator 中做 agentic RL。整体目标不是让模型记住某个固定 prompt，而是读懂当前 Harness 所表达的业务规则。
papers.method_overview_en: TaoLive studies how a live-commerce digital-avatar agent can stay low-latency while adapting to constantly changing scripts, tools, and compliance rules. The paper introduces Harness-Aware Training, which treats Skill text, tool schemas, prompt structure, and hook constraints as an evolving execution environment and explicitly samples those harness states during training. Training is split into HSA-SFT, General OPD, and HSA-RL: first learn robustness under perturbed harness variants, then recover broad instruction-following with on-policy distillation, and finally optimize the full agent inside a live-room simulator. The goal is to understand the current harness semantics rather than memorize one fixed prompt layout.
papers.story_zh: 直播电商数字人既要低延迟答疑，又要不断追随新的营销策略与合规规则，但传统 SFT 容易把工具名和 prompt 模板记死。于是论文把执行环境本身做成可扰动训练对象，让模型在多种 Harness 变体中学习“读懂规则”，从而在业务策略持续更新时仍能稳定工作。
papers.story_en: Live-commerce avatars must answer quickly while continuously following new campaign and compliance rules, but standard SFT tends to memorize tool names and prompt templates. The paper therefore trains on many harness variants so the model learns to interpret the active rule system itself and stays robust as the business runtime evolves.
papers.innovation_zh: 真正有价值的创新点是把“业务规则演化”提升为训练分布的一等公民。很多直播数字人系统只会在 prompt / tool 改名后退化，而 TaoLive 通过 Harness-State Augmentation 让模型对 skill identifier、schema 字段名与 prompt 组织方式不敏感，更像在学协议语义而非字符串模板。它同时兼顾了 compact model 的低延迟要求与 evolving runtime 的稳定性，这点对达人直播脚本治理非常现实。局限在于实验高度依赖内部评测与私有 simulator，公开可复现度一般。
papers.innovation_en: The key contribution is turning business-rule evolution into a first-class training distribution. Instead of overfitting to a single prompt or tool schema, the model is exposed to renamed skills, schema changes, and prompt restructurings, so it learns protocol semantics rather than string templates. This is particularly meaningful for live-commerce agents, where compact models are required for latency but brittle prompt dependence is unacceptable. The main weakness is limited public reproducibility because the simulator and much of the evaluation remain internal.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在四套评测上，HAT 训练后的 35B 模型 Live-Stream QA 平均分 94.8，高于 base 80.3 和文中 strongest general LLM 的 93.0；Harness-Variant QA 达到 94.6；IFEval 维持在 83.5，避免了 Fixed-Harness SFT 常见的 7.7 分泛化下降。线上部署侧，单张 H20 GPU 条件下完整 agent P50 延迟 3.407 秒，P95 8.114 秒。
papers.key_metrics_en: Across four evaluation sets, the HAT-trained 35B model reaches 94.8 on Live-Stream QA versus 80.3 for the base model and 93.0 for the strongest general LLM reported in the paper. Harness-Variant QA reaches 94.6, while IFEval remains at 83.5, avoiding the 7.7-point generalization drop seen after fixed-harness SFT. In deployment, the complete agent achieves 3.407 s P50 and 8.114 s P95 latency on a single H20 GPU.

papers.title: Sequential Multimodal Evidence Optimization for Product Media Ranking in E-Commerce
papers.authors: ["Prasenjit Dey", "Frank McIntyre", "Arnab Sinha"]

papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 26, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 21, "total": 84, "rationale_zh": "直接作用于商品图文/视频分发质量与转化链路，业务相关性很高；扣分在于公开实验与代码透明度不足。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 直接作用于商品图文/视频分发质量与转化链路，业务相关性很高；扣分在于公开实验与代码透明度不足。
papers.rationale_en: 直接作用于商品图文/视频分发质量与转化链路，业务相关性很高；扣分在于公开实验与代码透明度不足。
papers.method_overview_zh: SMEO 把商品图片、视频和 3D 视图看成一个协同提供证据的序列，而不是互相独立的点击位。第一阶段用 trajectory utility model 从用户已浏览的媒体前缀估计“离购买决策还有多远”，并显式修正 position bias 与 variable-depth imbalance。第二阶段训练一个自回归排序策略，用 survival-weighted reward-to-go 优先把最有决策价值的信息排在前面，让用户用更少的滑动成本看到关键证据。整个框架把效用学习和策略优化解耦，因此适合离线日志训练与后验归因分析。
papers.method_overview_en: SMEO treats product images, videos, and 3D assets as a cooperative evidence sequence rather than independent engagement slots. The first stage learns a trajectory utility model that estimates how much decision-relevant evidence has already been delivered by a consumed media prefix while correcting for position bias and variable browse depth. The second stage trains an autoregressive ranking policy with a survival-weighted reward-to-go so that the most decision-relevant media is surfaced earlier. Because utility learning is decoupled from policy optimization, the framework is well suited to offline logs and post-hoc attribution.
papers.story_zh: 现有商品媒体排序往往把图片和视频当作独立曝光单元，只优化短期点击或停留，结果是关键证据可能被排得太靠后。论文因此改为学习“证据序列对购买决策的累积效用”，并让排序策略优先呈现更能推动决策的信息，以更低浏览成本完成转化。
papers.story_en: Product-media rankers usually treat images and videos as independent slots and optimize shallow proxies such as clicks or dwell. SMEO instead learns the cumulative utility of media prefixes and ranks assets so that the user sees the most decision-relevant evidence earlier, reducing browse effort while improving conversion.
papers.innovation_zh: 它最值得关注的点是把详情页媒体排序从 engagement proxy 改成 purchase-evidence sequencing。论文不只优化 CTR，而是显式建模“前缀已经给了用户多少决策信息”，这比单个媒体质量打分更贴近内容生态里的真实购买链路。survival-weighted reward-to-go 也很合理，因为它考虑了用户可能提前流失这一现实约束。局限在于实验主要基于内部日志和离线 OPE，公开 benchmark 不足。
papers.innovation_en: The main novelty is reframing product-media ranking from engagement optimization into purchase-evidence sequencing. Instead of scoring media items independently, the paper models how much cumulative decision support a prefix provides, which is much closer to the real ecommerce purchase funnel. The survival-weighted reward design is also compelling because it explicitly accounts for user drop-off. The main drawback is that most evidence comes from internal logs and offline policy evaluation rather than public benchmarks.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在大规模电商会话的 doubly robust off-policy evaluation 下，SMEO 相比现有基线将估计转化率提升 5.5%，并让用户达到购买决策所需的滑动次数减少 15%。论文同时报告其两阶段设计在稳定性和 attribution 解释性上优于直接端到端排序。
papers.key_metrics_en: Under doubly robust off-policy evaluation on large-scale ecommerce sessions, SMEO improves estimated conversion by 5.5% over existing baselines and reduces the number of swipes needed to reach a purchase decision by 15%. The paper also reports better training stability and more interpretable media attribution than direct end-to-end ranking alternatives.

papers.title: TransAnyText: Translating Arbitrary Text in E-commerce Images via Structured Visual Generation
papers.authors: ["Xiaoan Liu", "Lichen Ma", "Zipeng Guo", "Yu He", "Xiaoyan Su", "Shaojie Guo", "Hao Yang", "Jingling Fu", "Xiaolong Fu", "Zhen Chen", "Yu Guo", "Fei Wang", "Xinyi Liu", "Yongjun Zhang", "Ke Zhang", "Junshi Huang"]
papers.tags: ["跨境电商", "图像翻译", "海报本地化", "多模态生成", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 24, "results": 11, "exp_quality": 10, "efficiency": 6, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 24, "total": 79, "rationale_zh": "业务相关性极强，但方法链路很重、公开可验证结果有限，暂不进入今日复现阈值。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 业务相关性极强，但方法链路很重、公开可验证结果有限，暂不进入今日复现阈值。
papers.rationale_en: 业务相关性极强，但方法链路很重、公开可验证结果有限，暂不进入今日复现阈值。
papers.method_overview_zh: TransAnyText 面向跨境电商图片本地化，把“图内文字翻译”重写成“从源图像和目标语言生成可渲染 HTML patch”。系统把语义生成和像素渲染解耦：VLM 负责视觉理解、跨语种翻译与结构化视觉代码生成，diffusion 模型负责背景补全与像素级修饰，最终用确定性 renderer 合成目标图。训练分为 SFT、PWSD 与 RLVR 三阶段，分别学习 image-to-code 映射、强化布局/风格 token，以及用可验证奖励对齐空间与翻译质量。论文同时构建了多语言的 TransAnyDataset / TransAnyBench。
papers.method_overview_en: TransAnyText targets cross-border ecommerce image localization by reformulating in-image translation as generating renderable HTML patches from a source image and a target language. The system decouples semantic generation from pixel rendering: a VLM handles visual understanding, cross-lingual translation, and structured visual-code generation, while a diffusion model performs background inpainting and pixel refinement before deterministic rendering synthesizes the final image. Training proceeds through SFT, PWSD, and RLVR to learn image-to-code mapping, improve layout/style token learning, and align task-level translation quality with verifiable rewards. The paper also introduces multilingual TransAnyDataset and TransAnyBench.
papers.story_zh: 跨境电商要频繁把商品图、banner 和详情页本地化，但级联式图文翻译会积累 OCR / inpaint / render 误差，端到端像素编辑又容易文字幻觉且难编辑。因此论文引入结构化视觉代码，把翻译和渲染拆开，既保证文本准确又保留后续编辑能力。
papers.story_en: Cross-border ecommerce repeatedly needs localized product images and banners, but cascaded in-image translation accumulates OCR, inpainting, and rendering errors, while end-to-end pixel editing often hallucinates text and is hard to edit later. TransAnyText therefore inserts a structured visual-code layer between translation and rendering so that localization remains both accurate and editable.
papers.innovation_zh: 中间视觉代码的设计非常适合电商设计生产链，因为它兼顾可控性、可编辑性与多语言扩展。相比 OCR-翻译-贴字的级联路线，它减少误差传播；相比端到端像素编辑，它更容易约束版式与品牌视觉一致性。问题在于整套系统依赖高质量 renderer、diffusion 和多语言数据协同，工程复杂度较高。
papers.innovation_en: The structured visual-code intermediate is especially attractive for ecommerce content pipelines because it balances controllability, editability, and multilingual scalability. Compared with OCR-translate-render cascades, it reduces error accumulation; compared with end-to-end pixel editing, it offers tighter control over layout and brand-faithful typography. The main trade-off is substantial system complexity because the method depends on a strong renderer, a diffusion module, and large multilingual training data.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文报告其在翻译保真、视觉一致性与可编辑性上均优于多种 cascaded pipeline、开源端到端模型和若干 closed-source image editing baselines；但公开摘要未给出足够完整的统一数值表，且复现实验主要依托作者自建 benchmark。
papers.key_metrics_en: The paper reports stronger translation fidelity, visual consistency, and editability than cascaded pipelines, open end-to-end alternatives, and several closed-source image-editing baselines. However, the public abstract does not expose a fully unified numeric table, and the evaluation relies heavily on the authors' own benchmark.

papers.title: PosterText: Towards Unified Visual Text Generation and Editing for E-commerce Poster
papers.authors: ["Xiaoan Liu", "Lichen Ma", "Zipeng Guo", "Yu He", "Xiaoyan Su", "Shaojie Guo", "Jingling Fu", "Xiaolong Fu", "Hao Yang", "Tongxuan Liu", "Yu Guo", "Fei Wang", "Xinyi Liu", "Yongjun Zhang", "Junshi Huang"]
