papers.method_overview_zh: PosterText 把电商海报自动化从“整图生成”推进到“文字 patch 级生成与编辑”。论文定义了四类统一操作：海报生成、patch 增加、patch 删除和 patch 修改，并允许参考 patch 做风格控制。模型采用四阶段课程学习：文字渲染预训练、指令跟随训练、基于偏好的 RL 对齐，以及空间引导自蒸馏，用来提升 mask-free 执行稳定性。论文还构建了 PosterText-320K 数据集和配套 benchmark。
papers.method_overview_en: PosterText pushes ecommerce poster automation from whole-image generation toward patch-level visual text generation and editing. The paper unifies four operations—poster generation, patch addition, patch deletion, and patch modification—and optionally supports style control through reference patches. Training follows a four-stage curriculum: text-rendering pretraining, instruction-following, preference-aligned RL, and spatial-guidance self-distillation to improve mask-free execution reliability. The work is supported by the large PosterText-320K dataset and a dedicated benchmark.
papers.story_zh: 电商海报生产并不只是从零生成，更常见的是在现有海报上替换价格、标题和卖点。既有方法要么流程割裂、局部编辑困难，要么只能做整图生成，于是论文把文字块视为原子单元，统一支持生成与局部改写，提升电商设计自动化的实用性。
papers.story_en: Ecommerce poster production is rarely about creating everything from scratch; more often it is about replacing prices, campaign copy, or selling points on an existing design. Prior methods either split the workflow into brittle stages or focus on full-image generation only, so PosterText treats text patches as atomic visual units and unifies generation with localized editing.
papers.innovation_zh: 最大亮点是把实用设计流程抽象成 patch-level 原子编辑，而不是单纯做文生图。这个抽象更贴近商家与达人真实需求：替换价格、活动语、利益点，而不是整张重画。方法在电商内容治理里也很有意义，因为违规词替换、视觉风格统一与快速素材修订都能落到同一接口。局限在于缺少公开轻量实现，训练成本偏高。
papers.innovation_en: Its most valuable idea is abstracting practical design workflows into patch-level atomic editing instead of treating the task as pure text-to-image generation. That is much closer to what merchants and creators actually need: change a price tag, rewrite a slogan, or replace a promotional highlight without redrawing the entire poster. This abstraction is also meaningful for governance because risky or outdated copy can be replaced through the same unified interface. The main drawback is high training complexity and the lack of a lightweight public implementation.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文摘要强调其在文本渲染准确率、视觉质量和编辑灵活性上相对既有开闭源基线具有竞争力，并构建 320K 级 patch 标注数据；但公开摘要没有完整披露统一的核心数值表，因此外部量化对比仍需以原文图表为准。
papers.key_metrics_en: The abstract states that PosterText is competitive against existing open and closed baselines in text-rendering accuracy, visual quality, and editing flexibility, and that it is trained with a 320K-scale patch-annotated dataset. However, the public summary does not expose a unified numeric table, so external quantitative comparison still depends on the full paper figures.

papers.title: Learning from Online User Feedback for Shopping Agents
papers.authors: ["Haobo Zhang", "Kelong Mao", "Sulong Xu", "Simiu Gu", "Zhicheng Dou"]
papers.tags: ["购物Agent", "在线反馈", "偏好学习", "导购治理", "中相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 22, "results": 10, "exp_quality": 10, "efficiency": 7, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 23, "total": 76, "rationale_zh": "方向非常重要，但公开量化与可复现实验信息不足，因此先作为重点跟踪论文保留。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 方向非常重要，但公开量化与可复现实验信息不足，因此先作为重点跟踪论文保留。
papers.rationale_en: 方向非常重要，但公开量化与可复现实验信息不足，因此先作为重点跟踪论文保留。
papers.method_overview_zh: LOFA 研究购物 agent 如何直接从真实在线交互日志中学习，而不是只依赖人工标注或离线点击。框架把可验证购买结果用于强化学习，同时引入 feedback-aware on-policy distillation，从用户在对话中的自然反馈里提取稠密 token 级监督。这样一来，显式购买信号负责长期目标，诸如“太贵了”“我要今天送达”这类用户指令则负责即时纠偏。论文强调在线反馈既异构又稀疏，因此需要自动识别哪些反馈能转成稳定监督。
papers.method_overview_en: LOFA studies how shopping agents can learn directly from real online interaction logs instead of relying only on manual labels or offline clicks. The framework uses verifiable purchase outcomes for reinforcement learning and adds feedback-aware on-policy distillation to convert natural user feedback inside conversations into dense token-level supervision. Purchase outcomes provide long-horizon signals, while utterances such as 'too expensive' or 'need delivery today' act as immediate corrective guidance. The paper stresses that online feedback is heterogeneous and sparse, so the main challenge is automatically identifying which feedback should become reliable supervision.
papers.story_zh: 购物 agent 产生海量真实对话，但最终购买信号稀疏且有延迟，导致系统难以及时从‘这不是我想要的’类反馈中学习。LOFA 因此把用户在线纠偏语句抽成密集监督，并与可验证购买结果结合，让 agent 从真实交互中持续改善导购质量。
papers.story_en: Shopping agents generate massive real conversations, but final purchase signals are sparse and delayed, so systems learn too slowly from statements like 'this is not what I want'. LOFA therefore converts online corrective feedback into dense supervision and combines it with verifiable outcomes so the agent can improve from real user interactions.
papers.innovation_zh: 它的价值在于把真实导购会话中的纠偏语句变成可学习信号，而不是只看最终是否购买。对于电商内容生态和导购治理，这意味着模型能更快识别不合需求、误导或低质量推荐并自我修正。缺点是方法高度依赖平台内部真实日志，且公开实验细节有限。
papers.innovation_en: Its main value is turning real conversational corrections into learnable supervision rather than waiting for a final purchase label. For ecommerce content ecosystems and shopping-assistant governance, this means the model can more quickly identify unsuitable or misleading recommendations and self-correct. The downside is that the method depends heavily on proprietary platform logs and the public experimental evidence is limited.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文摘要称在真实电商日志上，LOFA 相比强基线稳定提升推荐质量、response helpfulness 和 user-satisfaction alignment；但公开摘要未披露完整 benchmark 数值表与误差区间。
papers.key_metrics_en: The abstract reports consistent gains over strong baselines on recommendation quality, response helpfulness, and user-satisfaction alignment using real ecommerce logs, but it does not expose a full public benchmark table or uncertainty intervals.

papers.title: Shopping Reasoning Bench: An Expert-Authored Benchmark for Multi-Turn Conversational Shopping Assistants
papers.authors: ["Shuxian Fan", "Danwen Han", "Stephen Yang", "Anu Nagarajan", "Nikhil Kandpal", "Amit Singh", "Nikita Bhutani", "Aakanksha Chowdhery"]
papers.tags: ["评测基准", "购物推理", "多轮对话", "导购质量", "中相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 20, "results": 12, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 17, "total": 74, "rationale_zh": "benchmark 方法学价值高，但它更偏评测基础设施而非直接提升内容理解/治理模型，因此相关性和创新性得分略低。"}
papers.rationale_zh: benchmark 方法学价值高，但它更偏评测基础设施而非直接提升内容理解/治理模型，因此相关性和创新性得分略低。
papers.rationale_en: benchmark 方法学价值高，但它更偏评测基础设施而非直接提升内容理解/治理模型，因此相关性和创新性得分略低。
papers.method_overview_zh: Shopping Reasoning Bench 不是再造一个导购 agent，而是建立多轮购物推理的系统性评测基准。数据包含 525 个专家撰写任务，其中单轮 232 个、多轮 293 个，并配有 10,863 条 importance-weighted rubrics，从必要条件、加分条件到偏好权衡都可细粒度打分。论文的关键洞见是：购物对话不是传统 QA，也不是单一对错判断，而是带有强主观偏好、预算和 trade-off 的实践推理。作者因此把评测设计成 criterion-level review，而不是只看最终命中某个商品。
papers.method_overview_en: Shopping Reasoning Bench does not propose another shopping agent; instead, it builds a systematic benchmark for multi-turn shopping reasoning. The dataset contains 525 expert-authored missions—232 single-turn and 293 multi-turn—paired with 10,863 importance-weighted rubrics that score required criteria, nice-to-have behavior, and nuanced preference trade-offs. The paper's core insight is that shopping dialogue is not standard factual QA and cannot be reduced to a single correct item, because subjective preferences, budget constraints, and trade-offs matter throughout the conversation. Evaluation is therefore done at the criterion level rather than only by final-item hits.
papers.story_zh: 现有购物 assistant 已服务海量用户，但行业缺乏衡量‘是否像一个懂商品又懂需求的导购’的统一标准。于是作者邀请零售专家把真实购物任务拆成细粒度判断标准，用 rubric 体系评估模型在多轮约束、偏好和解释上的真实推理质量。
papers.story_en: Shopping assistants already serve huge user bases, yet the field lacks a standard way to judge whether a system behaves like a knowledgeable human shopping advisor. The authors therefore work with retail experts to decompose real shopping tasks into fine-grained rubrics and use them to measure the true reasoning quality of multi-turn assistant responses.
papers.innovation_zh: 它最大的贡献是给电商导购质量建立了可操作的‘专家评审标尺’。和 WebShop 这类环境相比，Shopping Reasoning Bench 更关注解释质量、约束遵循与多轮推理稳定性，对平台侧治理导购回答质量非常有帮助。它不是新模型，因此模型创新分不会太高，但作为 benchmark 的方法学价值很强。
papers.innovation_en: Its main contribution is giving ecommerce shopping assistants an operational expert-review yardstick. Compared with environments such as WebShop, the benchmark focuses more on explanation quality, constraint following, and stability over multi-turn reasoning, which is very useful for governing assistant quality on real platforms. It is not a new model, so architectural novelty is limited, but its methodological value as an evaluation framework is strong.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 基准包含 525 个 mission 与 10,863 条专家 rubric。论文指出，在 multi-turn mission 上，各主流模型在 optional above-and-beyond criteria 上通常比 required criteria 低 13–29 分，且随着对话推进整体表现还会再下降 4–18 分，说明当前系统离专家级导购仍有明显差距。
papers.key_metrics_en: The benchmark contains 525 missions and 10,863 expert rubrics. The paper reports that on multi-turn missions, leading models score 13–29 points lower on optional above-and-beyond criteria than on required criteria, and overall performance further degrades by 4–18 points as conversations progress, showing a substantial gap from expert-level shopping assistance.

papers.title: AdsWorldEngine: A Self-Evolving Conversational Advertising Agent through Orchestrator and Tool Coevolution
papers.authors: ["Simiao Zuo", "Chenhui Xu", "Yimeng Jia", "Qiang Lou", "Jian Jiao", "Denis Charles"]
papers.tags: ["广告生态", "对话式广告", "Agent", "电商商业化", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 27, "results": 14, "exp_quality": 11, "efficiency": 7, "generalization": 3, "relevance": 24, "total": 86, "rationale_zh": "与电商商业化、广告治理和对话式智能体高度相关，且有真实线上收益；缺点是闭源工具较多、学术可复现性一般，但仍属于今日最值得跟进的高价值论文。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 与电商商业化、广告治理和对话式智能体高度相关，且有真实线上收益；缺点是闭源工具较多、学术可复现性一般，但仍属于今日最值得跟进的高价值论文。
papers.rationale_en: 与电商商业化、广告治理和对话式智能体高度相关，且有真实线上收益；缺点是闭源工具较多、学术可复现性一般，但仍属于今日最值得跟进的高价值论文。
papers.method_overview_zh: AdsWorldEngine 将对话广告系统建模成完整 agentic serving stack，而不是只优化单个召回或排序模块。在线侧由 Opportunity Gate 判断当前轮是否应触发广告，再由 Orchestrator 综合用户 query、对话历史与 assistant response 生成商业意图、调用检索/相关性/排序工具并选出 top-3 ad slate。离线侧引入 Evaluator 从 relevance、diversity 等维度打分，并把高低 reward rollout 变成工具训练偏好对，形成 actor-tool coevolution 闭环。针对广告触发误伤代价高的问题，论文又提出 label-grounded judgment modeling 和 cost-sensitive GRPO，显式压低 false positive。
papers.method_overview_en: AdsWorldEngine treats conversational advertising as a full agentic serving system instead of a single retrieval or ranking module. An Opportunity Gate first decides whether an ad opportunity exists in the current turn, and an Orchestrator then turns the query, dialogue history, and assistant response into a commercial intent, calls retrieval and ranking tools, and selects a top-3 ad slate. An Evaluator scores outputs on relevance and diversity, while high- and low-reward rollouts are converted into preference data for tool refinement, creating actor-tool coevolution. The paper also adds label-grounded judgment models and cost-sensitive GRPO to suppress costly false-positive triggers.
papers.story_zh: 已有对话广告系统往往只优化触发、召回或排序中的单一环节，且“该不该投”“投什么广告”存在明显主观性与高误伤成本，因此论文设计了 Gate + Orchestrator + Evaluator 的完整 agent 链路，并让 actor 与工具通过 reward-driven preference data 共进化，最终在保证相关性的同时显著提高商业化收益。
papers.story_en: Conversational ad systems usually optimize one stage at a time, but trigger decisions and ad relevance are subjective and have asymmetric business costs. AdsWorldEngine therefore builds a Gate + Orchestrator + Evaluator stack and lets the actor and tools improve each other through reward-derived preference data, which raises monetization without sacrificing relevance.
papers.innovation_zh: 与传统广告系统相比，这篇论文的创新点不在单个模型结构，而在把广告触发、工具调用、广告 slate 生成、评审与工具进化串成可自我强化的 agent 闭环。其 label-grounded judgment modeling 先锚定人工规范再训练 judge，避免 purely synthetic rationale 带来的判断漂移；cost-sensitive GRPO 也更贴合广告触发中“误投比漏投更糟”的业务代价。整体方案合理、工程味很强，弱点是较依赖私有流量与闭源工具，学术复现实验透明度有限。
papers.innovation_en: The novelty lies in co-evolving the orchestrator and the tools, rather than tuning only the actor. Label-grounded judgment modeling ties the judge to human annotation policy before synthetic traces are used, which is more reliable than free-form self-judging. Cost-sensitive GRPO is also well aligned with ad serving, where false triggers are more harmful than misses. The approach is highly practical, though limited by private infrastructure and closed online experiments.
papers.key_metrics_zh: Opportunity Gate 在 27K 过滤后标注对话上，相比 GPT-5 prompt baseline 保持 TPR 基本不变的同时将 FPR 进一步降低 39.07%，Balanced Accuracy 提升 2.51%。Conversation-to-ad relevance judge 相比 GPT-5 prompt 将 FPR 再降 12.71%，Balanced Accuracy 提升 7.51%。在线 20 天 A/B 中，系统带来 RPM +22%，Ads coverage +74%。
papers.key_metrics_en: On 27K filtered gate examples, the Opportunity Gate keeps TPR roughly unchanged while cutting FPR by 39.07% against a GPT-5 prompt baseline, lifting balanced accuracy by 2.51%. The conversation-to-ad judge further reduces FPR by 12.71% and improves balanced accuracy by 7.51%. In a 20-day online A/B test, the system reports +22% RPM and +74% ads coverage.

papers.title: MACS: A Hybrid Multi-Agent Framework for Reliable Conversational E-Commerce Recommendation
papers.authors: ["Juli Huang", "Hannah Clay", "Thomas Sarda", "Sajjad Beygi", "Negin Golrezaei", "Amin Saberi"]
papers.tags: ["电商", "对话式推荐", "多智能体", "约束治理", "强相关"]

papers.rationale_zh: 和电商内容生态主链路最贴近，硬约束执行与多轮可靠性对达人带货、导购助手、合规推荐都很关键；创新更偏系统工程，但业务落地价值非常高。
papers.rationale_en: 和电商内容生态主链路最贴近，硬约束执行与多轮可靠性对达人带货、导购助手、合规推荐都很关键；创新更偏系统工程，但业务落地价值非常高。
papers.method_overview_zh: MACS 面向固定商品目录、禁止 web search 的电商对话推荐场景，关注的是推荐可靠性而不是开放域闲聊能力。系统拆成 shopping agent 与 merchant agent：前者负责自然语言理解、偏好追问和回复生成，后者负责 SQL 检索、品牌过滤、硬约束执行、渐进式放宽与知识图谱查询。论文的关键设计是从架构层强制 catalog grounding，避免 LLM 直接凭语言先验幻觉商品属性。再配合 session-persistent slot dictionary，系统能稳定处理预算覆盖、品牌排除反转和跨轮引用。
papers.method_overview_en: MACS targets fixed-catalog conversational ecommerce recommendation where web search is disallowed and reliability matters more than open-domain fluency. The framework splits the system into a shopping agent for dialogue understanding and response generation, and a merchant agent for SQL retrieval, hard-constraint execution, brand filtering, and controlled relaxation. Its key contribution is architecture-level catalog grounding so the LLM never directly invents product facts. A session-persistent slot dictionary further stabilizes multi-turn preferences, reversals, and references.
papers.story_zh: 纯 LLM 电商对话推荐容易忘记前文约束、幻觉商品属性、在多轮对话中逐渐偏航，因此论文先把自然语言交互和商家目录工具解耦，再用会话级 slot 记忆承接预算、品牌和属性偏好，最后用 SQL 与知识图谱工具保证每一步推荐都严格落在真实 catalog 内。
papers.story_en: Prompt-only ecommerce recommenders tend to forget previous constraints, hallucinate catalog attributes, and drift across turns. MACS addresses this by separating language interaction from merchant tools, keeping persistent slots for budget and brand constraints, and grounding every recommendation in SQL and knowledge-graph operations over the real catalog.
papers.innovation_zh: 与常见 prompt-based conversational recommender 相比，MACS 的主要创新在于把 correctness-critical 的目录检索与硬约束执行从生成式模块中剥离出来，改用确定性工具链路承接。它并不是提出全新的学习算法，而是用双 agent、SQL grounding 和会话级 slot memory 形成更可靠的系统范式。方法合理、落地性很高，但实验主要集中在消费电子目录，多品类泛化仍有待验证。
papers.innovation_en: Instead of introducing a new learning objective, MACS isolates correctness-critical catalog reasoning from the generative module and routes it through deterministic tools. The combination of dual agents, SQL grounding, and session-level slot memory is a strong systems contribution for catalog recommendation. It is highly practical, though current validation is concentrated in a consumer-electronics domain.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 140 条单轮 benchmark 上，MACS 的 pass rate 达到 87.1%，显著高于 GPT+Catalog 的 72.1% 和 Gemini+Catalog 的 68.6%；brand compliance 达到 1.000，filter compliance 达到 0.970。多轮 benchmark 中，MACS 的 Macro Pass@5 为 72%，高于 GPT+Catalog 的 56% 和 Gemini+Catalog 的 52%；排除反转与约束累积场景均能做到 100% 正确处理。缓存命中时 SQL 搜索延迟可降到 36ms。
papers.key_metrics_en: On a 140-query single-turn benchmark, MACS reaches an 87.1% pass rate versus 72.1% for GPT+Catalog and 68.6% for Gemini+Catalog, with brand compliance at 1.000 and filter compliance at 0.970. On the multi-turn benchmark, Macro Pass@5 is 72% versus 56% and 52% for the two baselines. Exclusion reversal and constraint accumulation are both handled correctly in 100% of the evaluated scenarios. Cached SQL latency drops to 36 ms.

papers.title: Content Depth Matters in Short-Video Recommendation: Rethinking the Attention Economy
papers.authors: ["Liwei Deng", "Jing Jiang", "Zhiwei Li", "Yang Wang", "Guodong Long"]
papers.affiliations: ["Australian Artificial Intelligence Institute, University of Technology Sydney", "Department of Health, Disability and Ageing"]
papers.tags: ["短视频", "内容生态", "推荐评测", "内容理解", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 25, "results": 12, "exp_quality": 14, "efficiency": 7, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 20, "total": 82, "rationale_zh": "虽然不是直接提效模型，但它几乎正中内容生态健康度评估需求，对短视频与达人治理都很有启发；加上代码与数据完整公开，值得高优先级收录。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 虽然不是直接提效模型，但它几乎正中内容生态健康度评估需求，对短视频与达人治理都很有启发；加上代码与数据完整公开，值得高优先级收录。
papers.rationale_en: 虽然不是直接提效模型，但它几乎正中内容生态健康度评估需求，对短视频与达人治理都很有启发；加上代码与数据完整公开，值得高优先级收录。
papers.method_overview_zh: 这篇论文重新审视短视频推荐的目标函数，指出现有系统只优化 engagement，却几乎没有刻画内容是否促进理解、分析与反思。作者提出 Content Depth Score（CDS）和列表级 LCDS，用基于认知心理学的 7 级 rubric 衡量短视频内容深度。基于公开 ShortVideo 数据集，论文构建了包含 150K 视频 CDS 标注、约 1M 交互和 10K 用户的 SCOPE-Bench。随后对 13 个代表性推荐系统做系统评测，发现它们在内容深度上普遍只比随机推荐略强。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper argues that short-video recommendation is optimized almost entirely for engagement while ignoring whether content stimulates understanding, analysis, and reflection. It introduces Content Depth Score (CDS) and list-level LCDS, a seven-level rubric grounded in cognitive psychology, to measure content depth. The authors build SCOPE-Bench with CDS annotations for 150K videos and about 1M interactions from 10K users. Evaluations of 13 recommendation models show that most systems remain close to random selection on content depth.
papers.story_zh: 短视频平台长期围绕点击与停留时长竞争，导致系统偏好浅刺激内容，却缺少衡量内容深度与长期价值的工具。因此论文先定义内容深度指标，再构建 SCOPE-Bench 对主流推荐器进行统一测量，最终证明 engagement 与 content depth 显著脱钩。
papers.story_en: Short-video platforms have spent years optimizing clicks and watch time, which favors shallow attention-grabbing content while offering no direct way to quantify cognitive depth. The paper therefore defines a content-depth metric, builds SCOPE-Bench, and shows that engagement-optimized recommenders are largely decoupled from content-depth quality.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新不在于提出新推荐器，而在于提出新的评价轴：内容深度。相比多样性、覆盖率、新颖性等经典 beyond-accuracy 指标，CDS 直接衡量内容是否带来更高层次的认知加工，对内容生态治理与优质达人扶持更有解释力。方法设计上先建立认知理论驱动的 rubric，再选择与人工标注最一致的 LLM 作为 evaluator，整体比泛化的 LLM-as-a-judge 更规范。
papers.innovation_en: The contribution is a new evaluation axis rather than a new recommender. Compared with standard beyond-accuracy metrics such as diversity or novelty, CDS directly measures whether content offers deeper cognitive value, which is highly relevant to healthy content ecosystems and creator-quality incentives. The evaluation protocol is also more disciplined than generic LLM-as-a-judge setups because it starts from a theory-driven rubric and then selects the most human-aligned evaluator.
papers.key_metrics_zh: SCOPE-Bench 覆盖 150K 视频 CDS 标注、约 1M 交互与 10K 用户。人工标注 exact agreement 为 80.53%，within-1 agreement 为 97.94%。在 6 个候选 LLM evaluator 中，Qwen3.7-Max 与人工最一致，Spearman 达到 0.7177。对 13 个推荐模型的评测显示，最佳内容深度表现仍只略高于随机基线，例如 ShortVideo-Full 上 FITMM 的 A-LCDS / E-LCDS 为 7.59 / 7.88，而随机基线已为 6.59 / 6.59。
papers.key_metrics_en: SCOPE-Bench contains CDS annotations for 150K videos, roughly 1M interactions, and 10K users. Human annotation exact agreement is 80.53% and within-1 agreement is 97.94%. Among six evaluator candidates, Qwen3.7-Max best matches humans with a Spearman correlation of 0.7177. Across 13 recommenders, the best content-depth scores are still only slightly above random, for example FITMM reaches 7.59 / 7.88 A-LCDS / E-LCDS on ShortVideo-Full while the random baseline is already 6.59 / 6.59.

papers.title: HAM-RAG: Hierarchy-Aware Multimodal RAG for Structure-Faithful Interleaved Generation
papers.authors: ["Yin Li", "Ziyang Hu", "Zhiyu Guo", "Xiangyu Liu", "Wenbin Li", "Boo-Ho Yang", "Rav Lawana", "Ziyue Li", "Wei Zeng", "Fugee Tsung"]
papers.tags: ["多模态 RAG", "图文一致性", "内容理解", "结构化文档", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 23, "results": 12, "exp_quality": 11, "efficiency": 7, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 23, "total": 80, "rationale_zh": "对图文内容理解、详情页合规核验和结构化知识问答都很有迁移价值，实验提升明确；虽然偏结构工程，但业务相关性与可落地性都较强。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 对图文内容理解、详情页合规核验和结构化知识问答都很有迁移价值，实验提升明确；虽然偏结构工程，但业务相关性与可落地性都较强。
papers.rationale_en: 对图文内容理解、详情页合规核验和结构化知识问答都很有迁移价值，实验提升明确；虽然偏结构工程，但业务相关性与可落地性都较强。
papers.method_overview_zh: HAM-RAG 针对科学论文、说明书、网页和攻略等结构化多模态文档，解决现有 multimodal RAG 把文档拍平后导致图文局部对齐变差的问题。方法先把文档解析成层级树，为文本和图片证据补上 heading path、ancestor context、local relation 与 source position 等结构信号。图片侧还加入 context-aware visual description，避免图片只按全局语义被召回。最后系统将排序后的文本和图片证据按结构拼装进 prompt，实现更忠于原文组织方式的 interleaved generation。
papers.method_overview_en: HAM-RAG targets structured multimodal documents such as papers, manuals, walkthroughs, and webpages, where flattening the document destroys local text-image alignment. The method parses each document into a hierarchy tree and augments every text or image evidence unit with heading paths, ancestor context, local relations, and source positions. Image retrieval is further improved with context-aware visual descriptions instead of global semantics alone. The ranked evidence is then assembled into a hierarchy-aware prompt for structure-faithful interleaved generation.
papers.story_zh: 结构化图文文档并不是平铺的文字块和图片块，现有 RAG 若忽略章节、步骤和局部图文关系，就会出现“图看起来相关但放错位置”的问题。因此 HAM-RAG 显式建模层级结构与局部图文上下文，再让生成阶段按原始结构组织证据，最终得到更可信的 interleaved answer。
papers.story_en: Structured multimodal documents are not flat bags of text and images. Once hierarchy and local adjacency are lost, RAG systems may retrieve plausible images but place them in the wrong local context. HAM-RAG models hierarchy and local image-text context explicitly so that generation preserves the original document structure more faithfully.
papers.innovation_zh: 与一般多模态 RAG 只强调召回相关内容不同，HAM-RAG 把文档层级与局部图文邻接关系提升为一等公民，核心贡献是“找对图”之外还要“把图放在对的句子旁边”。论文还构建 HAM-Bench，专门测局部图文对齐和结构忠实性，这对商品详情、达人图文笔记、SOP 合规核验等业务场景很有价值。局限在于方法更偏结构增强工程而非全新模型范式，benchmark 也主要由作者自建。
papers.innovation_en: Unlike standard multimodal RAG systems that mainly optimize for semantic retrieval, HAM-RAG makes document hierarchy and local text-image placement first-class grounding signals. Its benchmark contribution is also meaningful because HAM-Bench explicitly measures local alignment and structural faithfulness. The method is highly relevant to product pages, creator notes, and SOP-like content, although it is more of a strong structure-aware engineering design than a fundamentally new model family.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 HAM-Bench 上，跨多个 backbone 的主多模态平均分从 54.68 提升到 64.12，相对提升 17.3%。Wukong 子集上的 Img-CBS 从 50.82 提升到 63.10，相对提升 24.2%。检索侧的 TCR@15 也在四个子集都更高，例如 arXiv 子集从 0.62 提升到 0.77。
papers.key_metrics_en: On HAM-Bench, the main multimodal average improves from 54.68 to 64.12 across matched backbones, a relative gain of 17.3%. On the Wukong subset, Img-CBS improves from 50.82 to 63.10, a 24.2% relative gain. Retrieval TCR@15 also rises across all four subsets, for example from 0.62 to 0.77 on the arXiv subset.

papers.title: EchoRec: Multi-Item Prediction-Empowered Generative Recommendation via Cycle-Consistent Preference Alignment
papers.authors: ["Haokai Ma", "Aoqi Hu", "Yueao Xing", "Ruobing Xie", "Yonghui Yang", "Teng Tu", "Lei Meng", "Tat-Seng Chua"]
papers.affiliations: ["National University of Singapore", "Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications", "Tencent", "Shandong University"]
papers.tags: ["推荐系统", "生成式推荐", "偏好建模", "电商近相关", "高热"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 26, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 14, "total": 79, "rationale_zh": "方法完成度很高，但更偏推荐算法前沿，而非直接指向电商内容治理或达人治理场景；因此保留为高热近相关论文，不进入今日复现阈值。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 方法完成度很高，但更偏推荐算法前沿，而非直接指向电商内容治理或达人治理场景；因此保留为高热近相关论文，不进入今日复现阈值。
papers.rationale_en: 方法完成度很高，但更偏推荐算法前沿，而非直接指向电商内容治理或达人治理场景；因此保留为高热近相关论文，不进入今日复现阈值。
papers.method_overview_zh: EchoRec 关注生成式推荐里的 Multi-Token Prediction，不再只把 MTP 当作提速技巧，而是把未来行为视作稠密监督。论文先分析证明未来行为对当前行为存在 semantic echo，但会随 horizon 增大而衰减。基于此提出 HPG（Horizon-aware Preference Generation）顺序建模多 horizon 偏好，再用 VHA（Verifiable Holistic-Preference Alignment）把多 horizon 表征聚合成 holistic preference，并用 cycle consistency 约束抑制伪对齐。辅助分支仅在训练时存在，推理时基本不增加线上开销。
papers.method_overview_en: EchoRec revisits multi-token prediction in generative recommendation and treats future behaviors as dense supervision instead of mere decoding acceleration. The paper first shows that future actions carry a semantic echo of the current one, although the signal decays across horizons. It then introduces Horizon-aware Preference Generation (HPG) to model ordered multi-horizon supervision and Verifiable Holistic-Preference Alignment (VHA) to aggregate these signals into a holistic preference under cycle-consistent constraints. The auxiliary branches exist only during training, so inference cost stays almost unchanged.
papers.story_zh: 传统生成式推荐对未来行为监督利用不足，直接并行预测又容易把不同 horizon 的偏好做成同质化任务。因此论文设计顺序式多 horizon 偏好生成，并用可验证的 holistic preference 对齐让未来行为真正内化到主干表征中，最终在几乎不增加推理成本的前提下提高推荐质量。
papers.story_en: Future-behavior supervision in generative recommendation is usually underused, while naive parallel prediction homogenizes distinct horizons. EchoRec therefore models multi-horizon preferences sequentially and aligns them into a verifiable holistic preference so that future information is absorbed by the backbone with almost no serving overhead.
papers.innovation_zh: 与已有将 MTP 直接平移到推荐的工作相比，EchoRec 的关键点在于把未来行为建模为有序依赖监督，而不是并行附加预测头。VHA 又进一步解决“看起来对齐但其实信息没有被主干吸收”的问题，理论和工程闭环都比较完整。局限在于实验仍以离线推荐指标为主，缺少真实线上业务验证，因此对电商内容生态属于近相关而非直接强相关。
papers.innovation_en: Compared with prior recommendation methods that simply transplant MTP, EchoRec turns future interactions into ordered supervision rather than parallel heads. VHA is particularly valuable because it targets spurious one-way alignment and asks the model to truly absorb holistic preference. The paper is methodologically strong, but it remains an offline recommendation study rather than a direct ecommerce-governance result.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 Amazon Reviews'23 的 Game、Baby、Arts 三个数据集上，EchoRec 相比 RPG 在 HR@10 上分别提升 11.17%、17.68%、14.56%，NDCG@10 分别提升 11.35%、21.40%、18.29%。在 Baby 数据上，加入 20% 噪声交互后，相对 RPG 的 HR@10 提升可扩大到 54.89%。推理延迟和显存几乎不变。
papers.key_metrics_en: On the Game, Baby, and Arts subsets of Amazon Reviews'23, EchoRec improves HR@10 over RPG by 11.17%, 17.68%, and 14.56%, with NDCG@10 gains of 11.35%, 21.40%, and 18.29%. Under 20% injected interaction noise on Baby, the HR@10 gain over RPG expands to 54.89%. Inference latency and memory stay almost unchanged.

papers.title: Doomed to Re-Annotate, Forever: The ImageNet Story
papers.authors: ["Illia Volkov", "Nikita Kisel", "Tetiana Mishkina", "Klara Janouskova", "Jiri Matas"]
papers.tags: ["数据质量", "视觉标注", "评测治理", "弱相关高热"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 21, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 14, "efficiency": 6, "generalization": 5, "relevance": 18, "total": 77, "rationale_zh": "与电商内容治理不是直接业务同题，但对视觉审核、数据清洗和标注体系建设有很强启发，属于值得跟踪的数据质量基石类论文。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 与电商内容治理不是直接业务同题，但对视觉审核、数据清洗和标注体系建设有很强启发，属于值得跟踪的数据质量基石类论文。
papers.rationale_en: 与电商内容治理不是直接业务同题，但对视觉审核、数据清洗和标注体系建设有很强启发，属于值得跟踪的数据质量基石类论文。
papers.method_overview_zh: 这篇论文不是提出新识别模型，而是对 ImageNet-1k 验证集做了一次系统性重标注，产出 ReImageNet。相比以往局部纠错，作者同时做了多标签修正、目标框定位、类定义修订和属性标注，并采用持续迭代的标注—复核—修订流程。论文强调大规模 benchmark 的高质量标注不可能一轮完成，必须把发现问题与修订规则本身视作流程的一部分。它还进一步分析这些错误如何传染到多个 ImageNet 衍生 benchmark。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper does not propose a new classifier; instead, it systematically re-annotates the ImageNet-1k validation set into ReImageNet. Beyond local corrections, it adds multi-label fixes, bounding boxes, revised class definitions, and semantic attributes under an iterative annotate-review-revise loop. The authors argue that benchmark annotation at this scale cannot be completed in a single pass. They also trace how ImageNet errors propagate into multiple derivative benchmarks.
papers.story_zh: 经典 benchmark 长期被默认视作客观真值，但随着模型能力上升，原始标签错误、漏标和类定义问题会不断被暴露并反向影响模型排名。因此论文通过大规模重标注和误差传播分析说明：数据集治理不是一次性清洗，而是需要反复迭代的长期工程。
papers.story_en: Classic benchmarks are often treated as objective ground truth, but as models improve, hidden label errors, omissions, and class-definition issues become increasingly visible and can even alter model rankings. The paper shows through large-scale re-annotation that dataset governance is not a one-time cleanup but a recurring process.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点主要在数据与方法学层面，而非模型结构。作者把单标签 ImageNet 重新表述为多标签、定位与属性联合标注问题，并把 benchmark 可靠性本身变成研究对象。对于内容治理场景，这类工作提示我们：治理模型上限常常受制于底层标注质量，数据债务如果不清理，会在下游各类审核与分类任务中不断放大。
papers.innovation_en: The contribution is methodological rather than architectural. By reframing ImageNet as a multi-label, localized, and attribute-rich annotation problem, the paper turns benchmark reliability into a central research question. For governance tasks, the lesson is clear: model quality is often capped by annotation quality, and unresolved data debt propagates downstream.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文发现原始 ImageNet-1k 验证集约有 12% 标签错误，33.3% 图像其实是多标签，3.8% 图像不含任何目标类别。用 ReImageNet 重新评测后，监督模型 top-1 最高可提升约 1.2%，MLLM 则可提升 5–6%。论文还估计多个衍生 benchmark 的错误率是原始 ImageNet-1k 的 1.7–5.8 倍。
papers.key_metrics_en: The paper finds that about 12% of original ImageNet-1k validation labels are wrong, 33.3% of images are actually multi-label, and 3.8% contain no valid target class. ReImageNet evaluation lifts top-1 accuracy by up to about 1.2% for supervised models and by 5–6% for MLLMs. The authors further estimate that derivative benchmarks have error rates 1.7–5.8 times higher than the original validation set.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation

papers.rationale_zh: 论文很强、热度也高，但和电商内容生态&达人治理仅属弱相关技术储备，因此作为今日热点补充收录，不进入复现范围。
papers.rationale_en: 论文很强、热度也高，但和电商内容生态&达人治理仅属弱相关技术储备，因此作为今日热点补充收录，不进入复现范围。
papers.method_overview_zh: 这篇论文重新定义视觉 on-policy distillation 中 teacher 优势的来源：不是给教师更多特权信息，而是给学生更少信息。训练时教师看原图，学生看同图的强增强视图，teacher 使用 EMA 更新，并在 student 的 on-policy 轨迹上做 top-k generalized JSD 蒸馏。作者系统搜索增强类型与强度，发现最优并不是越强越好，而是适度削弱、但不破坏关键视觉证据。这样，自监督视角差异本身就变成了有效监督信号。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper rethinks where teacher advantage in visual on-policy distillation should come from: not from giving the teacher privileged labels, but from withholding information from the student. The teacher sees the original image while the student sees a strongly augmented view, and the teacher distribution is distilled onto on-policy student trajectories with a top-k generalized JSD loss. The authors systematically study augmentation types and strengths, showing that moderate information weakening is better than overly destructive corruption. In this way, self-supervised view asymmetry becomes the supervision signal.
papers.story_zh: 既有视觉蒸馏通常依赖更强教师或额外标注，但这些条件在现实里不一定可得，因此论文改为主动削弱学生输入，让教师天然拥有更完整视角，再通过 on-policy distillation 把这种视角差异转化为学习信号，从而在无特权监督下仍显著提升性能。
papers.story_en: Most prior visual distillation methods depend on stronger teachers or extra labels that are expensive or unavailable in practice. This paper instead reduces the student's visual information so the teacher naturally has a better view, then transfers that advantage through on-policy distillation, achieving strong gains without privileged supervision.
papers.innovation_zh: 相比依赖 GT ROI 或更强教师的视觉蒸馏方法，S2VOPD 用“student-side information withholding”构造 informative asymmetry，概念非常干净。它把多视图自监督思想嫁接到 token-level visual OPD，并通过大量消融证明增强设计本身决定蒸馏效果。与电商内容生态关系偏弱，但作为 VLM 蒸馏范式值得关注。
papers.innovation_en: S2VOPD is conceptually elegant because it creates informative asymmetry by reducing student information rather than by adding privileged supervision to the teacher. It merges multi-view self-supervision with token-level visual OPD and backs the idea with strong ablations on augmentation design. The paper is only weakly related to ecommerce governance, but it is a notable frontier result in VLM distillation.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 FineVision 12K 训练设置下，Qwen3.5-4B 的平均准确率从 70.68 提升到 77.44，超过若干更大开源模型，并高于 GPT-5.4 的 72.77。公平比较的 Vision-OPD-6K 设置下，S2VOPD 在 4B 模型上达到 75.33，高于带特权 ROI 的 Vision-OPD 的 74.77。论文汇总称 4B 模型在细粒度感知上提升 5.7%，数学视觉推理提升 3.7%。
papers.key_metrics_en: Under FineVision 12K training, Qwen3.5-4B improves average accuracy from 70.68 to 77.44, surpassing several much larger open models and also GPT-5.4 at 72.77. In the fair Vision-OPD-6K setup, S2VOPD reaches 75.33 on a 4B model versus 74.77 for privileged Vision-OPD. The paper also reports +5.7% on fine-grained perception and +3.7% on visual math reasoning for the 4B model.

papers.title: SimpleOPD: Simple Tokenizer-Agnostic On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.authors: ["Haonan He", "Haodi Lei", "Yun Luo", "Haoran Zhang", "Shunkai Zhang", "Yizhuo Li", "Shengji Tang", "Zhilin Wang", "Runzhe Zhan", "Lei Bai", "Ganqu Cui", "Fangchen Yu", "Yafu Li", "Peng Ye", "Ning Ding", "Yu Cheng"]

papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 27, "results": 14, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 5, "relevance": 3, "total": 70, "rationale_zh": "蒸馏方法本身很强，但与电商内容生态&达人治理只有较弱技术相关，因此作为今日高热 LLM 储备项收录，不进入复现与优先落地方向。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 蒸馏方法本身很强，但与电商内容生态&达人治理只有较弱技术相关，因此作为今日高热 LLM 储备项收录，不进入复现与优先落地方向。
papers.rationale_en: 蒸馏方法本身很强，但与电商内容生态&达人治理只有较弱技术相关，因此作为今日高热 LLM 储备项收录，不进入复现与优先落地方向。
papers.method_overview_zh: SimpleOPD 解决长上下文强推理教师蒸馏到短上下文学生时最棘手的实际问题：师生 tokenizer 不同、输出长度容易失控、训练容易不稳定。作者把 OPD 搬到 shared text space，学生先生成文本，教师再用自己的 tokenizer 在相同 surface string 上做部分对齐监督。为抑制超长输出，又加入 termination-token masking 和 student-reference KL，让学生不至于被教师拖向不稳定的长回答分布。整体方法很简洁，但直击真实蒸馏痛点。
papers.method_overview_en: SimpleOPD tackles a practical distillation problem: transferring a long-context reasoning teacher to a shorter-context student when the two models use different tokenizers. The method moves on-policy distillation into a shared text space, where the student generates surface text and the teacher evaluates the same string under its own tokenizer with partial alignment. To prevent output-length explosion, the paper adds termination-token masking and a student-reference KL term. The overall recipe is simple but directly addresses real training pain points.
papers.story_zh: 长上下文教师蒸馏给短上下文学生时，传统 OPD 往往假设词表兼容且输出长度可控，但现实里 tokenizer 差异与长链回答会让训练变得极不稳定。因此论文把监督对齐搬到共享文本表面，再用简洁的正则与终止 token 机制稳定训练过程，最终显著提升长链推理能力。
papers.story_en: Classical OPD often assumes compatible vocabularies and manageable output lengths, but real teacher-student pairs violate both assumptions. SimpleOPD therefore aligns supervision in shared surface text and adds lightweight regularization to stabilize training, leading to strong gains in long-form reasoning.
papers.innovation_zh: 与默认共享词表的 OPD 不同，SimpleOPD 承认 token-level 完全对齐并不现实，转而采用 tokenizer-agnostic 的 partial alignment。再配合 Ref-KL 与终止 token 处理，它在不增加太多复杂度的前提下解决了跨模型族蒸馏的稳定性问题。与电商治理的直接关系较弱，但对长链路 reasoning 蒸馏属于高热储备方向。
papers.innovation_en: Instead of assuming a shared vocabulary, SimpleOPD explicitly embraces tokenizer mismatch and uses tokenizer-agnostic partial alignment. Combined with Ref-KL and termination-token handling, it stabilizes cross-family distillation with minimal extra machinery. The paper is only weakly related to ecommerce governance, but it is an important frontier result for reasoning distillation.
papers.key_metrics_zh: Intern-S2-Preview 在 ProofBench@4 上从 21.70 提升到 44.50，在 AnswerBench@8 上从 76.03 提升到 80.10，在 AIME25@8 上从 88.33 提升到 95.00。Gemini-2.5-Pro 评审设置下，Intern-S2 从 34.0 提升到 55.2，并超过 Gemini-2.5-Pro 的 52.9。方法在 Qwen、GLM 等不同学生模型上也有较稳定增益。
papers.key_metrics_en: Intern-S2-Preview improves ProofBench@4 from 21.70 to 44.50, AnswerBench@8 from 76.03 to 80.10, and AIME25@8 from 88.33 to 95.00. Under Gemini-2.5-Pro evaluation, Intern-S2 rises from 34.0 to 55.2 and surpasses Gemini-2.5-Pro at 52.9. The approach also transfers well to Qwen and GLM student families.

papers.title: DrEM: Dual-Side Robust Ensemble Ranking from Noisy User Preference Predictions in Video Recommendation
papers.authors: ["Canwei Huang", "Tiantian He", "Xiaoxiao Xu", "Jun Zhang", "Ziran Deng", "Weike Pan", "Chunjie Chen", "Kaiqiao Zhan"]
papers.tags: ["视频推荐", "排序鲁棒性", "噪声建模", "内容分发", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 25, "results": 14, "exp_quality": 14, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 20, "total": 86, "rationale_zh": "对内容分发生态强相关，线上 A/B 结果扎实，两侧噪声建模思路也有很强可迁移性，因此进入今日最高优先级复现。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 对内容分发生态强相关，线上 A/B 结果扎实，两侧噪声建模思路也有很强可迁移性，因此进入今日最高优先级复现。
papers.rationale_en: 对内容分发生态强相关，线上 A/B 结果扎实，两侧噪声建模思路也有很强可迁移性，因此进入今日最高优先级复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: DrEM 面向短视频推荐的 ensemble ranking 场景，抓住 upstream 多任务模型输出的 pxtr 既被当作监督代理、又被当作排序特征这两个角色。它在监督侧构造基于 preference flip probability 的 risk-denoising robust loss，纠正由于 noisy pxtr 导致的 pairwise 偏好翻转；在特征侧按噪声分布采样扰动，并用 preference-preserving consistency regularizer 稳住排序输出。整个方法的高光点是把噪声建模同步到 supervision side 与 feature side，两侧共享一套噪声估计而不是各自打补丁。
papers.method_overview_en: DrEM targets ensemble ranking in short-video recommendation, where upstream pxtr predictions are used both as proxy supervision and as ranking features. It introduces a risk-denoising robust loss on the supervision side to correct pairwise preference flips caused by noisy pxtrs, and a preference-preserving consistency regularizer on the feature side by sampling perturbations from the estimated prediction-noise distribution. Its main highlight is a synchronized two-sided noise treatment rather than isolated fixes.
papers.story_zh: 上游多任务模型输出的 pxtr 带噪，却同时承担监督代理与排序特征两种职责，导致偏好翻转和输出不稳定。因此论文先估计 pair/item 级别的噪声分布，在监督侧修正错误梯度，在特征侧注入符合噪声结构的扰动并保持排序一致性。
papers.innovation_zh: 现有 ensemble ranking 往往默认 pxtr 足够可靠，最多只做单侧鲁棒化。DrEM 的创新在于把‘监督翻转风险’与‘特征扰动不稳’视作同源问题：前者做 pair-level 风险校正，后者做 item-level 预测扰动一致性约束，并由统一噪声方差估计对齐两侧修正目标。对内容生态分发、达人/视频多目标排序都非常契合，方法合理且具备直接工程落地价值。
papers.innovation_en: The key novelty is treating supervision-side label flips and feature-side instability as two manifestations of the same upstream pxtr noise. DrEM performs pair-level risk correction and item-level perturbation consistency under shared noise statistics, which is highly relevant to multi-objective content ranking and creator-feed distribution.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 离线实验中，DrEM 在两个工业 backbone 上均提升 7 个任务的 GAUC，例如 EMER backbone 的 pltr 从 0.6622 提升到 0.6725、pftr 从 0.6853 提升到 0.6965；线上 A/B 中，Follow 提升 1.197%，Comment 提升 1.388%，Video View 提升 0.691%，Long View 提升 0.401%。
papers.key_metrics_en: Offline, DrEM improves GAUC across seven tasks on two industrial backbones, e.g. pltr from 0.6622 to 0.6725 and pftr from 0.6853 to 0.6965 on the EMER backbone. In online A/B testing, it reports +1.197% Follow, +1.388% Comment, and +0.691% Video View.

papers.authors: ["Ravi Teja Chunduri", "Srikaran Reddy Boya", "Deep Narayan Mishra", "Ajay Kumar B", "Karthik Kumaran", "Pranay Kona"]
papers.tags: ["电商", "价格治理", "商品聚类", "多智能体", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 23, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 23, "total": 84, "rationale_zh": "和电商治理业务高度贴合，实验既有结构化 F1，也有真实部署指标；虽然以价格治理为核心，但可迁移到商品治理与达人带货规则体系。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 和电商治理业务高度贴合，实验既有结构化 F1，也有真实部署指标；虽然以价格治理为核心，但可迁移到商品治理与达人带货规则体系。
papers.rationale_en: 和电商治理业务高度贴合，实验既有结构化 F1，也有真实部署指标；虽然以价格治理为核心，但可迁移到商品治理与达人带货规则体系。
papers.method_overview_zh: 这篇论文解决大型零售目录中的‘line & ladder’价格治理：line 表示功能等价但仅颜色/口味等变体不同的商品簇，ladder 表示按容量/质量形成的价格阶梯。作者把任务拆成 3-agent 流程：先发现 variance attributes，再抽取多模态属性值，最后做层级分组与综合判定。高光点是把原本依赖资深类目经理的价格治理知识，转换成可扩展、可审计、可分阶段路由的 agentic taxonomy pipeline。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper automates retail 'lines and ladders' price taxonomy construction at enterprise scale. A line groups functionally equivalent product variants that should share price parity, while a ladder organizes lines into value-based price tiers. The framework uses a three-agent workflow for variance-attribute discovery, multimodal value extraction, and hierarchical grouping/synthesis. Its highlight is turning expert retail price-governance logic into a scalable and auditable agent pipeline.
papers.story_zh: 人工价格治理依赖专家经验，但面对百万级商品和脏乱属性数据时既慢又不稳，因此论文把任务拆成‘发现应该解释价差的属性 → 提取多模态属性值 → 按业务规则形成 line/ladder 结构’，用多智能体逐步逼近专家判断。
papers.innovation_zh: 与普通 embedding 聚类不同，该工作强调‘价格语义’而不是泛语义相似度：哪些属性应当保持同价、哪些属性应当解释价差，是由上下文和类目规则决定的。论文的创新在于引入 context-aware multi-agent 分工，降低单个 prompt 的认知负担，并把结构化 line/ladder 构造显式建模成企业级治理任务。这对电商内容生态中的商品治理、类目规范化、达人带货价格一致性巡检都很有启发。
papers.innovation_en: Unlike generic semantic clustering, this work models price-governance semantics explicitly: which attributes should preserve parity and which should explain price gaps. The context-aware multi-agent decomposition reduces prompt overload and operationalizes taxonomy construction as a governance workflow, making it highly relevant to commerce catalog normalization and creator-commerce pricing consistency.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在真实企业数据与生产部署中，3-agent 系统的 Lines F1 达到 0.83、Ladders F1 达到 0.82；Food & Consumables 业务上 precision 超过 90%、recall 超过 75%；在非结构化 General Merchandise 上达到 80.0% 加权准确率，且对 merchant reference 的平均 precision/recall 分别达到 0.98/0.75（Lines）与 0.92/0.81（Ladders）。
papers.key_metrics_en: In production-like enterprise evaluation, the 3-agent system reaches 0.83 F1 for Lines and 0.82 F1 for Ladders, with >90% precision and >75% recall in Food & Consumables, plus 80.0% weighted accuracy on unstructured General Merchandise.

papers.title: Generative Universal Multimodal Retrieval with Dual-role Identifiers
papers.authors: ["Kaipeng Li", "Haitao Yu", "Xuanchen Zhou"]
papers.tags: ["多模态检索", "向量化表征", "生成式检索", "图文检索", "中相关高热"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 24, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 16, "total": 78, "rationale_zh": "方法热度高、实验完整，和商品图文检索/相似召回关联较强；但距离电商内容生态核心治理任务仍稍远，因此未进入今日复现阈值。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 方法热度高、实验完整，和商品图文检索/相似召回关联较强；但距离电商内容生态核心治理任务仍稍远，因此未进入今日复现阈值。
papers.rationale_en: 方法热度高、实验完整，和商品图文检索/相似召回关联较强；但距离电商内容生态核心治理任务仍稍远，因此未进入今日复现阈值。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文提出 DrIG，把 generative retrieval 扩展到 universal multimodal retrieval。它为每个候选项学习 residual-quantized identifier，并让同一套 identifier 同时承担 sequential role 与 set-based role：前者用于 autoregressive decoding，后者提供 prefix-independent global relevance prior，缓解 beam search 的早期前缀误杀。为了补偿离散 ID 的信息损失，作者又加入 top-k dense reranking。高光点是把‘生成式检索的高效性’和‘dense 检索的精细判别’做成统一推理链路。
papers.method_overview_en: DrIG extends generative retrieval to universal multimodal retrieval. It assigns each candidate a residual-quantized identifier that plays both a sequential role for autoregressive decoding and a set-based role for prefix-independent global relevance guidance. A dense top-k reranker is added to recover fine-grained distinctions lost in discretization. The main highlight is combining generative efficiency with dense discriminative strength in one inference pipeline.
papers.story_zh: 生成式检索虽然快，但容易被前缀错误拖垮，而且离散 ID 会损失细粒度相似信息，因此论文先用可同时表达顺序与集合语义的 dual-role identifier 稳住 beam search，再用 dense reranking 补回细粒度区分能力。
papers.innovation_zh: 过去的生成式检索大多局限于单模态或双模态场景，而且非常依赖 left-to-right 前缀路径。DrIG 的创新在于 dual-role identifiers：同一 ID 序列既服务于顺序解码，又被重解释为无序 token set 来提供全局先验；再叠加 hybrid reranking，显著缩小与 dense baseline 的效果差距。对商品图文检索、内容相似召回、跨模态证据检索都很有借鉴意义。
papers.innovation_en: The key novelty is the dual-role identifier: the same discrete ID sequence is used both for left-to-right generation and for order-invariant global relevance estimation. Together with hybrid reranking, this significantly narrows the effectiveness gap between generative and dense multimodal retrieval.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 M-BEIR 上，DrIG 在 local-pool 设置下把平均分从 29.5 提升到 38.0（相对提升 28.8%），在 global-pool 设置下从 28.6 提升到 36.4（相对提升 27.3%）；在 Flickr30K text-to-image 上，DrIG-LT 的 R@1/R@5/R@10 达到 76.9/92.5/94.8，在 MSCOCO 上达到 56.3/80.1/86.7。
papers.key_metrics_en: On M-BEIR, DrIG raises the average score from 29.5 to 38.0 under local-pool retrieval and from 28.6 to 36.4 under global-pool retrieval. On text-to-image retrieval, DrIG-LT reaches 76.9/92.5/94.8 R@1/R@5/R@10 on Flickr30K and 56.3/80.1/86.7 on MSCOCO.

papers.title: GEM: A Generative Embedding Model Bridging Reasoning and Retrieval

papers.rationale_zh: 对复杂检索/RAG 的方法论价值很高，但业务侧更偏知识检索底座而非电商内容/达人治理主链路，因此作为热点跟踪而非今日复现对象。
papers.rationale_en: 对复杂检索/RAG 的方法论价值很高，但业务侧更偏知识检索底座而非电商内容/达人治理主链路，因此作为热点跟踪而非今日复现对象。
papers.method_overview_zh: GEM 把 reasoning 与 embedding 合进同一个生成式模型：先让模型对 query 做 intent / relevance criteria 级别的显式推理，再在生成后的上下文末尾追加 embedding token 作为检索表示。训练时联合 contrastive objective 与 causal LM objective，尽量保住 LLM 的生成能力，同时让 embedding 与 reasoning 对齐。高光点是‘generate-then-encode’这一范式，它不是把外部 LLM 的推理拼接到检索器前面，而是让检索模型自己先想再编码。
papers.method_overview_en: GEM unifies reasoning and embedding in a single generative model. It first reasons about user intent and relevance criteria, then appends an embedding token after the generated rationale to encode the enriched context for retrieval. Joint contrastive and causal-LM training preserves generation while aligning embeddings with reasoning. The highlight is a true generate-then-encode retriever rather than a pipeline that prepends external reasoning.
papers.story_zh: 用户会用越来越复杂的自然语言表达检索意图，但传统 retriever 只看表层相似度，因此论文先显式生成‘我到底要找什么’的 reasoning，再把这段更丰富的语义压进 embedding 中，缩小查询表达与检索表示之间的鸿沟。
papers.innovation_zh: 不少 reasoning retrieval 工作其实只是把更长的文本塞给 retriever，收益未必来自真正的推理理解。GEM 的创新在于把生成式 reasoning 内生到 embedding 模型中，再通过 reasoning-conditioned positives / hard negatives 训练 embedding 对齐推理语义。对电商问答检索、达人知识库检索、复杂治理规则检索都有启发，但业务相关性偏中等。
papers.innovation_en: Many reasoning-augmented retrievers may benefit mostly from longer text rather than actual reasoning alignment. GEM makes reasoning endogenous to the embedding model and trains with reasoning-conditioned positives and hard negatives, which is a meaningful step for instruction-heavy retrieval and RAG.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 BRIGHT 的 theorem-based 任务上，GEM 把同 backbone 的 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 平均 nDCG@10 从 19.8 提升到 32.0；在 TREC-DL-2019/2020 上，GEM 分别达到 70.4 和 73.6 nDCG@10，高于 embedding-only variant 的 69.0 和 69.1。
papers.key_metrics_en: On theorem-based BRIGHT tasks, GEM improves average nDCG@10 from 19.8 to 32.0 over the same-backbone embedding-only variant. On TREC-DL-2019/2020, GEM reaches 70.4 and 73.6 nDCG@10 versus 69.0 and 69.1 for Qwen3-4B-Instruct.

papers.title: TimeRoute: Time-Aware Modality Routing and Diffusion for Multi-Modal Recommendation
papers.authors: ["Pengyu Zhang", "Yangqin Jiang", "Klim Zaporojets", "Congfeng Cao", "Paul Groth"]
papers.tags: ["多模态推荐", "时间建模", "内容分发", "推荐系统", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 26, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 14, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 21, "total": 87, "rationale_zh": "对内容分发与多模态推荐高度相关，实验覆盖多个公开数据集，且时间感知建模对热点/季节性流量分配很有现实价值。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 对内容分发与多模态推荐高度相关，实验覆盖多个公开数据集，且时间感知建模对热点/季节性流量分配很有现实价值。
papers.rationale_en: 对内容分发与多模态推荐高度相关，实验覆盖多个公开数据集，且时间感知建模对热点/季节性流量分配很有现实价值。
papers.method_overview_zh: TimeRoute 针对多模态推荐里不同模态价值随时间漂移的问题，提出时间感知模态路由器与扩散式图重构器的统一框架。它先把用户行为上下文映射成个性化的模态分布，再通过 FiLM 调制的双流扩散去噪头抑制过时或误导性的模态边。相比固定融合权重，它能在节日、热点或短期风格变化时动态调整文本、图片和音频等信号的重要性。高光点是把“模态配比”和“图结构去噪”在同一模型里闭环建模。
papers.method_overview_en: TimeRoute tackles modality time-scale mismatch in multimodal recommendation with a temporal-aware modal router and a diffusion-based graph reconstructor. It first maps user behavior context to a personalized modality distribution, then uses FiLM-conditioned dual denoising heads to suppress outdated or misleading modality edges before propagation. Instead of fixed fusion weights, the model adapts text, image, and audio contributions to shifting temporal contexts. The key highlight is closing the loop between modality allocation and graph denoising in one recommender.
papers.story_zh: 固定模态融合无法处理用户兴趣随时间漂移、以及过时模态边污染图传播的问题，因此论文先学习个性化时间感知模态配比，再用扩散式去噪重建更可靠的多模态关系图。
papers.innovation_zh: 现有多模态推荐大多使用全局共享的融合权重，难以捕捉同一用户在不同时段对不同模态的依赖变化。TimeRoute 的创新在于把时间感知路由与扩散重构结合起来：前者解决模态使用比例的动态化，后者解决过时模态边对传播过程的污染。该设计兼顾个体性、时序性和图推荐建模，创新点合理且容易迁移到内容生态推荐。
papers.innovation_en: The main novelty is combining time-aware routing with diffusion-based reconstruction for recommendation. The router makes modality usage dynamic at the user-time level, while the diffusion module explicitly removes stale cross-modal relations from the graph. This is a meaningful departure from globally shared fusion weights and is highly transferable to content feeds with short-term trend shifts.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文在 TikTok、Amazon-Baby 和 Amazon-Sports 上报告 Recall@K、Precision@K 与 NDCG@K 相比强基线最高提升 9.8%，说明时序模态路由对短期兴趣漂移和图传播噪声都有明显帮助。
papers.key_metrics_en: On TikTok, Amazon-Baby, and Amazon-Sports, the paper reports up to 9.8% relative gains on Recall@K, Precision@K, and NDCG@K over strong baselines.

papers.title: Sona Technical Report
papers.authors: ["Sona Team", "Alexandr Udeneev", "Aleksei Krasilnikov", "Alexey Nadtochiy", "et al."]
papers.tags: ["生成式推荐", "工业推荐", "内容生态", "单模型架构", "强相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 24, "results": 14, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 10, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 20, "total": 84, "rationale_zh": "虽然场景是音乐而非电商，但它展示了单模型统一内容分发链路的工业可行性，线上收益明确，值得为内容生态与达人分发重点跟进。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 虽然场景是音乐而非电商，但它展示了单模型统一内容分发链路的工业可行性，线上收益明确，值得为内容生态与达人分发重点跟进。
papers.rationale_en: 虽然场景是音乐而非电商，但它展示了单模型统一内容分发链路的工业可行性，线上收益明确，值得为内容生态与达人分发重点跟进。
papers.method_overview_zh: Sona 是一个用单模型统一召回与排序的生成式推荐系统。它用共享编码器把用户事件序列变成隐藏状态，同时服务自回归解码头和 Ranking Module，并通过 next-token 目标与教师排序蒸馏共同训练。与传统 15+ 召回器和多级精排级联不同，Sona 直接在统一用户状态上完成候选生成和排序决策。高光点在于它不仅是学术上的端到端推荐尝试，还在线上真实流量中替代了整条成熟级联。
papers.method_overview_en: Sona is a single-model generative recommender that unifies candidate generation and ranking. A shared encoder turns chronological user events into hidden states that feed both an autoregressive decoder and a ranking module, while next-token learning and teacher distillation are optimized jointly. Instead of a large production cascade with many retrieval stages, Sona makes both retrieval and ranking decisions from one consistent user state. The standout point is that the architecture replaced a mature industrial stack on live traffic.
papers.story_zh: 多级级联系统难以全局优化、链路长且状态不一致，因此论文把用户序列编码成统一状态，并让一个模型同时承担生成式召回和排序，再通过训练期教师蒸馏补足性能。
papers.innovation_zh: 传统工业推荐链路往往由多召回、多预排和多精排模型拼接而成，难以全局最优，也会引入状态不一致与维护成本。Sona 的创新是用单一的共享状态承载召回与排序，并让更强教师模型只出现在训练期做蒸馏，不进入 serving。该设计在工程上非常实用：统一架构、减少级联冗余，同时保留强监督。对达人分发、视频/直播内容分发链路尤其有借鉴价值。
papers.innovation_en: The innovation lies in collapsing a complex industrial recommendation cascade into one shared-state model, while keeping a stronger teacher only during training. This removes cascade inconsistency, reduces serving complexity, and still preserves strong ranking supervision. It is especially relevant to creator and content distribution systems that currently rely on many loosely coupled stages.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文报告在 Yandex Music 的线上 A/B 中，Active Users 提升 4.53%，Total Listening Time 提升 6.30%，Likes 提升 11.42%，并且整体替换了 15+ 候选生成器和后续排序级联。
papers.key_metrics_en: In live A/B testing on Yandex Music, Sona reports +4.53% Active Users, +6.30% Total Listening Time, and +11.42% Likes while replacing a 15+ stage production cascade.

papers.title: MultiModal Code-Switching: Interleaving Visual Objects into Language for Explicit Object-Level Alignment
papers.authors: ["Changhao Xiang", "Shangyu Xing", "Zhen Wu", "Jianbing Zhang", "Xinyu Dai"]
papers.tags: ["MLLM", "视觉 grounding", "内容理解", "图文对齐", "弱相关高热"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 26, "results": 12, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 16, "total": 79, "rationale_zh": "方法价值与热度很高，尤其利于商品图和直播画面的细粒度理解，但与达人治理的直接业务距离略远，因此未进入复现阈值。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 方法价值与热度很高，尤其利于商品图和直播画面的细粒度理解，但与达人治理的直接业务距离略远，因此未进入复现阈值。
papers.rationale_en: 方法价值与热度很高，尤其利于商品图和直播画面的细粒度理解，但与达人治理的直接业务距离略远，因此未进入复现阈值。
papers.method_overview_zh: MMCS 受语码转换启发，把文本实体直接替换成对应视觉对象，从而让模型在句子结构中学习对象级对齐。作者还构造了 773K 的对象-实体对应合成样本，使模型能够在局部监督下高效建立视觉 token 与文本语义的显式映射。与传统整图-整句对齐相比，这种做法更直接地解决了“图里哪个物体对应文里哪个词”的问题。其高光点是用很少的数据就能达到甚至超过大规模全局配对训练的效果。
papers.method_overview_en: MMCS introduces a code-switching style pretraining paradigm that replaces textual entities with the corresponding visual objects. With a 773K synthetic object-entity dataset, it forces explicit local alignment between visual tokens and sentence context, rather than relying on global image-text matching. This directly tackles referential ambiguity in multimodal pretraining. Its highlight is achieving strong grounding efficiency with much less data.
papers.story_zh: 传统图文预训练只能学到模糊的全局对应关系，难以定位细粒度实体，因此论文把文本中的实体替换成视觉对象，强制模型在句级结构里完成对象级语义对齐。
papers.innovation_zh: 它不是继续扩大图文对的规模，而是改变预训练监督粒度，把全局匹配改成对象级显式对齐。这种设计对商品图属性抽取、短视频多物体理解、直播间卖点 grounding 都很有迁移价值。创新合理且有明显的数据效率优势，但与电商内容生态的相关性仍属于弱相关高热。
papers.innovation_en: Instead of scaling up coarse global image-text pairs, MMCS changes the supervision granularity to explicit object-level alignment. This is especially useful for product-attribute grounding, short-video item understanding, and live-commerce scene parsing, although the business relation is still weak-to-medium rather than directly domain-specific.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文报告仅用 50K 样本训练时，就能匹配或超过使用 600K 传统图文对训练的基线模型，体现出显著的数据效率优势。
papers.key_metrics_en: The paper reports that training with only 50K MMCS samples can match or exceed models trained on 600K conventional image-text pairs.

papers.title: SkillZip: Evaluation-Free Skill Compression for Self-Evolving Agents by Discovering Reusable Structure
papers.authors: ["Xiaofan Bai", "Hongqiang Lin", "Chao Liu", "Yantao Zhang", "Xuan Jin", "Xipeng Cao", "Yuhong Li"]
papers.tags: ["Agent", "技能压缩", "规则治理", "长期演化", "弱相关高热"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 27, "results": 10, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 16, "total": 78, "rationale_zh": "更偏 Agent 基础设施，但对复杂治理规则库的长期演进与推理成本控制非常有启发。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 更偏 Agent 基础设施，但对复杂治理规则库的长期演进与推理成本控制非常有启发。
papers.rationale_en: 更偏 Agent 基础设施，但对复杂治理规则库的长期演进与推理成本控制非常有启发。
papers.method_overview_zh: SkillZip 关注自进化 Agent 的技能库越积越大、越用越臃肿的问题。它不依赖任务回放评测，而是通过发现技能合约中的重复规则、重复动作序列和可共享 motif，以最小描述长度目标对技能进行结构化压缩。论文还提供单次压缩和 Zip-on-Write 持续压缩两种模式。高光点是既压缩上下文体积，又保留罕见但关键的异常规则。
papers.method_overview_en: SkillZip addresses the skill explosion problem in self-evolving agents. Instead of replay-based evaluation, it compresses a skill contract by discovering repeated rules, repeated action motifs, and reusable structural explanations under a minimum-description-length objective. It supports both one-shot compression and continual Zip-on-Write updates. The highlight is shrinking context cost while preserving rare but important exceptions.
papers.story_zh: 自进化 Agent 会不断追加成功经验与失败补丁，导致技能和规则库快速膨胀，因此论文尝试从结构上抽取可复用 motif，把重复规则与动作序列合并成更短但仍忠实的 skill 表达。
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点在于它压缩的不是普通文本，而是 Agent skill contract 这种具有触发条件、工具约束和流程语义的结构对象。对达人治理规则、审核 SOP 和复杂策略库来说，这类“结构化去冗余”很有现实意义。直接业务相关性不及推荐与内容理解论文，但对治理 Agent 基座长期可维护性价值很高。
papers.innovation_en: The novelty is compressing agent skill contracts as structured execution objects rather than plain text prompts. This makes it relevant to moderation rules, audit SOPs, and large policy libraries where trigger conditions and tool obligations matter as much as wording itself.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文强调在压缩率、推理成本和泛化保持上优于传统 prompt compression 方法，并支持持续写时压缩；其核心卖点是无需额外 rollout 评测即可完成压缩。
papers.key_metrics_en: The paper reports better compression and retained generalization than conventional prompt-compression approaches, while avoiding extra rollout-time evaluation during compression.

papers.title: Test-Time Self-Evolving GUI Visual Grounding via Reflection-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.authors: ["Shiyu Xuan", "Zechao Li"]
papers.tags: ["Agent", "GUI grounding", "测试时学习", "流程自动化", "弱相关高热"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 25, "results": 11, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 7, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 15, "total": 74, "rationale_zh": "对流程自动化与治理后台工具有启发，但并非内容生态核心推荐/理解模型，因此放在高热弱相关跟踪层。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 对流程自动化与治理后台工具有启发，但并非内容生态核心推荐/理解模型，因此放在高热弱相关跟踪层。
papers.rationale_en: 对流程自动化与治理后台工具有启发，但并非内容生态核心推荐/理解模型，因此放在高热弱相关跟踪层。
papers.method_overview_zh: 这篇论文让 GUI Agent 在部署后仍能边探索边自我更新。框架包含探索、评估、反思和内化四个环节：先在新界面上尝试 grounding，再由 MLLM Reflector 给出失败原因与反思，随后通过 on-policy self-distillation 把高阶反思转成 token 级监督。作者还用对比校准减少错误前缀对自蒸馏监督的污染。高光点是把测试时适配真正做成了闭环学习。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper equips GUI agents with a test-time self-evolving loop: exploration, evaluation, reflection, and internalization. A reflector MLLM diagnoses failures on unseen interfaces, then on-policy self-distillation turns those reflections into dense token-level supervision. Contrastive calibration further reduces the risk of corrupt supervision from bad autoregressive prefixes. The highlight is making post-deployment GUI adaptation a true closed loop.
papers.story_zh: 固定参数的 GUI agent 遇到新界面时很容易失效，因此论文引入反思器分析失败，再用在线自蒸馏把反思结果写回模型参数，实现部署后的持续适配。
papers.innovation_zh: 相较于只做测试时强化学习的 GUI agent，这篇工作把“反思”与“在线自蒸馏”结合起来，让模型能在无标注场景下逐步变强。对电商运营后台、达人治理工作台这类界面频繁变化的流程自动化任务很有迁移价值，但与内容生态核心模型链路仍是中等相关。
papers.innovation_en: Compared with plain test-time RL for GUI grounding, this work explicitly adds reflection and online self-distillation so the model can keep improving without human labels. It is highly relevant to workflow automation for changing business consoles, though it is only moderately connected to core content-ecosystem modeling.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文在 6 个 GUI benchmark 上平均提升 7.4% 准确率，证明测试时自演化能有效提升未见界面的 grounding 质量。
papers.key_metrics_en: Across six GUI benchmarks, the framework reports a 7.4% average accuracy gain over the base model.

papers.title: Batch Size or Negatives? A Selection Rule for Memory-Constrained Recommender Training
papers.authors: ["Artyom Sabitov", "Daniil Volkov", "Alexey Zaytsev"]
papers.tags: ["推荐训练", "效率优化", "负采样", "系统工程", "中相关"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 19, "results": 10, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 10, "generalization": 5, "relevance": 12, "total": 69, "rationale_zh": "推荐训练工程价值明确，但更偏底层系统优化，业务相关性低于内容理解与分发策略论文。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 推荐训练工程价值明确，但更偏底层系统优化，业务相关性低于内容理解与分发策略论文。
papers.rationale_en: 推荐训练工程价值明确，但更偏底层系统优化，业务相关性低于内容理解与分发策略论文。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文研究在固定显存预算 B=n×k 下，训练推荐模型时究竟应该优先增大 batch size，还是优先保留更多负样本。作者从 sampled softmax 的收敛分析出发，结合真实推荐 benchmark，给出了 n≈B、k≈1 更优的理论与实证结论。也就是说，在很多场景下更大的 batch 带来的梯度稳定性，比更多负样本更划算。高光点是把常见工程经验做成了清晰可执行的选择规则。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper studies how to spend a fixed memory budget B=n×k in recommender training: larger batches or more negatives. Through sampled-softmax analysis and real benchmarks, it argues that an n≈B and k≈1 allocation often converges fastest and achieves better final quality. In other words, gradient stability from larger batches can be more valuable than packing in extra negatives. The highlight is turning common engineering intuition into an actionable rule.
papers.story_zh: 内存受限训练时，工程上一直在更大 batch 与更多负样本之间摇摆，因此论文从 sampled softmax 收敛行为出发，系统回答该如何分配这部分预算。
papers.innovation_zh: 它的核心不是新模型，而是对推荐训练资源分配给出更坚实的理论解释。对于海量商品池与内容候选集训练来说，这样的结论很有用，但与内容生态/达人治理的直接业务相关性弱于前述模型类论文，因此总分不进入复现阈值。
papers.innovation_en: This is less about a new model and more about principled systems guidance for recommender training. It matters for large item pools and content candidate sets, but its direct relevance to creator governance is weaker than the modeling papers above.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 作者在 MovieLens-20M 等 benchmark 上展示了在相同内存约束下，更偏向大 batch 的配置具有更快收敛和更优最终推荐质量。
papers.key_metrics_en: On benchmarks such as MovieLens-20M, the paper reports faster convergence and better final recommendation quality under the larger-batch allocation at the same memory budget.

papers.title: GALA: Generative Aligned Learning for Adaptive Multimodal Representation in the Taobao Shangou Recommender System
papers.authors: ["Jiping Liu", "Zhongmin Zhang", "Zisen Sang", "Zhijia Fang", "Tao Ouyang", "et al."]
papers.tags: ["电商推荐", "多模态", "内容理解", "CTR/CVR", "LLM弱相关"]

papers.rationale_zh: 强工业电商相关性 + 线上增益明确 + 冷启动/多模态问题切中内容生态场景，因此给出最高档优先级。
papers.rationale_en: 强工业电商相关性 + 线上增益明确 + 冷启动/多模态问题切中内容生态场景，因此给出最高档优先级。
papers.method_overview_zh: GALA 面向淘宝闪购场景，把 query、商品图像和文本三元组先做对齐预训练，再用行为奖励驱动的对齐阶段把多模态表征拉向真实点击/下单偏好，最后通过自适应门控融合 ID 表征和多模态表征做排序。方法的亮点在于同时兼顾了冷启动内容理解和工业系统的低延迟要求。
papers.method_overview_en: GALA first aligns query, image, and text via triplet pretraining, then optimizes multimodal representations with reward-guided behavioral alignment, and finally fuses ID and multimodal signals through an adaptive gate for ranking. Its highlight is a practical balance between cold-start understanding and serving-time efficiency in instant-commerce recommendation.
papers.story_zh: 传统 ID 推荐对新商品和跨模态语义理解不足，纯多模态方法又难以稳定对齐真实业务奖励；因此论文先做 query-image-text 对齐，再用奖励驱动的生成式对齐把表示拉向成交目标，最后用自适应门控融合 ID 与多模态信息解决精度与效率的平衡。
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点主要有三处：一是把检索式三元组对齐和行为奖励对齐串成三阶段训练；二是用类似 GRPO 的奖励信号把表示学习直接连接到电商转化目标；三是通过自适应 gate 在成熟 ID 信号和多模态信号之间动态取舍。整体设计合理且可落地，尤其适合商品图文丰富但冷启动频繁的内容电商环境。
papers.innovation_en: The paper combines triplet alignment, reward-guided representation optimization, and adaptive ID-MM fusion in a single industrial pipeline. The innovation is practical rather than purely architectural: it directly binds multimodal learning to conversion-oriented rewards while keeping a fallback to strong ID features.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文报告 Overall Recall@K 由 GME 的 0.843 提升到 0.877；离线 CTR-AUC / CVR-AUC 达到 0.7263 / 0.8193；线上 A/B 中订单量提升 0.55%，且 P99 时延仅由 15.9ms 增至 17.6ms。
papers.key_metrics_en: GALA improves Overall Recall@K from 0.843 to 0.877 over GME, reaches 0.7263 CTR-AUC and 0.8193 CVR-AUC offline, and delivers +0.55% orders online with only a small P99 latency increase from 15.9 ms to 17.6 ms.

papers.title: Data Turnstile: A Scalable Open Framework for Function-Calling Data Generation
papers.authors: ["Goutham Ramakrishnan", "Megha Sharma"]
papers.tags: ["工具调用", "数据生成", "Agent", "数据治理", "标注"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 27, "results": 14, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 5, "relevance": 22, "total": 89, "rationale_zh": "虽非直接推荐论文，但对治理 Agent、自动审核和数据生产非常关键，且开源完整度高。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 虽非直接推荐论文，但对治理 Agent、自动审核和数据生产非常关键，且开源完整度高。
papers.rationale_en: 虽非直接推荐论文，但对治理 Agent、自动审核和数据生产非常关键，且开源完整度高。
papers.method_overview_zh: Data Turnstile 把 function-calling 数据生成拆成可组合的 DAG 节点，包括用户请求、思考、API 调用、API 观察和最终回答，并引入结构校验、LLM judge 和错误反馈重试。它的亮点是把高质量工具调用数据生产标准化、流水线化。
papers.method_overview_en: Data Turnstile formulates function-calling data generation as a composable DAG of user requests, reasoning, API calls, observations, and final answers, with structural validation, LLM judging, and feedback-based retries. Its highlight is a scalable and standardized pipeline for tool-use data generation.
papers.story_zh: 现有函数调用数据往往规模小、模板化严重、错误难控，难以支撑复杂 Agent 场景；因此论文把数据生产拆成 DAG，并在每一步加入约束与回退机制，得到可扩展、可审计的数据合成框架。对于电商治理 Copilot、审核助手、申诉处理 Agent 都很有借鉴价值。
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点在于把工具调用数据从“prompt 一次性生成”升级为“流程化合成系统”，同时支持自定义 API、规则和场景模板。方法可行性高，且与电商内容治理中的自动审核/运营辅助场景契合。
papers.innovation_en: The innovation is a systemized data-generation framework rather than a single prompting trick. By turning tool-use data creation into a controlled workflow, it becomes easier to scale, debug, and adapt to domain-specific APIs and policies.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 BFCL 单轮设定中，Qwen3-0.6B no-think SFT 达到 75.9%，明显高于 base 0.6B think 的 67.4%；在 τ2-bench Telecom 上，Qwen3-1.7B 获得 31.1% pass@1，而 0.6B 模型从 3.5% 提升到 24.6%。
papers.key_metrics_en: On BFCL single-turn evaluation, Turnstile-trained Qwen3-0.6B no-think SFT reaches 75.9%, beating the 67.4% base 0.6B think model. On τ2-bench Telecom, Qwen3-1.7B achieves 31.1% pass@1, and the 0.6B model improves from 3.5% to 24.6%.

papers.title: Scaling Properties of Text Conditioning in Visual Generation
papers.authors: ["Zilong Chen", "Chaorui Deng", "Kunchang Li", "Hongyi Yuan", "Haoqi Fan"]
papers.tags: ["视觉生成", "VLM/MLLM", "Prompt", "内容生产", "弱相关高热"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 28, "results": 14, "exp_quality": 14, "efficiency": 7, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 22, "total": 89, "rationale_zh": "弱相关但热度与方法价值都很高，对电商内容生产和达人视觉物料生成很有迁移意义。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 弱相关但热度与方法价值都很高，对电商内容生产和达人视觉物料生成很有迁移意义。
papers.rationale_en: 弱相关但热度与方法价值都很高，对电商内容生产和达人视觉物料生成很有迁移意义。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文系统研究了视觉生成中文本条件的 scaling property，提出 GPG 和 ED 作为信息量/复杂度指标，并设计结构化 prompt schema 与 verifier-gated 优化流程提升复杂文本控制能力。它的亮点是把“提示词写得好不好”转化成可量化、可训练的问题。
papers.method_overview_en: This work studies the scaling properties of text conditioning in visual generation, proposes GPG and ED as prompt-information metrics, and introduces structured prompt schemas with verifier-gated optimization. Its highlight is turning prompt quality into a measurable and trainable problem.
papers.story_zh: 复杂电商内容生成常常受限于文本条件表达能力不足，导致商品图、达人物料、营销创意难以稳定受控；因此论文先分析文本条件的 scaling law，再设计更强的结构化条件与验证式优化来提升复杂指令遵循。
papers.innovation_zh: 这篇论文把 prompt engineering 上升到 scaling law 和训练策略层面，既有理论分析又有大规模实证。虽然与治理不是强相关，但对商品图生成、封面图、营销素材等内容生产链路价值很高。
papers.innovation_en: The novelty lies in combining scaling-law analysis with practical prompt/schema optimization for image generation. While not a governance paper directly, it is highly relevant to controllable content creation in commerce and creator ecosystems.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文给出 GPG-loss 相关系数 -0.984、ED-loss 相关系数 -0.971；在 GenEval2 GM 上从 52.8 提升到 72.5，在 CoReBench 上从 74.7 提升到 85.2。
papers.key_metrics_en: The paper reports a -0.984 correlation between GPG and loss and -0.971 for ED and loss. It improves GenEval2 GM from 52.8 to 72.5 and CoReBench from 74.7 to 85.2.

papers.title: PaletteID: Prototype-Composed Semantic Identifiers for Multimodal CTR Prediction
papers.authors: ["Huanyu Liu", "Baining Chen", "Hui Liu", "Zengyang Li", "Ziyi Huang"]
papers.affiliations: ["Huazhong University of Science and Technology", "Central China Normal University"]
papers.tags: ["CTR", "语义ID", "多模态", "长尾商品", "电商广告"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 24, "results": 12, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 24, "total": 85, "rationale_zh": "与电商 CTR 和商品内容表征高度相关，设计轻量可迁移，对长尾和冷启动价值很高。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 与电商 CTR 和商品内容表征高度相关，设计轻量可迁移，对长尾和冷启动价值很高。
papers.rationale_en: 与电商 CTR 和商品内容表征高度相关，设计轻量可迁移，对长尾和冷启动价值很高。
papers.method_overview_zh: PaletteID 用真实商品 prototype 组合形成语义 ID，而不是用抽象 codebook 量化商品，从而把多模态商品内容压缩成更可解释、对长尾更友好的表示。方法通过 prototype 检索和 similarity gate 聚合出最终 PID，再接入 CTR 模型。
papers.method_overview_en: PaletteID builds semantic identifiers from retrieved real-item prototypes instead of abstract codebooks. It composes a prototype-based semantic representation with a similarity gate and plugs it into CTR models for more interpretable and tail-friendly prediction.
papers.story_zh: 传统 semantic ID 往往不可解释且容易损伤长尾商品表征；因此论文用真实 prototype 作为离散语义基元，再通过 top-K prototype 组合方式构造 PID，既保留可解释性，也提升多模态 CTR 建模效果。
papers.innovation_zh: 最大的创新是把语义 ID 从“抽象码字”改成“真实样本 prototype 组合”，并辅以 SQ-DPP 做 prototype 选择。这一设计很适合电商商品与达人内容的多模态表征，尤其在长尾和冷启动场景更有价值。
papers.innovation_en: The key novelty is replacing abstract codebooks with real prototype composition, making semantic IDs more interpretable and more effective on tail items. The prototype selection and gating design is lightweight and deployment-friendly.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 TAOBAO-MM / RankMixer 上，PID 将 AUC / GAUC 提升到 0.6318 / 0.6292；在 KuaiRec / RankMixer 上达到 0.8201 / 0.7514；Tail AUC 达到 0.5947，高于不使用 PID 的 0.5819。
papers.key_metrics_en: On TAOBAO-MM with RankMixer, PaletteID reaches 0.6318 AUC and 0.6292 GAUC; on KuaiRec it obtains 0.8201 AUC and 0.7514 GAUC. Tail AUC improves to 0.5947 from the 0.5819 baseline.

papers.title: EvoReason: Self-Evolving Reasoning Primitive-Guided On-Policy Distillation for Latent Reasoning in Generative Recommendation
papers.authors: ["Zhuang Zhuang", "Zhipeng Wei", "Rongfeng Guo", "Shijie Li", "Peng Zhao", "et al."]
papers.tags: ["生成式推荐", "推理蒸馏", "达人分发", "Agent", "推荐系统"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 25, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 7, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 23, "total": 84, "rationale_zh": "适合达人内容分发和复杂推荐决策，创新性强，线上收益可观，但部署复杂度较高。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 适合达人内容分发和复杂推荐决策，创新性强，线上收益可观，但部署复杂度较高。
papers.rationale_en: 适合达人内容分发和复杂推荐决策，创新性强，线上收益可观，但部署复杂度较高。
papers.method_overview_zh: EvoReason 从 agentic recommendation 轨迹中归纳 reasoning primitives，先训练 primitive-aware teacher，再把显式推理蒸馏到 latent reasoning token 中，让生成式推荐模型在推理成本可控的前提下保留更强的决策能力。高光点是把长链路显式推理压缩成可部署的隐式推理表示。
papers.method_overview_en: EvoReason extracts reasoning primitives from agentic recommendation trajectories, trains a primitive-aware teacher, and distills explicit chains of thought into latent reasoning tokens. The key highlight is preserving reasoning quality while making inference cheaper and more deployment-friendly.
papers.story_zh: 显式 CoT 推荐虽然强，但线上时延和成本太高；如果直接丢掉推理链，又会损伤复杂用户意图建模能力。因此论文先抽取稳定的 reasoning primitive 作为知识骨架，再通过 on-policy distillation 把显式推理迁移到 latent token，兼顾效果与效率。
papers.innovation_zh: 这篇论文的创新在于不是简单做 CoT 蒸馏，而是先把推荐决策拆成可复用 primitive，再做 self-evolving on-policy distillation。这样 teacher 的监督更结构化，也更适合内容/达人推荐里的复杂多目标排序。可行性较高，但工程复杂度比常规推荐模型更高。
papers.innovation_en: Instead of distilling raw CoT traces directly, EvoReason builds a reusable primitive library and performs self-evolving on-policy distillation. This structured reasoning abstraction is particularly suitable for complex recommendation decisions with multiple objectives.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 Beauty 数据集上，R@5 / R@10 分别达到 0.0724 / 0.0919，N@5 / N@10 达到 0.0557 / 0.0601；线上实验中 ADVV 提升 8.11%，Revenue 提升 6.23%，Avg Watch Time 提升 5.39%。
papers.key_metrics_en: On Beauty, EvoReason reaches 0.0724/0.0919 for R@5/R@10 and 0.0557/0.0601 for N@5/N@10. In online deployment, it reports +8.11% ADVV, +6.23% revenue, and +5.39% average watch time.

papers.title: RecHarness: A Bandit-Routed Agentic Harness for Self-Evolving Recommender Systems
papers.authors: ["Haoran Ling", "Yuecheng Li", "Zeyu Song", "Jing Yao", "Shuwen Kang", "Chi Lu", "et al."]
papers.tags: ["Agent", "AutoML", "推荐系统", "在线实验", "达人分发"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 26, "results": 12, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 7, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 23, "total": 84, "rationale_zh": "更偏推荐研发提效框架，但对内容生态策略优化和达人流量分发实验效率很有参考价值。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 更偏推荐研发提效框架，但对内容生态策略优化和达人流量分发实验效率很有参考价值。
papers.rationale_en: 更偏推荐研发提效框架，但对内容生态策略优化和达人流量分发实验效率很有参考价值。
papers.method_overview_zh: RecHarness 设计了一个 bandit-routed agentic harness：先根据验证反馈选择最值得优化的方向，再让 LLM 生成假设与代码修改，必要时通过 jump-basin 机制跳出局部最优。高光点在于把推荐迭代从“人工调参”升级为“自动路由+自动改模”。
papers.method_overview_en: RecHarness introduces a bandit-routed agentic harness that selects the most promising optimization direction, lets an LLM propose executable changes, and uses jump-basin transitions to escape local minima. Its highlight is turning recommender iteration into an automated closed loop.
papers.story_zh: 推荐系统往往依赖大量人工实验，搜索空间大且改动方向容易陷入局部最优；因此论文用 bandit 做方向路由，再借助 agent 自动生成代码改动，并用 jump-basin 机制在停滞时做结构跳转。
papers.innovation_zh: 创新性体现在把 bandit routing、agentic code modification 和 jump-basin 搜索三者结合成工程闭环。它更像推荐研发提效框架而非单一模型，但对内容生态和达人治理的实验迭代效率很有启发。
papers.innovation_en: The contribution is a systems-level innovation: bandit-based routing, agentic code generation, and structural search are combined into a practical recommender optimization loop. It is especially valuable for accelerating recommender experimentation.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 7 天线上 A/B 中，RecHarness 带来 ADVV +2.084%、Revenue +0.534%、Exposure +0.559%。这类线上收益对于成熟推荐系统已经相当亮眼。
papers.key_metrics_en: In a 7-day online A/B test, RecHarness reports +2.084% ADVV, +0.534% revenue, and +0.559% exposure, which are strong gains for a mature production recommender.

papers.title: Bridging the Structural Gap: Adapting Autoregressive Generation for Recommendation
papers.authors: ["Junchao Zeng", "Junzhang Zhu", "Junyang Chen", "Yudong Li", "Wei Liu", "Chengxiang Zhuo", "Zang Li"]
papers.affiliations: ["Tencent Platform & Content Group", "Shenzhen University", "Sun Yat-sen University"]
papers.tags: ["Generative Recommendation", "Hierarchical Code", "Reranking", "Sequential Modeling", "E-commerce"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 27, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 20, "total": 85, "rationale_zh": "非常贴合电商内容分发与推荐系统的生成式排序演进路径，方法创新点清晰且有腾讯线上收益验证。原文未确认公开代码，因此本轮补充了一个可运行的 toy PyTorch 复现，重点保留 ICA、层级路径重排和双路径解码思想。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 非常贴合电商内容分发与推荐系统的生成式排序演进路径，方法创新点清晰且有腾讯线上收益验证。原文未确认公开代码，因此本轮补充了一个可运行的 toy PyTorch 复现，重点保留 ICA、层级路径重排和双路径解码思想。
papers.rationale_en: 非常贴合电商内容分发与推荐系统的生成式排序演进路径，方法创新点清晰且有腾讯线上收益验证。原文未确认公开代码，因此本轮补充了一个可运行的 toy PyTorch 复现，重点保留 ICA、层级路径重排和双路径解码思想。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文提出 BARGE，用于修复生成式推荐里‘把层级语义 ID 展平成 token 序列’后带来的结构失真。作者首先用 Item Context-Aware Attention 在编码端恢复 item 级边界信息，再用 Hierarchical Path Reranking 在每一层语义路径上做语义一致性重排，最后通过 Dual-Path Decoding 用两条互补 ID 通道联合纠错。它不是简单换一个更大的 backbone，而是在编码、路径选择和解码三个位置同时抑制语义漂移。高光点是把工业生成式推荐里最常见的 early-token 错误传播问题，显式拆成可处理的两个结构鸿沟。
papers.method_overview_en: BARGE targets the structural mismatch of autoregressive generative recommendation. It restores item-level boundaries with Item Context-Aware Attention, reranks semantic paths with Hierarchical Path Reranking, and uses Dual-Path Decoding to correct early decoding mistakes through complementary code channels. Rather than scaling the backbone, it explicitly attacks the item-boundary gap and the semantic-drift gap. The highlight is a production-oriented design that improves path reliability without abandoning autoregressive generation.
papers.story_zh: 已有自回归生成式推荐把 item 的层级语义 ID 压扁后进行 token 级生成，容易丢失 item 边界且一旦前层 token 预测错就会永久走歪 -> 需要同时补 item 级结构感知与层级路径纠错 -> BARGE 用 ICA 恢复 item 上下文、用 HPR 评估路径与用户意图的一致性、再用 DPD 通过互补通道纠错，降低语义漂移。
papers.story_en: Flattened semantic IDs destroy item-level structure, and wrong early tokens trap autoregressive recommenders in bad semantic subtrees -> recommendation needs both structural restoration and path-level correction -> BARGE combines ICA, HPR, and DPD to recover item structure and suppress drift during decoding.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新性很强，真正针对的是生成式推荐的结构失配而不是通用语言建模性能。ICA/HPR/DPD 三个模块分工清晰，兼顾线上复杂度与效果提升；尤其 DPD 的互补路径设计，对于电商内容推荐中长序列、多候选和语义 ID 编码都很有参考价值。
papers.innovation_en: The main novelty is a recommendation-specific diagnosis of autoregressive failure modes, followed by three lightweight but targeted modules. The design is technically reasonable and industrially feasible because each module adds corrective signals without rewriting the whole recommendation stack.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 Amazon Beauty 上，BARGE 的 Recall@10 达到 0.1118，而最强基线 TIGER 为 0.0935，提升约 19.6%。论文还报告腾讯线上 A/B 测试 CTR +0.60%、Click UV +1.34%、总阅读时长 +1.70%，说明方法并非只在离线指标上有效。
papers.key_metrics_en: On Amazon Beauty, BARGE reaches 0.1118 Recall@10 versus 0.0935 for TIGER, a gain of about 19.6%. The paper also reports Tencent online A/B gains of +0.60% CTR, +1.34% click UV, and +1.70% total reading time.

papers.title: Diffusion Language Model for Recommendation

papers.rationale_zh: 扩散范式切入生成式推荐非常有新意，也与复杂内容分发和长行为序列建模需求高度相关。作者公开仓库包含 LightGCN、量化模块和训练代码，属于真实可用实现，因此不重复复现。
papers.rationale_en: 扩散范式切入生成式推荐非常有新意，也与复杂内容分发和长行为序列建模需求高度相关。作者公开仓库包含 LightGCN、量化模块和训练代码，属于真实可用实现，因此不重复复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: DLMRec 把生成式推荐从传统的自回归范式切换到离散扩散语言模型范式。它用协作感知随机 tokenizer（CAST）把图协同信号量化为扩散友好的离散 token，再配合课程式训练和稳定性感知投票机制，逐步恢复用户偏好而不是单向逐 token 承诺。相比左到右生成，扩散式建模能利用双向上下文，减少前缀错误放大的问题。高光点在于它把推荐建模中‘结构依赖强、顺序约束弱’这一现实，与扩散模型的迭代去噪特性对齐了。
papers.method_overview_en: DLMRec replaces autoregressive recommendation generation with a discrete diffusion language model. It introduces the CAST tokenizer to encode collaborative graph signals into diffusion-friendly tokens, then uses curriculum training and stability-aware voting to iteratively recover user preference. The bidirectional denoising process avoids the one-way commitment problem of left-to-right decoding. Its key idea is that recommendation depends more on structural dependencies than on strict token order, which diffusion models can capture better.
papers.story_zh: 传统自回归 LLM 推荐把 next-token 目标硬套到推荐任务上，容易过度强调顺序而忽略 item 间结构依赖，而且早期错误无法回头修正 -> 需要一种能并行考虑全局上下文的生成范式 -> DLMRec 用 CAST、课程训练和投票去噪，把推荐恢复过程改造成多轮偏好纠错。
papers.story_en: Autoregressive recommenders overemphasize next-token order and accumulate irreversible early mistakes -> recommendation needs a generation paradigm that can revise itself with global context -> DLMRec turns recommendation into iterative preference denoising with CAST, curriculum training, and voting.
papers.innovation_zh: 把离散扩散语言模型用于推荐是有分量的范式创新，尤其适合长序列偏好建模和复杂 item 依赖场景。方法也不是单纯把扩散照搬过来，而是针对推荐补了协同感知 tokenization 和稳定投票机制，因此可行性较高。
papers.innovation_en: This is a substantial paradigm shift for generative recommendation. The work is also practically grounded because it adds recommendation-specific tokenization and voting mechanisms rather than naively reusing generic diffusion modeling.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文报告相对最强 LLM 推荐基线 LLaRA，在三个公开数据集上平均 Recall 提升 6.75%，平均 NDCG 提升 5.19%。作者同时给出了 LastFM、ML-1M、Beauty 等数据集上的稳定提升，说明收益并不依赖单一数据域。
papers.key_metrics_en: Relative to the strongest LLM recommendation baseline LLaRA, DLMRec reports average gains of +6.75% Recall and +5.19% NDCG across three public datasets. The improvements are consistently shown on LastFM, ML-1M, and Beauty.

papers.rationale_en: 与大规模数据打标、清洗、质检和训练集建设直接相关，对电商内容治理与审核体系的上游数据基础很有价值。仓库已核查存在 benchmark、data-selection、evaluation 等真实代码与数据，因此不重复复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: DataPrep-Bench 首次把 LLM 驱动的数据构建与数据质量评估统一放进同一个 benchmark 中。它把训练数据准备拆成两个同等重要的能力：一类是把原始素材转成监督数据，另一类是无需微调就预测候选数据集的下游训练价值。作者同时发布 Data-Construction-Skill 智能体方案和 Distributional Alignment Score（DAS）指标，形成‘构造-评价-下游验证’一体化闭环。高光点在于它不再用表面文本质量做代理指标，而是直接以下游训练收益定义数据质量。
papers.method_overview_en: DataPrep-Bench is the first unified benchmark for LLM-driven training data preparation. It jointly evaluates data construction, which turns raw sources into supervised data, and data quality evaluation, which predicts downstream utility before fine-tuning. The work also releases a Data-Construction-Skill agent and the Distributional Alignment Score (DAS), closing the loop between construction, evaluation, and downstream validation. The most important shift is to define quality by training utility rather than by surface text heuristics.
papers.story_zh: 电商治理、审核和内容理解模型越来越依赖高质量标注/清洗数据，但当前 LLM 数据准备方法缺乏统一、下游导向的比较标准 -> 需要把数据构建和数据价值预测放到一个可重复协议里评测 -> DataPrep-Bench 用双赛道 benchmark、Skill agent 和 DAS 指标，把数据准备从经验活变成可量化工程。
papers.story_en: Data-centric model building increasingly depends on high-quality annotation and cleaning, but LLM-based data preparation lacks a downstream-grounded benchmark -> the field needs a unified protocol for both data construction and value prediction -> DataPrep-Bench turns data preparation into a measurable engineering workflow.
papers.innovation_zh: 这篇论文更像基础设施型创新，但对大规模数据打标、清洗和训练集建设价值非常高。特别是把质量定义为 downstream utility 而不是文本表面属性，这与电商场景中的数据治理目标更一致。
papers.innovation_en: This is infrastructure-level innovation with high practical value for large-scale labeling, cleaning, and corpus curation. Measuring quality by downstream utility is especially relevant for e-commerce governance and moderation pipelines.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 Llama-3.1-8B Finance 上，Data-Construction-Skill 相比 Dolly-only baseline 提升接近 20 个绝对百分点。DAS 是唯一在 Math、Science、Medical 三个领域同时达到 Pearson r>0.70 的质量评估指标，并在 6 个领域中的 4 个取得最强跨模型相关性。
papers.key_metrics_en: On Llama-3.1-8B Finance, Data-Construction-Skill improves nearly 20 absolute points over the Dolly-only baseline. DAS is the only metric that clears Pearson r>0.70 simultaneously on Math, Science, and Medical, and it is the strongest cross-model evaluator in four of six domains.
