papers.rationale_zh: 对多模态内容理解驱动的推荐控制非常契合电商与达人内容分发，但当前更偏研究原型，且公开项目页未直接确认完整训练代码仓库，因此本轮先纳入重点关注，不触发复现。
papers.rationale_en: 对多模态内容理解驱动的推荐控制非常契合电商与达人内容分发，但当前更偏研究原型，且公开项目页未直接确认完整训练代码仓库，因此本轮先纳入重点关注，不触发复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: CCBR 用多模态大模型从图像、音频和视频内容中生成自然语言用户画像，再把这个文本瓶颈接入协同过滤推荐器，实现‘可解释且可编辑’的推荐控制。它不是只使用文本元数据，而是直接从内容模态中抽取可 verbalize 的偏好摘要，并通过对比学习与标签监督对齐文本表示和推荐表示。用户可以通过改写文本摘要或提供新的多模态内容来主动 steer 推荐结果。高光点是把可控推荐从‘改 latent 向量’变成‘改人能看懂的文本偏好’。
papers.method_overview_en: CCBR builds controllable recommendation through a text bottleneck generated from multimodal content. Instead of relying on metadata, it verbalizes user preference from images, audio, and video, then aligns the text representation with a collaborative filtering backbone through contrastive and label-guided learning. Users can steer recommendation by editing the generated profile text or by providing new multimodal content. The key idea is to turn latent preference control into human-readable text control.
papers.story_zh: 传统推荐模型依赖隐向量，用户很难理解也无法直接干预；而已有可控方法多基于文本元数据，无法覆盖图像/音视频信号 -> 需要一个从多模态内容直接生成可编辑画像的框架 -> CCBR 用多模态 verbalization、用户摘要聚合和对比对齐实现内容驱动的可控推荐。
papers.story_en: Latent recommenders are hard to interpret and hard to control, while earlier controllable systems mostly depend on text metadata -> recommendation needs editable preference representations directly grounded in content modalities -> CCBR uses multimodal verbalization, text bottlenecks, and alignment losses to make content-based control practical.
papers.innovation_zh: 从多模态原始内容到可编辑文本画像的设计很有新意，对商品内容、达人内容和用户兴趣解释都很友好。缺点是依赖较强的预处理与多模态模型，因此效率和工程复杂度略高。
papers.innovation_en: The contribution is compelling because it moves controllable recommendation from latent-vector manipulation to editable textual preference summaries grounded in multimodal content. The engineering cost is higher, which slightly limits immediate deployability.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 ML-20M 视频数据集上，CCBR+Multi-VAE 的 NDCG@100 为 0.4964，优于可控推荐基线 TEARS 的 0.4836，并在添加/删除属性的 steering 实验中展现出稳定单调响应。
papers.key_metrics_en: On the ML-20M video setup, CCBR+Multi-VAE reaches 0.4964 NDCG@100 versus 0.4836 for TEARS, while also showing stable monotonic behavior in add/remove attribute steering experiments.

papers.rationale_en: 适合作为现有电商推荐系统的低侵入增强方案，跨域与异质用户场景价值较高。但公开代码未确认，且整体方法更偏增强型模块，因此分数略低于今日最强方法类论文。
papers.method_overview_zh: PRL 把推荐增强建模成‘基础推荐器预测残差’的概率学习问题。它利用用户概率聚类、因果混杂建模和贝叶斯残差推断，专门去修正现有深度推荐系统在跨域和异质人群上的偏差。作为 plug-and-play 框架，PRL 不需要重训整个基础模型，而是在其预测之上做局部残差校正。高光点是把推荐器调优从纯黑盒工程，转成了带因果解释的后验残差修正。
papers.method_overview_en: PRL treats recommendation enhancement as probabilistic residual learning on top of an existing recommender. It combines user-level probabilistic clustering, causal confounder modeling, and Bayesian residual correction to fix systematic errors in deep recommendation systems. Because it is plug-and-play, the method improves a deployed base model without retraining the whole stack. Its main appeal is turning black-box recommendation refinement into an interpretable residual correction problem.
papers.story_zh: 工业推荐器在复杂市场和用户异质性下会出现系统性偏差，纯深度模型又很难解释这些误差从何而来 -> 需要一个能显式建模用户群差异和混杂因素的增强模块 -> PRL 用概率聚类、因果混杂和残差校正，在不推翻基础模型的前提下提升线上推荐质量。
papers.story_en: Production recommenders suffer from systematic bias across heterogeneous users and markets, while pure deep models make those errors hard to diagnose -> recommendation needs a low-intrusion correction layer with causal awareness -> PRL learns probabilistic residuals conditioned on user clusters and confounders.
papers.innovation_zh: 残差学习本身不新，但将分层贝叶斯与因果去偏结合到推荐残差修正里较有意思，尤其适合需要低侵入式增强现有排序系统的场景。整体可行性较高，但实验覆盖面和公开可复现性稍弱于今天最顶级的几篇。
papers.innovation_en: Residual learning is not new, but combining hierarchical Bayesian modeling with causal debiasing for recommendation correction is valuable. The method is feasible and deployment-friendly, though the overall evidence package is slightly weaker than the strongest papers of the day.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 XMRec 跨国迁移场景中，PRL 将 CDL 的 Recall@20 从 0.0143 提升到 0.1091；也把 PerK 的 Recall@20 从 0.1098 提升到 0.1635，说明其对困难迁移场景尤为有效。
papers.key_metrics_en: On XMRec cross-market transfer, PRL improves Recall@20 from 0.0143 to 0.1091 over CDL, and from 0.1098 to 0.1635 over PerK.

papers.method_overview_zh: ResponseGuard 质疑了‘做多模态安全审核一定要先推理再判断’这一假设，提出一个无 CoT 的轻量级视觉语言审核器。它直接用请求、图像和响应的池化表征做单次前向分类，不再生成长链路解释，从而能在流式输出中实时拦截不安全响应。作者还引入参考向量库与概率标定策略，使小模型也能稳定输出高置信度审核结论。高光点是证明了实时审核场景里，推理型 guardrail 并不一定划算。
papers.method_overview_en: ResponseGuard challenges the assumption that multimodal safety guarding must rely on chain-of-thought reasoning. It uses pooled request-image-response representations for one-shot classification, avoiding long generation traces and enabling streaming moderation. A reference-vector-bank design and calibration strategy help a small model maintain stable guard performance. The highlight is that real-time moderation may benefit more from direct classification than from reasoning-heavy guardrails.
papers.story_zh: 内容治理系统越来越多地依赖 VLM 审核，但 reasoning-based guardrail 延迟高，很难在直播、图文生成和流式问答里及时拦截风险 -> 需要一个不依赖长推理链、却能保持精度的轻量审核器 -> ResponseGuard 用池化表征分类和参考向量库，实现快速响应级 moderation。
papers.story_en: Reasoning-based VLM guardrails are too slow for streaming moderation in live or interactive content systems -> moderation needs a lightweight but accurate response-time guard -> ResponseGuard performs direct pooled-representation classification with calibrated reference vectors.
papers.innovation_zh: 这篇更偏系统与效率创新，而不是更强的语义理解模型。对电商内容治理来说价值很直接，因为它解决的是‘实时拦截是否可行’而不是离线排行榜问题。仓库层面只有 README 与 docs 资源，未确认完整训练推理代码，因此不把它算作已公开完整实现。
papers.innovation_en: This is primarily a systems-efficiency contribution rather than a new semantic understanding model. Its production relevance is high, but the public repository currently looks more like a project-page release than a full training and inference codebase.
papers.key_metrics_zh: ResponseGuard-2B 在响应有害性检测上的 All-average F1 为 77.31，高于 3B reasoning baseline 的 76.56；单次判定耗时约 67.6ms，而推理型方法约 10.12s，速度提升约 150 倍。
papers.key_metrics_en: ResponseGuard-2B reaches 77.31 all-average F1 on harmful-response detection versus 76.56 for a 3B reasoning baseline, while reducing latency from about 10.12 seconds to 67.6 milliseconds, roughly a 150x speedup.

papers.method_overview_zh: LO-FAR 面向工业广告推荐中的稀疏高基数特征筛选，提出一种纯 CPU、模型无关的局部过滤工作流。它不依赖昂贵的 GPU 重训练，而是用局部 ID 级估计器快速评估每个候选特征的独立预测价值，再按预算做特征保留。对于 embedding 成本巨大、迭代节奏快的广告/推荐系统，这类方法能显著降低筛选开销。高光点在于把‘特征重要性估计’从重型交互建模，降成了可快速上线的 local filter。
papers.method_overview_en: LO-FAR is a CPU-only, model-agnostic workflow for sparse feature ranking in industrial ad recommendation. Instead of expensive GPU retraining loops, it estimates the marginal predictive value of each sparse feature with lightweight local predictors and ranks features under budget constraints. This makes sparse-feature governance much faster for production recommendation stacks dominated by embedding costs. Its main contribution is reframing feature selection as a deployable local filter.
papers.story_zh: 工业广告推荐里稀疏特征占存储和训练成本的大头，传统特征选择方法依赖反复 GPU 重训，无法跟上业务迭代 -> 需要一种低成本、快速但结果仍可用的特征筛选流程 -> LO-FAR 用局部 held-out 信号和 CPU 并行评分，在预算约束下近似保留最有价值的稀疏特征。
papers.story_en: Industrial recommenders spend most of their storage and training budget on sparse high-cardinality features, while classic feature-selection methods are too expensive to iterate -> the system needs a cheap but reliable filtering workflow -> LO-FAR uses local held-out signal and CPU-parallel scoring to rank sparse features efficiently.
papers.innovation_zh: 更偏工程系统优化而非算法突破，但实用性很强。对于电商广告、商品推荐和内容分发的特征治理，这种成本感知的筛选思路有直接借鉴意义。
papers.innovation_en: The novelty is mainly engineering-oriented rather than algorithmically disruptive, but it is directly useful for production feature governance in ads and recommendation systems.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在包含 100 多万交互、475 个稀疏特征的生产数据集上，LO-FAR 可在约 2 CPU 小时内完成排序，成本约 100 美元，而重型替代方案约 4000 美元；在 CTR/CVR 任务上与 shuffle-based importance、BSN 等方法的 NE Gain 基本持平。
papers.key_metrics_en: On a production dataset with more than one million interactions and 475 sparse features, LO-FAR finishes ranking in about two CPU hours at roughly 100 USD cost versus about 4000 USD for heavier alternatives, while keeping NE gains competitive on CTR and CVR tasks.

papers.title: Beyond Relevance-Centric Retrieval: Rubric-Oriented Document Set Selection and Ranking
papers.authors: ["Kailin Jiang", "Lei Liu", "Jian Xi", "Hui Xu", "Junlin Liu", "Baochen Fu", "Shaoqing Ren", "Bin Li", "Vichwang", "Yu Lu", "Haibo Shi"]
papers.affiliations: ["University of Science and Technology of China", "Tencent Hunyuan Yuanbao", "University of Chinese Academy of Sciences", "Shandong University"]

papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 28, "results": 14, "exp_quality": 15, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 5, "relevance": 23, "total": 94, "rationale_zh": "重新定义了 RAG 证据检索的优化目标，数据集、诊断分析和无训练优化闭环都很完整；对电商内容治理中的证据筛选、多样性控制、冲突检测和事实核查都具有直接迁移价值。原仓库已确认包含 run_pipeline.py、judge_scoring、rankify 等实现文件，因此不重复复现。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 重新定义了 RAG 证据检索的优化目标，数据集、诊断分析和无训练优化闭环都很完整；对电商内容治理中的证据筛选、多样性控制、冲突检测和事实核查都具有直接迁移价值。原仓库已确认包含 run_pipeline.py、judge_scoring、rankify 等实现文件，因此不重复复现。
papers.rationale_en: 重新定义了 RAG 证据检索的优化目标，数据集、诊断分析和无训练优化闭环都很完整；对电商内容治理中的证据筛选、多样性控制、冲突检测和事实核查都具有直接迁移价值。原仓库已确认包含 run_pipeline.py、judge_scoring、rankify 等实现文件，因此不重复复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文把检索质量从‘单文档相关性’扩展到‘文档集合协同质量’，提出覆盖文档级、集合级、全局级的 SETWISEEVALKIT，并用约 2.8 万条 query-specific rubrics 描述互补性、冗余、冲突、真实性等九个维度。作者随后提出免训练的 RUBRIC4SETWISE，把 rubrics 直接转成文档集筛选与排序信号，不再只依赖相似度分数。它同时完成评估、诊断和优化闭环：先发现现有 reranker 的集合级缺陷，再把评估信号反向用于 setwise 选择。高光点在于把 RAG 检索从‘相关即可’推进为‘证据充分、互补且不冲突’的工业化指标体系。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper reframes retrieval quality from single-document relevance to document-set quality. It introduces SETWISEEVALKIT, a rubric-based benchmark spanning document-, set-, and global-level criteria such as complementarity, redundancy, conflict, and authenticity. On top of that, RUBRIC4SETWISE is a training-free selector that directly converts query-specific rubrics into setwise document ranking signals. The work closes the loop across evaluation, diagnosis, and optimization for RAG retrieval.
papers.story_zh: 现有 RAG/检索系统主要优化单文档相关性，容易得到一组彼此冗余、甚至事实冲突的文档 -> 需要从文档集合整体质量出发，明确什么叫‘适合回答问题的一组证据’ -> 论文用 query-specific rubrics 描述集合级质量，并把 rubrics 直接用于无训练 setwise ranking。
papers.story_en: Standard retrieval optimizes single-document relevance, which often returns sets that are redundant or mutually conflicting -> retrieval should optimize the quality of the whole evidence set -> build query-specific rubrics and use them directly for setwise selection and ranking.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新性很强，核心不在于再造一个打分模型，而是重新定义检索目标函数：从单文档相关性转向集合级证据质量。Rubric 驱动的 setwise 选择兼具可解释性和落地性，尤其适合治理类场景中对冗余、冲突、真实性和覆盖度都有明确要求的证据检索。
papers.innovation_en: The novelty is not just another reranker, but a new objective for retrieval: evidence-set quality. Rubric-oriented setwise ranking is both interpretable and actionable for industrial governance pipelines that care about redundancy, conflict, authenticity, and coverage.
papers.key_metrics_zh: SETWISEEVALKIT 覆盖约 2.8 万条高质量 rubrics、12 类 reranker；rubric 覆盖得分与下游生成质量 Pearson r=0.92。RUBRIC4SETWISE 在短文本多跳 QA 上取得 27.71 平均分（EM 26.10 / F1 29.32），且平均只需 2.66 篇文档；在长文本调研场景中 LLM-judge 得分 70.57，优于次优方法，同时使用更少文档（20.52 vs 29.23）和更少搜索轮次（4.52 vs 4.73）。
papers.key_metrics_en: SETWISEEVALKIT contains about 28k high-quality rubrics and evaluates 12 rerankers. Rubric coverage correlates strongly with downstream generation quality (Pearson r=0.92). RUBRIC4SETWISE reaches 27.71 average score on short-text multi-hop QA (EM 26.10 / F1 29.32) with only 2.66 documents on average, and achieves 70.57 LLM-judge score on long-form research while using fewer documents and search rounds than the runner-up.

papers.title: UniRank: Benchmarking Ranking Models for Unified Sequential Modeling and Feature Interaction

papers.affiliations: ["Anhui University", "University of Science and Technology of China", "Tencent"]

papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 24, "results": 14, "exp_quality": 15, "efficiency": 10, "generalization": 5, "relevance": 25, "total": 93, "rationale_zh": "虽然不是单模型创新，但它对电商排序基础设施的价值极高：数据规模、任务覆盖和复现实验都很强，且代码仓库已确认包含 model_zoo、benchmark、unirank 等完整实现，适合作为后续选型和复验基线，因此不重复复现。"}

papers.rationale_en: 虽然不是单模型创新，但它对电商排序基础设施的价值极高：数据规模、任务覆盖和复现实验都很强，且代码仓库已确认包含 model_zoo、benchmark、unirank 等完整实现，适合作为后续选型和复验基线，因此不重复复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: UniRank 提出面向工业级排序任务的统一基准，聚焦‘行为序列建模 + 特征交互’融合架构，覆盖 15 种代表性模型与 5 个亿级公开数据集。它把工业里常见的时间序点式自回归训练范式标准化，而不是继续沿用学术界简化采样设置。作者还同步提供高性能 PyTorch 工具包，集成 Flash Attention、混合精度等优化，用于研究排序模型的 scaling law 和超长行为序列建模。高光点在于首次把内容消费、互动、转化等多反馈目标放到一个统一、可复现的开源排名基准里。
papers.method_overview_en: UniRank is an industrial-scale benchmark for ranking models that unify sequential behavior modeling with feature interaction. It standardizes a production-like pointwise autoregressive training setup, covers 15 representative models, and spans five public datasets at hundred-million scale. The benchmark is paired with an optimized PyTorch toolkit using techniques such as Flash Attention and mixed precision for scaling-law studies and ultra-long sequence modeling. Its main contribution is turning fragmented ranking research into a reproducible industrial baseline suite.
papers.story_zh: 工业界排序模型依赖私有数据和私有训练流水线，学术界很难公平比较不同序列+交互架构 -> 需要一个贴近真实工业训练范式、同时覆盖超长行为序列和多任务反馈的统一基准 -> UniRank 统一数据、模型、算子优化和评测协议，建立可扩展的排序 benchmark。
papers.story_en: Industrial ranking models are hard to compare because they depend on private data and private training pipelines -> the field needs a public benchmark that mirrors real production training and multi-feedback objectives -> UniRank standardizes data, models, optimization, and evaluation into one scalable benchmark.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点更偏‘基石型工程研究’：它不是提出单一新模型，而是把过去零散的 long-sequence ranking、feature interaction 和多反馈训练整合成可复现基准。对于电商内容生态，这类工作价值非常高，因为选型、压测、扩容和线上演进都需要先有可信的统一对照系。
papers.innovation_en: This is a foundational engineering contribution rather than a single new model. It creates a trustworthy comparison layer for long-sequence ranking, feature interaction, and multi-feedback training, which is exactly what production recommendation systems need for model selection and iteration.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 数据集包括 QK-Video（4.9 亿）、KuaiRand（3.2 亿）、TAAC-25（7.5 亿）、Taobao、MerRec。论文报告在 KuaiRand 上层级化交互模型 EST 的 Long View AUC 达到 0.8157；工具包在 4 卡 H20 上实现 14.24 倍吞吐加速，并完整输出 15 种模型的 AUC/Logloss 排行。
papers.key_metrics_en: The benchmark includes QK-Video (490M), KuaiRand (320M), TAAC-25 (750M), Taobao, and MerRec. On KuaiRand, the hierarchical interaction model EST reaches 0.8157 AUC on the Long View task. The toolkit also reports up to 14.24x training throughput speedup on 4x H20 GPUs while benchmarking 15 models with AUC and Logloss.

papers.title: Personalized Recommendation Tool Learning via Autonomous Language Agents
papers.authors: ["Mingdai Yang", "Zhiwei Liu", "Weizhi Zhang", "Yibo Wang", "Hao Peng", "Philip Yu"]
papers.tags: ["Agent", "Recommendation", "Tool Learning", "Personalization", "LLM"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 26, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 14, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 22, "total": 87, "rationale_zh": "LLM agent + 推荐工具调度的思路兼具创新性与落地性，对达人内容、商品内容、用户偏好异质性很有价值。原仓库已确认包含 main.py、memory_bank.py、prompt_bank.py、SimpleX/、SASRec/、LightGCN-PyTorch/ 等实现，因此不重复复现。"}
papers.rationale_zh: LLM agent + 推荐工具调度的思路兼具创新性与落地性，对达人内容、商品内容、用户偏好异质性很有价值。原仓库已确认包含 main.py、memory_bank.py、prompt_bank.py、SimpleX/、SASRec/、LightGCN-PyTorch/ 等实现，因此不重复复现。
papers.rationale_en: LLM agent + 推荐工具调度的思路兼具创新性与落地性，对达人内容、商品内容、用户偏好异质性很有价值。原仓库已确认包含 main.py、memory_bank.py、prompt_bank.py、SimpleX/、SASRec/、LightGCN-PyTorch/ 等实现，因此不重复复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: PRTA 把推荐系统中的多个传统推荐模型视为可调用工具，由 LLM 代理充当中央规划者，在用户级别学习‘该调用哪些工具、权重如何分配、结果如何聚合’。框架核心是 Personalized Tool Memory，用来记录用户对不同推荐工具的偏好权重；LLM 通过局部工具评估、全局工具比较和排名比较三种反思机制持续更新该记忆。推理阶段，代理聚合 LightGCN、SASRec、SimpleX 等模型输出，并结合上下文重排序完成最终推荐。高光点在于用轻量代理调度替代端到端大模型排序，把 LLM 的语义推理能力和传统推荐器的全量候选处理能力结合起来。
papers.method_overview_en: PRTA treats multiple recommendation models as tools and lets an LLM agent serve as the central planner. Its Personalized Tool Memory stores user-specific tool preferences, while local evaluation, global comparison, and rank comparison reflections update those weights over time. At inference, the agent aggregates outputs from models such as LightGCN, SASRec, and SimpleX, then performs contextual reranking. The key idea is to use the LLM for tool orchestration instead of forcing it to rank the entire candidate pool alone.
papers.story_zh: 纯 LLM 推荐代理容易受幻觉、上下文窗口和全量候选排序能力限制，传统推荐器又难以在复杂语义偏好下动态切换 -> 需要让 LLM 只负责‘何时使用哪种推荐工具’，而不是独自完成所有排序 -> PRTA 用个性化工具记忆和三类反思机制学习用户级工具调度策略。
papers.story_en: Pure LLM recommenders struggle with hallucination, context limits, and full-candidate ranking, while classical recommenders cannot flexibly adapt to complex semantic preferences -> let the LLM decide which recommendation tools to use rather than doing all ranking itself -> learn user-level tool orchestration with memory and reflection.
papers.innovation_zh: 它真正的创新不在于再加一个 reranker，而是把推荐模型抽象成可学习工具，并把调度问题变成 LLM agent 的记忆与反思问题。这种分层设计非常适合电商内容生态：不同用户、不同内容模态、不同达人类型，往往对应不同召回/精排器的优势区间。
papers.innovation_en: The paper reframes recommendation as tool learning for an autonomous language agent. This hierarchical design is highly practical for e-commerce because different users and content types often benefit from different retrieval and ranking specialists.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 Amazon、Yelp、Goodreads 等数据集上，PRTA 全量排序明显超过纯 LLM 和传统基线；例如 Amazon 上 Recall@10 从 0.0625 提升到 0.1000（约 +60%），Goodreads 上 Recall@10 从 0.1000 提升到 0.1688（约 +68.8%）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Across Amazon, Yelp, and Goodreads, PRTA substantially outperforms pure-LLM and classical baselines in full-ranking settings. Reported gains include Recall@10 improving from 0.0625 to 0.1000 on Amazon (about +60%) and from 0.1000 to 0.1688 on Goodreads (about +68.8%).

papers.rationale_en: 非常适合大规模视频内容治理，尤其是 AI 生成内容检测的全量预筛。由于公开网页层面的实验细节仍有限，结果与实验质量项略保守；但原仓库已确认包含 streamdet/features、analysis、tests、scripts 等实现，因此不重复复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文把 AI 生成视频检测重构为流式感知任务：先直接从压缩码流提取运动场等轻量特征进行早期判断，再只把少量低置信度片段上报给更昂贵的视觉模型。它同时引入 anytime-valid 阈值和‘早检、少升级’的阶梯式决策机制，使系统在尚未完整解码视频前就能输出可用风险判断。相比离线像素级检测器，该方案把治理链路前移到码流层，并通过 deferral 机制把大模型调用预算压到很低。高光点是把海量短视频内容治理从重模型全量扫视频，变成轻特征全量预筛 + 小流量精检。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper reformulates AI-generated video detection as a streaming task. It first uses lightweight features parsed directly from the compressed bitstream, then escalates only low-confidence segments to a more expensive visual model. With anytime-valid thresholds and a staged escalation policy, the detector can act before the entire video is decoded. The overall design turns large-scale moderation into cheap full-coverage prefiltering plus sparse expensive verification.
papers.story_zh: 电商短视频和直播录屏量大、时效强，逐帧像素级检测很难承受成本 -> 需要在不完整解码视频的前提下尽早发现 AIGC 风险，并只把少数难例交给重模型 -> 论文用压缩码流特征、随时有效阈值和分级上报机制完成低成本流式检测。
papers.story_en: E-commerce short videos and livestream recordings are too numerous for full pixel-level analysis -> the system needs to detect suspicious AIGC content as early as possible and escalate only hard cases -> use compressed-bitstream features, anytime thresholds, and deferral to enable low-cost streaming detection.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点集中在治理系统设计：检测入口从像素域前移到码流域，同时把早停判断、置信度控制和分级升级整合在一个 anytime 流式框架里。这非常适合达人内容治理中的 AI 换脸、AI 造景、AI 商品演示视频识别。
papers.innovation_en: The main novelty is moving the moderation entry point from pixel space to bitstream space while integrating early stopping and escalation in one anytime framework. This is highly aligned with creator-governance workloads at platform scale.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 公开网页信息显示：在 CPU 上其计算量比像素级 CNN 低 5 个数量级，在 GenVidBench 上获得 0.64 全长 AUC；当仅将约 15% 片段升级给高阶模型时，准确率可由 0.75 提升到 0.78，总体算力仍较全量像素分析低约 7 倍。
papers.key_metrics_en: Publicly available details indicate CPU-side compute that is five orders of magnitude lower than pixel-level CNN baselines while reaching 0.64 full-length AUC on GenVidBench. Escalating only about 15% of segments improves accuracy from 0.75 to 0.78 while keeping total compute roughly 7x lower than full pixel analysis.

papers.rationale_zh: 多目标生成式推荐与电商内容生态的业务约束高度契合，推理时控制多目标的设计也很有工程价值。由于公开代码暂未确认，因此本轮按论文核心思想补充了一个可运行的 toy PyTorch 复现，保留了生成式 slate 模型、原对偶约束更新和多目标评测接口。
papers.rationale_en: 多目标生成式推荐与电商内容生态的业务约束高度契合，推理时控制多目标的设计也很有工程价值。由于公开代码暂未确认，因此本轮按论文核心思想补充了一个可运行的 toy PyTorch 复现，保留了生成式 slate 模型、原对偶约束更新和多目标评测接口。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文把生成式推荐中的序列生成问题改写为带约束的多目标优化：既要最大化用户相关性，又要兼顾公平性、商业目标或新内容曝光等辅助目标。为此作者提出随机原对偶解码，在解码阶段对 logits 注入对偶变量控制，让模型边生成边根据约束违反程度更新权重，而不必事后重排或重新训练整个模型。该方法给出关于约束违反与 regret 的理论保证，并在大规模真实场景中验证在线收益。它的亮点是把多目标博弈直接嵌进生成式推荐的 decoding 环节。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper reformulates generative recommendation as constrained multi-objective sequence generation. Its stochastic primal-dual decoder adjusts token logits with dual variables during decoding so that relevance and auxiliary goals such as fairness or business objectives are balanced on the fly, without expensive retraining or post-hoc reranking. The method also provides theoretical guarantees on regret and constraint violation. The key contribution is pushing multi-objective control directly into the decoding loop.
papers.story_zh: 生成式推荐常常只优化用户相关性，平台却还需要兼顾商业目标、内容多样性和新作者扶持 -> 如果靠后处理重排，往往会破坏生成分布或带来额外系统复杂度 -> 论文把约束优化直接放进 decoding，用随机原对偶更新在生成时实时平衡多个目标。
papers.story_en: Generative recommenders often optimize only user relevance, while platforms also care about business goals, diversity, and creator exposure -> post-hoc reranking adds complexity and can distort the generative distribution -> move constraint optimization into decoding through stochastic primal-dual updates.
papers.innovation_zh: 方法创新性较强：它不是改训练损失，而是在推理阶段通过 primal-dual 机制完成多目标控制，既减少重训成本，也便于在线调权。对电商内容生态来说，这类方法非常适合同时控制转化率、内容丰富度、达人曝光公平和新商品冷启动。
papers.innovation_en: This is a strong inference-time innovation: instead of redesigning the training objective, it introduces primal-dual control into decoding for online multi-objective balancing. That is highly relevant to e-commerce ranking and recommendation systems with competing platform objectives.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 公开网页信息显示：Spotify 真实推荐场景在线 A/B 中，辅助目标提升约 +1.8%，且用户满意度相关指标基本零损失；论文同时声明离线实验在多目标 trade-off 上优于传统启发式或 reranking 方案。
papers.key_metrics_en: Public information indicates about +1.8% improvement on the auxiliary objective in a large-scale Spotify online A/B test with essentially no loss on user satisfaction metrics. The paper also reports better offline multi-objective trade-offs than heuristic and reranking alternatives.

papers.title: Silent Failures in Multimodal Agentic Search: A Diagnostic Taxonomy and Cross-Judge Evaluation
papers.authors: ["Zhengxian Wu", "Junjie Gao", "Kai Yang"]
papers.source: arXiv / Multimodal Agentic Search / 弱相关热点
papers.tags: ["Multimodal Agent", "Search", "Reliability", "Evaluation"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 24, "results": 10, "exp_quality": 11, "efficiency": 7, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 20, "total": 76, "rationale_zh": "对多模态搜索 Agent 的可靠性治理很有启发，但更偏评估框架而非直接提升效果的方法；同时公开网页层面的量化细节有限，因此本轮作为弱相关热点关注，不触发代码复现。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 对多模态搜索 Agent 的可靠性治理很有启发，但更偏评估框架而非直接提升效果的方法；同时公开网页层面的量化细节有限，因此本轮作为弱相关热点关注，不触发代码复现。
papers.rationale_en: 对多模态搜索 Agent 的可靠性治理很有启发，但更偏评估框架而非直接提升效果的方法；同时公开网页层面的量化细节有限，因此本轮作为弱相关热点关注，不触发代码复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文关注多模态 Agent Search 中的‘静默失败’：最终答案看似正确，但检索证据、模态对齐或中间推理轨迹其实已经出错。作者提出六类错误分类，包括模态捷径、幻觉接地、证据错位等，并构建轨迹级诊断评估管线，用多法官（人工、LLM、VLM）交叉评审 agent 的全过程，而不只看最终答案。工作重点不在提升某个模型分数，而在揭示随着模型能力增强，失败模式会变得更隐蔽。高光点在于把多模态搜索 agent 的‘过程正确性’独立出来评估。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper studies silent failures in multimodal agentic search, where the final answer looks correct but the evidence retrieval or grounding trajectory is actually wrong. It proposes a six-type diagnostic taxonomy and a trajectory-level evaluation pipeline with cross-judge assessment from humans, LLMs, and VLMs. The focus is not on maximizing one benchmark score, but on exposing hidden reliability risks as models become stronger. Its main contribution is to make process correctness a first-class evaluation target for multimodal agents.
papers.story_zh: 多模态搜索 agent 的最终答案可能偶然正确，但证据检索和接地过程早已偏离，这会让线上系统产生不可见风险 -> 需要一种能诊断 agent 轨迹级错误类型的评估体系，而不是只看 answer accuracy -> 论文提出静默失败 taxonomy 和 cross-judge 评估框架。
papers.story_en: A multimodal search agent can produce the right answer for the wrong reasons, creating invisible production risk -> answer accuracy alone is insufficient -> introduce a silent-failure taxonomy and cross-judge trajectory evaluation for process-level diagnosis.
papers.innovation_zh: 这类工作更偏评估与诊断创新，但对工业系统非常重要。对于电商搜索、拍照搜同款、AI 导购问答等场景，‘证据错位但答案碰巧正确’是非常危险的失败模式，因此这篇论文对治理 Agent 可信度很有参考价值。
papers.innovation_en: This is primarily an evaluation and diagnostics contribution, but it is highly relevant to trustworthy multimodal search and shopping-assistant systems where evidence grounding matters as much as the answer itself.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 公开网页信息表明：论文系统性展示了六类静默失败随模型规模变化的迁移现象，指出最终答案准确率无法充分反映证据接地质量；更多量化表格需阅读全文确认。
papers.key_metrics_en: Publicly visible information shows six silent-failure categories and highlights that answer accuracy does not reliably capture grounding quality; full quantitative tables still require full-paper reading.

papers.title: GMO-E2DIT: Grounded Multi-Operation Editing for E-Commerce Images
papers.authors: ["Zipeng Guo", "Xiaoan Liu", "Lichen Ma", "Cheng Wang", "Yu He", "Xiaolong Fu", "Jingling Fu", "Xinyuan Shan", "Shaojie Guo", "Luohang Liu", "Junshi Huang", "Yan Li"]

papers.tags: ["E-commerce", "VLM Agent", "Image Editing", "Content Quality"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 25, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 14, "efficiency": 7, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 25, "total": 88, "rationale_zh": "强电商场景、方法闭环完整、指标明显优于闭源强基线，实验覆盖模糊指令、精确指令和人评；效率项略低，因为依赖 VLM agent 与多轮反思。未发现原文提供可用代码，因此已按论文核心流程做 toy PyTorch 复现。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 强电商场景、方法闭环完整、指标明显优于闭源强基线，实验覆盖模糊指令、精确指令和人评；效率项略低，因为依赖 VLM agent 与多轮反思。未发现原文提供可用代码，因此已按论文核心流程做 toy PyTorch 复现。
papers.rationale_en: 强电商场景、方法闭环完整、指标明显优于闭源强基线，实验覆盖模糊指令、精确指令和人评；效率项略低，因为依赖 VLM agent 与多轮反思。未发现原文提供可用代码，因此已按论文核心流程做 toy PyTorch 复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: GMO-E2DIT 把电商图片编辑重新定义为 grounded multi-operation task completion，而不是一次性全局生成。VLM agent 先把模糊自然语言指令拆成区域绑定的 edit agenda，包括 add/remove/move/replace/exchange 等操作、源/目标区域和约束；mask-conditioned editor 再按子程序执行。反思循环会检查中间结果并决定 success/continue/rollback，保留已完成的安全局部进展并重试失败操作。论文还构建电商编辑数据管线与 EComEditBench，对规划、执行、反思进行对齐监督。
papers.method_overview_en: GMO-E2DIT formulates e-commerce image editing as grounded multi-operation task completion. A VLM agent converts ambiguous instructions into a region-grounded edit agenda, a mask-conditioned editor executes each sub-program, and a reflection loop marks operations as success, continue, or rollback.
papers.story_zh: 电商图的 Logo、贴纸、价格标签、文案块等元素有业务意义，一次性编辑很容易只完成一部分或误改背景 -> 需要先显式规划“改哪里、做什么、如何验收” -> GMO-E2DIT 用 VLM 规划+mask 编辑器执行+反思回路，把不可控生成变成可审计的多操作流程。
papers.story_en: E-commerce images contain business-critical local elements, so one-shot editing often misses operations or corrupts untouched content -> make every operation explicit and auditable -> combine VLM planning, mask-conditioned execution, and reflective verification.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点非常贴合电商内容生态：把本来黑盒的一步图像编辑拆成可追踪 edit agenda 与可回滚执行状态，并把 VLM 从辅助 prompt 生成提升为 planner + judge。与传统 mask/box-guided editor 相比，它不要求用户手工标注区域；与 one-shot editor 相比，它能显式保留未编辑区域并处理组合指令。
papers.innovation_en: The paper turns black-box editing into a traceable program of grounded operations. Compared with one-shot editors, it separates cognitive reasoning from rendering; compared with mask-guided editors, it does not require users to manually annotate regions.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 EComEditBench precise setting 中总体 IA/EF/BP 达到 9.82/9.62/9.85，超过 Nano Banana Pro 的 9.18/9.01/9.49 和 Seedream 5.0 的 9.29/9.04/9.49；1000 个 fuzzy-instruction 人评中，GMO-E2DIT 在 instruction following 上相对三类强基线获得 36.3%、40.4%、46.6% 偏好率，对手分别为 28.5%、26.6%、21.2%。
papers.key_metrics_en: On EComEditBench precise setting, GMO-E2DIT reaches 9.82/9.62/9.85 overall IA/EF/BP, outperforming Nano Banana Pro at 9.18/9.01/9.49 and Seedream 5.0 at 9.29/9.04/9.49. In a 1,000-case user study, it is preferred for instruction following at 36.3%, 40.4%, and 46.6% against three strong baselines.

papers.title: Real-Time Hard Negative Sampling via LLM-based Clustering for Large-Scale Two-Tower Retrieval
papers.authors: ["Authors not fully disclosed in parsed preview"]
papers.tags: ["Recommendation", "Retrieval", "LLM Clustering", "E-commerce"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 23, "results": 14, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 24, "total": 87, "rationale_zh": "这是强电商召回基础设施论文：相关性与线上指标都很高，且兼顾效果、偏置缓解和工业吞吐；创新性主要是系统与采样设计，理论新颖度略低于 MLLM 方法。未发现原文代码，因此已复现可运行的两塔+簇负采样 pipeline。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 这是强电商召回基础设施论文：相关性与线上指标都很高，且兼顾效果、偏置缓解和工业吞吐；创新性主要是系统与采样设计，理论新颖度略低于 MLLM 方法。未发现原文代码，因此已复现可运行的两塔+簇负采样 pipeline。
papers.rationale_en: 这是强电商召回基础设施论文：相关性与线上指标都很高，且兼顾效果、偏置缓解和工业吞吐；创新性主要是系统与采样设计，理论新颖度略低于 MLLM 方法。未发现原文代码，因此已复现可运行的两塔+簇负采样 pipeline。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文提出 GOOBS/Cluster GOOBS：在两塔召回训练中维护实时 out-of-batch item pool，并利用 LLM-based item clustering 从正样本同语义簇中在线抽取 hard negatives。它解决 in-batch negatives 覆盖不足、随机 OOB negatives 太容易、以及点击反馈导致流行度偏置的问题。工程上通过 update engine 与 sampling engine 在训练中持续刷新 item pool，使 hard negative 生成可工业级扩展。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper proposes GOOBS / Cluster GOOBS for two-tower retrieval. It maintains a real-time out-of-batch item pool and samples semantically hard negatives from the same LLM-derived item cluster as the positive item, addressing limited in-batch exposure, overly easy random OOB negatives, and popularity bias.
papers.story_zh: 大规模电商召回需要两塔模型高效检索，但负样本要么太少、要么太容易、还会放大热门物品偏置 -> 需要实时、语义相近、可扩展的困难负样本 -> Cluster GOOBS 用 LLM 聚类把同类目/同语义 item 作为在线 hard negatives，并保持训练/服务一致性。
papers.story_en: Large-scale e-commerce retrieval needs efficient two-tower training, but negatives are either too few, too easy, or popularity-biased -> sample real-time semantic hard negatives -> use LLM-based clusters and a scalable update/sampling engine.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新主要在工程化负采样系统：不是离线 ANN 周期刷新，也不是固定 batch 内负样本，而是通过簇索引把 semantic hard negatives 实时注入训练。LLM clustering 让“难负样本”更贴近内容语义，对电商商品/达人/内容向量召回与相似内容治理都有直接价值。
papers.innovation_en: The novelty is a production-oriented hard-negative system rather than another static loss. It injects semantic hard negatives online without global ANN refresh, making the retrieval model sharper and less popularity-biased.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 公开数据集上 Cluster GOOBS 在所有数据集和 HR@50/HR@100 指标均最佳；相对 in-batch baseline，MovieLens-1M HR@50 +7.2%，Amazon-Grocery HR@50 +55.6%，Amazon-Electronics HR@50 +47.3%，Amazon-Home HR@100 +42.3%。工业线上作为一个 retrieval source 时，其 served impressions CTR 相比旧 source +53%，训练 QPS 仅 -1.4%，推理 QPS 无回退。
papers.key_metrics_en: Cluster GOOBS is best on all reported public HR@50/HR@100 metrics, with gains such as +55.6% HR@50 on Amazon-Grocery, +47.3% HR@50 on Amazon-Electronics, and +42.3% HR@100 on Amazon-Home. In production, the retrieval source achieves +53% CTR on served impressions with only -1.4% training QPS and no inference QPS regression.

papers.title: DeltaV: Thinking with Visual State Updates in Unified Large Multimodal Models
papers.authors: ["Pengjie Wang", "Linger Deng", "Zujia Zhang", "Shaojie Zhang", "Zhenbo Luo", "Pei Fu", "Jian Luan", "Xiang Bai", "Yuliang Liu"]
papers.affiliations: ["Huazhong University of Science and Technology", "Alibaba Group"]
papers.source: arXiv / Unified MLLM / 今日巡检热点
papers.tags: ["MLLM", "Visual Reasoning", "Token Efficiency", "Content Understanding"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 27, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 5, "relevance": 19, "total": 86, "rationale_zh": "方法创新很强，直接解决 MLLM 视觉状态冗余；实验指标覆盖效率与推理效果，且包含大规模 StructCoT。与电商强相关度不是最高，但对图文内容理解、局部变化审核、商品图编辑审查非常有迁移价值。原文代码仓库已确认存在且包含 deltav/modeling、tsim_router、inference、data_processing 等实现文件，因此不再重复复现。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 方法创新很强，直接解决 MLLM 视觉状态冗余；实验指标覆盖效率与推理效果，且包含大规模 StructCoT。与电商强相关度不是最高，但对图文内容理解、局部变化审核、商品图编辑审查非常有迁移价值。原文代码仓库已确认存在且包含 deltav/modeling、tsim_router、inference、data_processing 等实现文件，因此不再重复复现。
papers.rationale_en: 方法创新很强，直接解决 MLLM 视觉状态冗余；实验指标覆盖效率与推理效果，且包含大规模 StructCoT。与电商强相关度不是最高，但对图文内容理解、局部变化审核、商品图编辑审查非常有迁移价值。原文代码仓库已确认存在且包含 deltav/modeling、tsim_router、inference、data_processing 等实现文件，因此不再重复复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: DeltaV 面向 unified large multimodal models 的多步图文推理，核心是把每一步完整生成一张视觉状态图，改成只生成相对上一状态的 compact visual update tokens。它用 TSIM Router 根据视觉变化幅度动态决定 token 预算，边际重建收益低于阈值时停止分配 token，从而减少重复建模未变化区域。论文还构建 StructCoT，覆盖 44 个任务域、105 万样本，用于训练更泛化的 interleaved multimodal reasoning。高光点在于把视觉推理中的“状态演进”显式增量化，直接对应电商内容理解里商品图局部变化、违规要素定位、图文一致性校验等场景。
papers.method_overview_en: DeltaV replaces full-image intermediate-state generation in unified large multimodal models with compact visual update tokens. A TSIM Router dynamically allocates the update-token budget according to the magnitude of visual change, stopping when marginal reconstruction gain falls below a threshold. The paper also introduces StructCoT, a 1.05M-sample interleaved multimodal reasoning dataset across 44 domains.
papers.story_zh: 现有 ULMM 在多步推理时每步重画整图，视觉 token 冗余大且稀疏关键变化被稀释 -> 需要只关注状态差异，并让 token 预算随变化量自适应 -> DeltaV 用 visual update token 与 TSIM Router 取代 full-image state generation。
papers.story_en: Existing ULMMs redraw full visual states at every reasoning step, wasting visual tokens and diluting sparse but critical state changes -> model only the delta between states -> use visual update tokens plus a temporal-similarity router for adaptive token budgets.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点合理且工程价值强：它没有继续堆大模型，而是改变中间视觉状态的表示粒度，把“完整图像监督”变成“差分视觉监督”。与普通压缩或 token pruning 不同，DeltaV 的预算由跨状态相似度驱动，能把计算集中到真正变化的区域；这对电商图文审核中局部贴纸、文本、Logo、违规元素变化尤其契合。
papers.innovation_en: The key novelty is representing visual reasoning as state deltas rather than repeated full images. Unlike generic pruning, DeltaV allocates visual budget by temporal similarity, focusing supervision and compute on changed regions.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文摘要报告：visual-update paradigm 平均减少 55.6% 新生成视觉 token，同时 multimodal reasoning 较 full-image generation 提升 3.3%；DeltaV-2B 在 in-domain multimodal reasoning 上超过更大开源模型 8.4%，在外部 multimodal reasoning/understanding benchmark 上超过同尺度 Qwen3-VL-2B 5.9%。
papers.key_metrics_en: The abstract reports 55.6% fewer newly generated visual tokens on average, +3.3% reasoning over full-image generation, +8.4% over larger open-source models on in-domain reasoning, and +5.9% over Qwen3-VL-2B on external multimodal reasoning/understanding benchmarks.

papers.method_overview_zh: 论文提出 Cognitive-structured Multimodal Agent，把长期多模态对话中的视觉历史外置为 Episodic Visual Memory，再由 Perceptual Abstraction Engine、Cognitive Retrieval Engine 与 Multimodal Executive Controller 分别负责视觉抽象、跨轮检索和任务执行。Unified Scenario Engine 自动生成带 turn-level retrieval annotation 的多轮对话，用 SFT+RL 优化记忆写入与检索策略。CMA-Harness 则把同一结构扩展到持久记忆、网页访问、图像生成/编辑/合成与 OpenAI-compatible serving。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper externalizes visual history into Episodic Visual Memory and decomposes long-horizon multimodal dialogue into perceptual abstraction, cognitive retrieval, and executive control. A Unified Scenario Engine generates retrieval-supervised multi-turn dialogues, and SFT+RL optimizes memory writing and retrieval policies.
papers.story_zh: 统一多模态模型在长对话中反复塞入全部历史图片，导致视觉 token 爆炸和跨轮引用漂移 -> 需要把视觉记忆结构化外置，并按当前问题检索相关片段 -> CMA 用 PAE/EVM/CoRE/MEC 将记忆、检索、执行模块化。
papers.story_en: Unified multimodal models keep feeding all historical images into context, causing visual-token explosion and cross-turn drift -> externalize and retrieve visual memory -> modularize abstraction, retrieval, and execution.
papers.innovation_zh: 它的价值在 agent 架构：把多模态长上下文问题从“更大模型+全上下文”改成“结构化视觉记忆+可学习检索+模块化执行”。这对电商达人治理的多轮证据核查、内容溯源、跨图对比很有潜力，但论文主场景是通用多模态生成/编辑，对电商强相关度不如 GMO-E2DIT。
papers.innovation_en: The main innovation is an agentic memory architecture for multimodal dialogue: structured visual memory and learned retrieval replace brute-force all-context scaling.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 8B agent 在 20-turn English sessions 上 retrieval accuracy 达 91.4%，中文 89.6%，超过最强 32B agent baseline +8.2%；per-turn inference time 从 23.1s 降至 12.7s。Hard subset 中从 72.1% 提升到 82.0%，并且 M2CA-Bench generation quality 达 8.49。
papers.key_metrics_en: The 8B agent reaches 91.4% English and 89.6% Chinese retrieval accuracy over 20-turn sessions, exceeds the strongest 32B baseline by +8.2%, and reduces per-turn inference time from 23.1s to 12.7s.

papers.method_overview_zh: 论文讨论 multimodal RAG 中“模态相关性”不等于“模态效用”：不是问题看起来需要图像就一定调用昂贵 VLM，而是在文本/表格管线先尝试回答后，再 post-hoc 判断是否需要升级到图像模态。它适合电商治理中的证据检索：优先低成本文本/结构化证据，只有当答案不充分或图像证据关键时才调用 VLM。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper argues that modality relevance is not the same as modality utility in multimodal RAG. Instead of deciding upfront whether every image needs expensive VLM processing, it first attempts a cheaper text/table answer and then escalates to image evidence only when the expected utility is high.
papers.story_zh: 多模态 RAG 预先决定是否看图，会导致要么成本过高、要么漏用关键视觉证据 -> 需要在初步答案之后判断图像是否真正带来增量效用 -> Post-hoc selective modality escalation 以效用而非相关性触发升级。
papers.story_en: Pre-retrieval modality choice either overuses VLMs or misses useful visual evidence -> estimate utility after a first answer -> selectively escalate modality for cost-aware multimodal RAG.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新是决策时机与目标函数的转变：从 pre-retrieval relevance prediction 转向 post-answer utility estimation。对大规模治理系统很实用，因为成本控制和召回充分性同样重要。
papers.innovation_en: The key shift is from relevance prediction to post-answer utility estimation, which is directly useful for scalable governance evidence retrieval.

papers.title: Beyond Semantic IDs: Encoding Business-Value Ranking into Document Identifiers for Generative Retrieval
papers.authors: ["Gui Ling", "Zhihong Chen", "Yu Li", "Tong Xiong", "Kunhai Lin", "Kaixuan Zhang", "Yuliang Yan", "Dan Ou", "Haihong Tang", "Bo Zheng"]
papers.source: arXiv / E-commerce / Generative Retrieval / Business Value

papers.score_breakdown: {"total": 85, "innovation": 25, "results": 14, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 8, "generalization": 3, "relevance": 23, "rationale_zh": "CRID 针对 generative retrieval 的核心瓶颈——DocID 设计——提出“语义聚类 + 商业价值排序”解耦：先做 collision-free 的语义聚类，再在簇内按业务价值重排生成 DocID，使得 ID 的学习目标与 GMV/排序目标一致，并支持增量更新（簇内 reranking）。在 3 亿规模淘宝语料上超过最强 embedding baseline，并在全流量实验带来 +1.06% GMV，属于非常典型的电商检索/排序直接增量论文。"}
papers.rationale_zh: CRID 针对 generative retrieval 的核心瓶颈——DocID 设计——提出“语义聚类 + 商业价值排序”解耦：先做 collision-free 的语义聚类，再在簇内按业务价值重排生成 DocID，使得 ID 的学习目标与 GMV/排序目标一致，并支持增量更新（簇内 reranking）。在 3 亿规模淘宝语料上超过最强 embedding baseline，并在全流量实验带来 +1.06% GMV，属于非常典型的电商检索/排序直接增量论文。
papers.rationale_en: CRID 针对 generative retrieval 的核心瓶颈——DocID 设计——提出“语义聚类 + 商业价值排序”解耦：先做 collision-free 的语义聚类，再在簇内按业务价值重排生成 DocID，使得 ID 的学习目标与 GMV/排序目标一致，并支持增量更新（簇内 reranking）。在 3 亿规模淘宝语料上超过最强 embedding baseline，并在全流量实验带来 +1.06% GMV，属于非常典型的电商检索/排序直接增量论文。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文研究 Generative Retrieval（把检索变成 seq2seq 生成 DocID），指出现有 DocID 学习方案存在 collision 与“ID 编码目标 ≠ 业务优化目标”的错配。作者提出 Cluster-Ranked Identifier（CRID）：将 DocID 设计解耦为两步——(1) 语义聚类：为文档分配 collision-free 的 cluster；(2) 簇内排序：在每个 cluster 内按业务价值（如成交/转化相关信号）进行 reranking，把业务 prior 编进 DocID 的 token 序列中。该设计还支持增量更新：新增文档仅需在簇内重排而不破坏全局 ID 体系。论文同时给出一个分析框架，将收益拆分为个性化偏好与统计先验泛化，并指出 cluster size 决定二者平衡。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper studies DocID design for Generative Retrieval and identifies collisions and misalignment between DocID learning objectives and business ranking targets. CRID decouples DocIDs into semantic clustering (collision-free groups) and intra-cluster business-value ranking, encoding business priors directly into the identifier sequence while supporting incremental updates via intra-cluster reranking. It also provides an analysis that decomposes gains into personalized preference and statistical-prior generalization.
papers.story_zh: GR 的效果高度依赖 DocID，但现有 DocID 会碰撞且很难对齐业务目标 -> 把 DocID 拆成“语义聚类 + 簇内业务排序” -> collision-free 且能把业务 prior 编进生成空间，并支持增量更新 -> 线上 GMV 取得可观增量。
papers.story_en: DocID quality is the bottleneck of generative retrieval -> collisions and objective mismatch hurt online value -> decouple DocIDs into semantic clusters plus business-value ranks -> achieve both offline improvements and measurable GMV lift.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点在于把“DocID 既要表达语义又要表达业务价值”的冲突显式拆开：语义负责分桶避免碰撞，业务负责簇内序位对齐线上目标；这种结构化 ID 设计比纯离散表征学习更可控、更利于线上增量维护。对电商而言，这是把 generative retrieval 从学术指标直接拉到 GMV 的可落地路线。
papers.innovation_en: CRID separates semantics (for collision-free grouping) from business value (for ordering within clusters), making DocIDs controllable, maintainable, and aligned with online objectives.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 3 亿（300M）商品规模淘宝语料上，CRID 在 top-K Hitrate 上超过最强 embedding-based retrieval baseline；并在全流量线上部署带来 +1.06% GMV（论文报告）。
papers.key_metrics_en: On a 300M-item Taobao corpus, CRID outperforms the strongest embedding-based retrieval baseline on top-K hitrate and delivers +1.06% GMV in full-traffic deployment.

papers.rationale_zh: EVQA 把“可解释/可核验”从附加文字解释推进到像素级证据：输出答案的同时给出 temporal segment + tracked masklets，让回答可回溯到具体帧与目标实例。这类 evidence-backed 输出非常契合内容治理、申诉与复核链路（能直接拿证据对齐规则）。论文还给出 ST-Evidence（human-verified）与 160k 规模的 ST-Evidence-Instruct 自动生成数据，并在 7B 级别带来显著增益，且代码数据公开，落地门槛较低。
papers.rationale_en: EVQA 把“可解释/可核验”从附加文字解释推进到像素级证据：输出答案的同时给出 temporal segment + tracked masklets，让回答可回溯到具体帧与目标实例。这类 evidence-backed 输出非常契合内容治理、申诉与复核链路（能直接拿证据对齐规则）。论文还给出 ST-Evidence（human-verified）与 160k 规模的 ST-Evidence-Instruct 自动生成数据，并在 7B 级别带来显著增益，且代码数据公开，落地门槛较低。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文提出 Evidence-Backed Video QA（E-VQA）：模型不仅输出语义答案，还必须输出精确的时空证据，包括时间段（temporal segments）与可跟踪的目标分割 masklets（dense, tracked object segmentation）。为此作者构建 ST-Evidence：首个面向判别式/生成式、像素级 grounding 的 human-verified 基准；并提出可扩展的自动化生成流水线，产出 160k 规模的 ST-Evidence-Instruct，将高层推理与细粒度视觉证据对齐，用于微调 grounded Video LLM。
papers.method_overview_en: EVQA introduces Evidence-Backed Video QA (E-VQA), where models must output both the semantic answer and precise spatio-temporal evidence: temporal segments plus dense tracked segmentation masklets. The paper releases ST-Evidence, a human-verified benchmark for pixel-level grounding, and a scalable pipeline that produces ST-Evidence-Instruct (160k) to fine-tune grounded Video LLMs.
papers.story_zh: 现有 Video LLM 虽能答对，但缺少可核验依据，治理与审计不可用 -> 定义必须同时给出答案与像素级时空证据的 E-VQA -> 先建 human-verified 基准，再用可扩展流水线生成 160k 指令数据 -> 让模型真正学会“用证据说话”。
papers.story_en: Video LLMs can answer correctly but remain unauditable -> require answers plus spatio-temporal evidence -> build a human-verified benchmark and scale supervision via automated data generation -> train models to be evidence-grounded.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点在于把视频 QA 的“解释性”升级为可机器评测、可复核的证据输出（masklet + 时段），从而把黑盒回答变成可审计结果；同时用自动化数据生成把像素级标注扩展到 160k 量级，解决传统人工标注难以规模化的问题。对治理场景尤其关键：证据可以直接用于规则匹配、争议复核与 failure case 归因。
papers.innovation_en: It elevates explainability from free-form text rationales to auditable pixel-level evidence. The scalable data generation pipeline makes fine-grained grounding supervision practical at large scale, which is critical for governance and review.
papers.key_metrics_zh: ST-Evidence-Instruct 规模约 160k。用该数据微调后，7B 模型相对 size-matched UniPixel baseline 提升 +27.2 t-mean 与 +13.8 J&F（论文示例设置），展示 QA 正确率与真实感知/grounding 之间的“脱钩”可被数据显著缓解。
papers.key_metrics_en: ST-Evidence-Instruct contains ~160k examples. Fine-tuning a 7B model yields +27.2 t-mean and +13.8 J&F over a size-matched UniPixel baseline.

papers.title: Read It Back: Pretrained MLLMs Are Zero-Shot Reward Models for Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: ["Runhui Huang", "Qihui Zhang", "Zhe Liu", "Yu Gao", "Jie Wu", "Hengshuang Zhao"]
papers.affiliations: ["The University of Hong Kong", "ByteDance Seed", "Peking University"]
papers.source: arXiv / 今日热点 / AIGC 内容质量
papers.tags: ["AIGC", "Reward Model", "MLLM", "Text-to-Image", "Content Quality"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"total": 81, "innovation": 25, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 14, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 5, "relevance": 15, "rationale_zh": "SpectraReward 把预训练 MLLM 直接变成“零样本奖励模型”：不做偏好标注/不做 RM 微调，而是用 teacher-forced 的 prompt log-likelihood 来衡量“生成图能否被读回原始意图”。这种 read-it-back 视角等价于把对齐问题转为可度量的信息恢复问题，既训练-free、又天然兼容不同扩散 policy 与 RL 算法。更重要的是它能落到 AIGC 内容质量与对齐：对电商图生图/广告素材/图文一致性，reward 可以直连“提示词可恢复性/文本一致性”，并在 GenEval、DPG-Bench 等 OOD 评测上带来稳定提升。"}
papers.rationale_zh: SpectraReward 把预训练 MLLM 直接变成“零样本奖励模型”：不做偏好标注/不做 RM 微调，而是用 teacher-forced 的 prompt log-likelihood 来衡量“生成图能否被读回原始意图”。这种 read-it-back 视角等价于把对齐问题转为可度量的信息恢复问题，既训练-free、又天然兼容不同扩散 policy 与 RL 算法。更重要的是它能落到 AIGC 内容质量与对齐：对电商图生图/广告素材/图文一致性，reward 可以直连“提示词可恢复性/文本一致性”，并在 GenEval、DPG-Bench 等 OOD 评测上带来稳定提升。
papers.rationale_en: SpectraReward 把预训练 MLLM 直接变成“零样本奖励模型”：不做偏好标注/不做 RM 微调，而是用 teacher-forced 的 prompt log-likelihood 来衡量“生成图能否被读回原始意图”。这种 read-it-back 视角等价于把对齐问题转为可度量的信息恢复问题，既训练-free、又天然兼容不同扩散 policy 与 RL 算法。更重要的是它能落到 AIGC 内容质量与对齐：对电商图生图/广告素材/图文一致性，reward 可以直连“提示词可恢复性/文本一致性”，并在 GenEval、DPG-Bench 等 OOD 评测上带来稳定提升。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文提出 SpectraReward：把预训练 MLLM 当作现成 reward model，用一次 image-conditioned、teacher-forced forward pass 计算“prompt 被读回的平均对数似然”（prompt log-likelihood），作为 text-to-image 强化学习的奖励。与让 MLLM 直接打分/问答式验证不同，它把奖励定义为“生成图对原始文本意图的信息可恢复性”。进一步，作者提出 Self-SpectraReward：在统一多模态模型（同一骨干既能理解也能生成）的场景下，用其理解分支给生成分支打分，形成无需外部 RM 的闭环自我改进。
papers.method_overview_en: SpectraReward turns a frozen pretrained MLLM into an off-the-shelf reward model for text-to-image RL. It scores a generated image by the teacher-forced, image-conditioned log-likelihood of recovering the original prompt (prompt log-likelihood). The paper further introduces Self-SpectraReward for unified multimodal models, where the model’s own understanding branch rewards its generation branch, forming a closed-loop self-improving setup.
papers.story_zh: 图生图 RL 的瓶颈是“奖励难做”：偏好数据贵、RM 迁移差、模型越大也不一定更稳定 -> 把奖励改成“能否把 prompt 从图里读回来”的条件似然 -> 用现成 MLLM 即插即用做 reward，并进一步用 Self-SpectraReward 把 reward 和 policy 放进同一多模态体系统一对齐。
papers.story_en: T2I RL is bottlenecked by costly or brittle reward modeling -> define reward as prompt recoverability from the generated image -> reuse frozen MLLMs as plug-and-play reward models, and close the loop via Self-SpectraReward.
papers.innovation_zh: 核心创新是 reward 定义的“读回范式”：将对齐/质量度量从主观打分转为可计算的条件似然，从而做到训练-free、可迁移、且对 reward-policy 的表示对齐更友好；Self-SpectraReward 则把 reward-policy 对齐显式内生化，减少“更大 RM 未必更好”的不稳定来源。对内容质量治理而言，它提供了一个可直接工程化的、面向文本一致性/提示词忠实度的奖励信号。
papers.innovation_en: The key innovation is a training-free “read-it-back” reward: alignment is measured as conditional likelihood (information recoverability) rather than subjective judgments. Self-SpectraReward internalizes reward-policy alignment, reducing instability where a larger external reward model is not necessarily better.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在五个 OOD 图像生成评测上（GenEval、TIIF-Bench、DPG-Bench、GenEval2、WISE）一致提升。以 512 分辨率为例，GenEval 从 BAGEL 的 84.0 提升到 88.3（SpectraReward）/ 89.5（Self-SpectraReward），DPG-Bench 从 85.0 提升到 88.1；同时覆盖 2 个扩散模型、3 种 RL 算法、9 个 reward MLLM（4B–235B）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Across five out-of-distribution T2I benchmarks, SpectraReward consistently improves generation quality. At 512 resolution, GenEval improves from 84.0 to 88.3 (SpectraReward) / 89.5 (Self-), and DPGBench improves from 85.0 to 88.1. papers.method_overview_zh: 论文指出单视角视频理解在体育场景会被遮挡、快速运动与复杂交互卡死，而真实比赛依赖多机位证据。作者提出 SportMV-Bench：从官方比赛多机位录像构建的多视角基准，涵盖 787 个 multi-view bundles 与 2592 个 QA，任务分为 PAR（感知识别）、REI（规则事件解释）与 ADR（裁决推理）。在此基础上提出 SportMV-Agent：通过“主动视角选择 → 感知工具执行 → 证据驱动推理”的迭代闭环，让模型更有效利用多视角信息。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper introduces SportMV-Bench, a multi-view sports video benchmark built from official match recordings (787 multi-view bundles, 2592 QA pairs) across perception-aware recognition, rule-aware event interpretation, and adjudicative decision reasoning. It also proposes SportMV-Agent, an iterative loop of active view selection, perception tool execution, and evidence-grounded reasoning to better exploit multi-camera evidence.
papers.story_zh: 单视角理解遇到遮挡与歧义 -> 引入多机位证据但模型不会“主动看” -> 用 benchmark 定位瓶颈在视角选择与细粒度感知 -> 通过 agent loop 主动选视角+工具感知，把多视角优势转成可验证增益。
papers.story_en: Single-view sports videos are ambiguous under occlusion -> multi-view evidence exists but is underused -> actively select views and extract perception evidence -> improve decision-level reasoning with verifiable cues.

papers.authors: ["Kirill Dubovikov", "Martin Takac", "Salem Lahlou"]

papers.score_breakdown: {"total": 68, "innovation": 20, "results": 11, "exp_quality": 11, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 2, "relevance": 15, "rationale_zh": "这篇工作解决“强 teacher 很大、线上代价高”的典型检索痛点：只用 teacher 的 score vectors（不依赖 hidden states）来蒸馏 compact retriever，并给出 row-centered 的 PairMSE（uniform all-pairs）实现，工程上更易接入现有向量检索链路。结果显示 0.6B student 编码速度显著提升，但跨协议/跨域 transfer 仍不稳定，因此适合作为“匹配协议下的压缩提速”方案。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 这篇工作解决“强 teacher 很大、线上代价高”的典型检索痛点：只用 teacher 的 score vectors（不依赖 hidden states）来蒸馏 compact retriever，并给出 row-centered 的 PairMSE（uniform all-pairs）实现，工程上更易接入现有向量检索链路。结果显示 0.6B student 编码速度显著提升，但跨协议/跨域 transfer 仍不稳定，因此适合作为“匹配协议下的压缩提速”方案。
papers.rationale_en: 这篇工作解决“强 teacher 很大、线上代价高”的典型检索痛点：只用 teacher 的 score vectors（不依赖 hidden states）来蒸馏 compact retriever，并给出 row-centered 的 PairMSE（uniform all-pairs）实现，工程上更易接入现有向量检索链路。结果显示 0.6B student 编码速度显著提升，但跨协议/跨域 transfer 仍不稳定，因此适合作为“匹配协议下的压缩提速”方案。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文研究 score-only distillation：学生模型不看 teacher 的中间表征，只学习 teacher 对候选集合的打分/排序行为。训练数据由“真阳性 + 负样本候选”组成的行（row）构建，目标函数采用 row-centered score-vector objective，并实现为内存友好的 uniform all-pairs PairMSE。作者还单独评估 student-teacher hard-negative mining 作为扩展。最终目标是在保持检索协议一致的前提下，把昂贵 teacher 排序能力压缩到更小的 student encoder。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper studies score-only distillation for dense retrieval: a compact student learns the teacher’s ranking behavior from score vectors without accessing teacher hidden states. Training uses rows composed of ground-truth positives and mined negatives, optimized with a row-centered score-vector objective implemented as a memory-efficient uniform all-pairs PairMSE.
papers.story_zh: 大 embedding teacher 效果好但线上太贵 -> 只取 teacher 的分数向量做蒸馏，不依赖内部表征 -> 用 row-centered PairMSE 学习排序行为 -> 得到更快的 compact encoder，同时在 matched protocol 下尽量保住效果。
papers.story_en: Large retrievers are effective but costly -> distill from teacher score vectors only -> train a compact student with row-centered PairMSE -> achieve major speedups while retaining a significant portion of teacher gains under matched protocols.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点是将蒸馏信号压缩到 score vectors，避免依赖 teacher hidden states/特定架构接口，从而更适合工业检索系统里“多 teacher 融合、异构模型、不可导组件”的现实；row-centered PairMSE 也更便于大规模训练与工程实现。
papers.innovation_en: By distilling only from score vectors, the method avoids reliance on teacher internals and is easier to integrate with heterogeneous or fused teacher systems. The row-centered PairMSE objective is also implementation-friendly at scale.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在固定 8-task 评测面板上，蒸馏最多可恢复 base-to-teacher gap 的 50%。0.6B student 的 query 编码速度比 sequential online teacher fusion 快 4.7×，document 编码快 9.7×（论文报告）。
papers.key_metrics_en: On an 8-task evaluation panel, the protocol recovers up to 50% of the base-to-teacher gap. The distilled 0.6B student is 4.7× faster for query encoding and 9.7× faster for document encoding than sequential online teacher fusion.

papers.rationale_zh: 把高控制资源只路由到高风险写操作前，思路非常适合达人治理申诉、处罚执行和运营工单。论文在 retail/airline focus set 上稳定提升可靠性，且 toy 复现可落成可运行 pipeline。
papers.rationale_en: 把高控制资源只路由到高风险写操作前，思路非常适合达人治理申诉、处罚执行和运营工单。论文在 retail/airline focus set 上稳定提升可靠性，且 toy 复现可落成可运行 pipeline。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文把客服 Agent 的风险控制问题 formalize 为“何时需要 reconsider before write”。核心架构包含一个轻量 Difficulty Router，用于把 routine session 留在低成本 baseline 路径，把 operationally coupled session 路由到 escalated workflow。升级路径在每次关键 backend write 前触发 pre-write reconsideration，并通过 conflict-aware communication 收集证据、绑定记录、拆解多实体请求。作者在 retail 与 airline 任务上证明，这种 selective control 比对所有请求一刀切加控制更有效。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper frames service-agent reliability as deciding when to reconsider before backend writes. A lightweight Difficulty Router keeps routine sessions on a cheap baseline path and routes operationally coupled sessions to an escalated workflow. The escalated path performs conflict-aware communication and write-triggered reconsideration before consequential writes. This selective control improves reliability on human-verified retail and airline tasks.
papers.story_zh: 统一低成本流程会在复杂请求上写错对象或顺序 -> 先用 router 识别 operational conflict，再在 write 前做 reconsideration 和证据核对 -> 把高强度控制集中用在真正高风险的请求上。
papers.story_en: Uniform low-cost execution fails on coupled requests -> route only conflict-heavy sessions to an escalated path -> verify evidence right before the write and preserve fallback plans.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点在于把 agent 可靠性问题从“更强模型”转成“把 deliberation 与 safeguards 放在最值钱的地方”。它不是给所有对话都增加反思，而是围绕高风险写操作建立 write-triggered reconsideration 控制点；这个设计既节省成本，又提高复杂治理工单的稳定性。对电商达人治理而言，封禁、解封、赔付、申诉等流程都能复用这一控制范式。
papers.innovation_en: Its key innovation is allocating deliberation and safeguards only where they matter: high-risk write operations. Instead of adding reflection to every turn, it creates a control point right before consequential backend writes. This makes the design cost-aware and deployment-friendly for governance operations.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 retail focus set 上，Gemini 2.5 user + Gemini 3.5 agent 组合从 60.7% 提升到 73.8%；Gemini 2.5 user + ChatGPT 5.5 agent 从 78.7% 提升到 86.9%。airline focus set 上两组设置都从 45%-55% 提升到 65%。
papers.key_metrics_en: On the retail focus set, reliability improves from 60.7% to 73.8% and from 78.7% to 86.9% under two model settings. On the airline focus set, reliability rises from 45%-55% to 65%.

papers.title: VideoSearch-R1: Iterative Video Retrieval and Reasoning via Soft Query Refinement
papers.authors: ["Seohyun Lee", "Seoung Choi", "Dohwan Ko", "Jongha Kim", "Hyunwoo J. Kim"]

papers.rationale_en: 很适合电商短视频巡检、违规片段定位和案例检索。SQR + 多轮检索的设计清晰，且项目页与真实代码仓库已公开，因此本次不重复复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: VideoSearch-R1 把视频检索与时序定位串成一个可自我纠错的 agent loop：先检索 top-1 视频，再判断是否匹配查询，不匹配就继续 refine query。核心模块 Soft Query Refinement 不是生成新的文本查询，而是在 embedding 空间里生成连续 soft tokens，以更少 token 成本细调查询向量。训练上结合 SFT、InfoNCE 与 GRPO，让 retrieval 和 downstream temporal grounding 一起优化。论文在三套 VCMR 基准上都拿到更好的检索与定位结果。
papers.method_overview_en: VideoSearch-R1 turns retrieval plus temporal grounding into a self-correcting agent loop. It retrieves a top-1 video, verifies the match, and refines the query if needed. Soft Query Refinement appends latent soft tokens in embedding space instead of rewriting the query in text. Joint optimization with SFT, contrastive learning, and GRPO improves both retrieval and temporal grounding.
papers.story_zh: 一次检索错了，后续时序推理就全部崩掉 -> 让模型先核验检索结果，再在连续空间 refine query -> 逐轮把目标视频拉到更高排名后再做细粒度定位。
papers.story_en: Static retrieval pipelines fail once the first hit is wrong -> verify and refine the query in latent space -> retrieve a better video before doing temporal grounding.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点是把“检索失败可自救”做成 agentic retrieval 框架，并用 soft query 而非离散 rewrite 降低冗余 token。对于内容治理，这意味着系统能在海量视频库里多轮收窄到更相关的候选，再做精确定位。该设计既兼容向量检索引擎，也给后续 RAG/审核案例检索提供了统一接口。
papers.innovation_en: The key innovation is recoverable retrieval: the system can detect a wrong first hit and refine itself. Using soft tokens rather than discrete rewrites reduces token cost while keeping fine-grained control over dense retrieval embeddings.
papers.key_metrics_zh: ActivityNet-FIG 上 VR R@1 从 55.1 提升到 61.1；DiDeMo-FIG 上 VCMR 0.5/R@1 从 22.1 提升到 30.2；SQR 只用 8 个 soft tokens，而硬查询改写平均需要 26.8 个 tokens。
papers.key_metrics_en: On ActivityNet-FIG, VR R@1 improves from 55.1 to 61.1. On DiDeMo-FIG, VCMR 0.5/R@1 improves from 22.1 to 30.2. SQR uses 8 latent tokens versus 26.8 text tokens for hard refinement.

papers.method_overview_en: GenCeption repurposes large text-to-video diffusion backbones into feed-forward perception models. It uses unified task representations and text instructions to handle depth, normals, pose, referring segmentation, and 3D keypoints within one architecture. The paper argues that video generation acts as the next-token-style pretraining catalyst for vision. Results show strong performance and data efficiency across diverse tasks.
papers.story_zh: 视觉模型仍然被大量任务专用架构割裂 -> 用视频生成模型学习统一时空先验 -> 通过统一表示和单步前向把生成骨干改造成通用视觉感知器。
papers.story_en: Task-specific vision stacks fragment capability -> use video generation as scalable pretraining -> convert the generative backbone into a unified perception model.
papers.innovation_zh: 真正亮点在于把视频生成视作视觉领域的 next-token prediction，对齐出一条“生成式预训练 -> 通用感知”的统一路线。它不是为某个任务设计额外 head，而是把多种任务挤进一个可扩展框架，对后续内容理解与结构化标注非常有启发。
papers.innovation_en: Its main contribution is turning video generation into a general-purpose visual pretraining path rather than a synthesis-only tool. The design favors a single expandable architecture over task-specific heads.

papers.key_metrics_en: Average depth reaches AbsRel 0.071 / δ1 93.8, and expression-referring segmentation on Ref-DAVIS reaches 75.8, matching or surpassing several specialized baselines.

papers.method_overview_zh: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 构建 46 个长时程终端任务，并用 dense reward-based grading 给每个子任务打分，避免 pass/fail 只看最终结果。它能够细分“完全失败”和“做对大半但收尾失败”的差异，更适合评估真正的工作流型 Agent。论文还配套 stress suite 与成本/时间统计，让 benchmark 更接近真实软件工程与自动化场景。
papers.method_overview_en: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench builds 46 long-horizon terminal tasks and grades them with dense subtask rewards instead of pure pass/fail. This distinguishes partial progress from total failure and better reflects real workflow-style agent behavior. The benchmark also measures cost, time, and stress robustness.
papers.story_zh: 短任务 + 终态评测无法反映真实工作流 -> 把任务拆成可验证子步骤并给 partial reward -> 更准确地定位长时程 Agent 的瓶颈。
papers.story_en: Outcome-only terminal benchmarks hide where agents fail -> decompose tasks into graded subtasks -> expose long-horizon reliability bottlenecks.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新在于把长链路 agent 的评测做成确定性、可解释、可部分得分的系统，而不是依赖模糊的人类主观判断。对治理巡检来说，这种 partial credit 和 failure mode 分析非常重要，因为很多问题不是零一成败，而是在哪个步骤掉链子。

papers.innovation_en: The key idea is to treat document visual structure itself as the pretraining signal. This provides a new path from rich pages to stronger language models.

papers.key_metrics_en: On Qwen 3.5, MMLU-Pro improves from 83.91 to 85.09 and GPQA from 76.24 to 79.29. MathVista improves from 85.50 to 86.70, while using roughly one quarter of the token budget of matched text pretraining.

papers.method_overview_en: The paper formalizes Fashion Detail Generation: given a garment reference image and a focus box, generate a high-fidelity close-up of the selected region. It uses Cross-modal Feature Alignment Distillation to align boxed references and detail close-ups in a teacher semantic space, then distills the alignment into both MMDiT branches. papers.innovation_en: Unlike generic image editing, the method targets an e-commerce decision point: inspecting collars, cuffs, zippers, and fabric textures. papers.key_metrics_en: FDBench contains 40K+ human-verified reference-detail pairs and 800 evaluation pairs across 41 categories; the paper reports SOTA results across automatic metrics and human evaluation.

papers.method_overview_en: QueryAgent-R1 reframes e-commerce query recommendation as retrieval-grounded generation. A memory tool compresses long user behavior into latest intent and an interest graph, while a product-search sandbox validates candidate queries against real inventory. The policy is optimized with a chain-of-retrieval reward that combines query exact match, item hit rate, title ROUGE, and format correctness.
papers.innovation_zh: 过去的 query 推荐更偏 query 语义相关性，容易出现 CTR 高但 CVR 低的 generation-retrieval gap；该文把真实库存检索引入生成闭环，并用一致性奖励把 query 命中和商品命中绑定起来。Memory abstraction 让长行为不直接塞入上下文，适合电商大规模在线部署。方案创新合理且可落地，尤其适合内容电商的搜索、达人商品池召回和意图治理。
papers.innovation_en: Instead of optimizing only query-level attractiveness, the method closes the generation-retrieval gap by explicitly checking whether recommended queries retrieve products aligned with downstream preference. papers.key_metrics_en: On the industrial offline set it reports Q_EM=0.177, I_Hit@1=0.261, and Cons@1=0.117; online A/B tests improve Query CTR by 2.9% and guided CVR by 3.1%.

papers.method_overview_en: MORE addresses the tension between reasoning correctness and natural response generation in e-commerce dialogue. papers.method_overview_en: ZooClaw-FashionSigLIP2 is a fashion-specialized SigLIP2-base dual-encoder trained via full fine-tuning with knowledge distillation on curated in-domain data, followed by WiSE-FT weight interpolation with the base model to preserve robustness.

papers.key_metrics_en: On ZooClaw-Fashion (ZC-TRAIN-L), R@10 reaches 0.659 vs 0.612 for a LoRA baseline; long-query R@10 is 0.225.

papers.method_overview_zh: 论文面向电商Sponsored Search的候选召回，核心难点是：点击信号有位置/曝光偏置、尾部query稀疏，而人工标注在亿级样本上成本不可承受。作者把线上同时运行的多路检索系统（字典/BM25/ANN等）的Top-K不一致视为‘天然监督’，把样本划分为易正、难正、难负等五档，并用一个三模型级联（Cross-Encoder→2B LLM→8B LLM）做5级相关性标注，再用三阶段课程训练（BCE→MNR→Triplet）训练双塔BERT检索模型并上线。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper targets candidate retrieval for e-commerce sponsored search, where clicks are biased and tail queries lack data. It turns multi-channel disagreement among production retrievers (lexical/BM25/ANN) into structured supervision: easy positives where all agree, hard positives found only by lexical, and hard negatives that fool one system. A calibrated three-model annotation cascade (cross-encoder → 2B LLM → 8B LLM) produces 5-grade relevance labels, and a three-stage curriculum (BCE → MNR → Triplet) trains a two-tower BERT dense retriever for deployment.
papers.innovation_zh: 亮点在于把‘检索系统互相打架’从噪声变成结构化挖掘信号，并把“样本难度→损失函数→训练阶段”做成可复用的工业化配方；LLM不参与训练时蒸馏，而只做离线标注，便于缓存/复用与独立迭代。级联+按类校准也让大模型标注在成本可控前提下逼近人标一致性。
papers.innovation_en: Key novelty is operationalizing retrieval disagreement as structured mining signals and matching difficulty levels with stage-wise objectives. LLMs are used only for offline labeling (cacheable and upgradable), not online distillation. The calibrated cascade makes large-scale labeling cost-effective while keeping high agreement with human judgments.
papers.key_metrics_zh:
离线：NDCG@10 0.878→0.923（+5.1%），尾部query +6.8%；rating=0的‘尴尬检索’8.7%→3.5%。
线上两周A/B（千万级请求/组）：+2.80% ad spend，+1.4% CTR，+2.8% eCPM，+2.9% click conversion rate。
papers.key_metrics_en:
Offline: NDCG@10 0.878→0.923 (+5.1%), tail queries +6.8%; embarrassing retrievals (rating 0) 8.7%→3.5%.
Online A/B (2 weeks, tens of millions requests/arm): +2.80% ad spend, +1.4% CTR, +2.8% eCPM, +2.9% click conversion rate.

papers.method_overview_zh: OneBar针对短视频播放页底栏（Bottom Bar）的‘看视频→一键搜’query推荐，在线预算仅20–30ms。它把传统“检索候选→过滤→风险→排序”的多阶段级联替换为单一端到端生成：先用协同多模态意图落地把视频文本/多模态摘要/协同query锚点/用户历史组织成证据schema，再用BART类encoder-decoder生成query列表，并用prompt压缩降低推理成本。为了避免单独训练reward model，提出PIOPD把层级行为偏好信号直接内化进生成策略。
papers.method_overview_en: OneBar tackles bottom-bar query recommendation in e-commerce short-video feeds under an ultra-tight 20–30ms latency budget. It replaces multi-stage cascades (retrieve → filter/risk → rank) with a unified encoder–decoder generator. Evidence from cleaned metadata, multimodal summaries, collaborative query anchors and filtered user history is compressed into a compact schema (prompt compression) and fed to a BART-like model; preference signals are progressively internalized via on-policy distillation (PIOPD) to avoid relying on a separate reward model.
papers.innovation_zh: 主要亮点是面向工业超低时延把生成式推荐做成可上线的统一推理链路（证据schema + prompt压缩），同时用‘偏好内化’弱化reward model带来的分布偏差与reward hacking风险；在内容侧噪声较大的短视频场景下，用“多源证据清洗+协同锚点”增强生成稳定性。
papers.innovation_en: It focuses on making generative recommendation deployable under strict latency constraints (schema + prompt compression) and reducing reward-model dependency via preference internalization, which helps mitigate reward hacking and distribution bias. Robustness against noisy content-side metadata is improved by evidence cleaning plus collaborative anchors.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 线上A/B（电商视频）：Query Exposure +16.91%，Query Click +18.68%，Query CTR +0.19%；引导订单 +20.36%，引导GMV +21.67%。
papers.key_metrics_en: Online A/B (e-commerce videos): Query Exposure +16.91%, Query Click +18.68%, Query CTR +0.19%; guided orders +20.36%, guided GMV +21.67%.

papers.method_overview_zh: 论文关注用户为规避审核而使用的隐语/暗语（algospeak、委婉替换、对抗性混淆等）。作者提出以“编码/解码机制路径”为核心的ILE taxonomy（11个顶层机制、33个子机制），并把taxonomy注入LLM prompt来做coded language检测（doc级是否存在ILE + span级定位 + 机制分类）。同时构建2000条人工标注数据（TikTok/Bluesky），系统对比多种taxonomy与无taxonomy基线。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper studies coded/indirect linguistic expressions (ILE) used to evade moderation. It proposes a mechanism-oriented taxonomy (11 top-level classes, 33 sub-mechanisms) centered on encoding/decoding pathways rather than topics or intents, and uses the taxonomy as structured scaffolding in LLM prompts for coded-language detection (document-level, span-level, and mechanism labeling). A 2,000-post dataset (TikTok/Bluesky) is manually annotated for evaluation.
papers.innovation_zh: 关键点在于将“隐语”抽象为可扩展的机制集合，而不是依赖某一主题或词表，从而能对抗概念漂移；taxonomy作为prompt scaffolding，让LLM检测不只靠surface-form扰动，而能覆盖emoji映射、跨语种转换、隐喻/借代、加密编码等更复杂机制。
papers.innovation_en: Instead of focusing on surface perturbations only, it models a broader set of encoding mechanisms (emoji mapping, cross-lingual transforms, metaphor/metonymy, algorithmic encodings, etc.) to better handle concept drift. A comprehensive taxonomy provides more stable prompt scaffolding for LLM-based moderation support.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在2000条标注数据上（3个LLM），相对最佳对照taxonomy，doc级准确率提升+4.7%，span级F1提升+5.4%。代码与可公开数据已提供（TikTok文本因协议不公开）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Across 3 LLMs, the proposed taxonomy improves accuracy by +4.7% and span-level F1 by +5.4% over the best baseline taxonomy on the annotated dataset. Code and the publicly releasable part of the data are available on GitHub (TikTok text is not redistributed).

papers.method_overview_zh: HarmVideoBench针对多模态大模型在内容治理中的‘有害视频理解’能力评测：指出现有benchmark多是二分类且缺少解释理由，容易让模型靠捷径得分。作者构建1379个视频与4137道多项选择题，把能力拆成三层：Observable Evidence（显式证据识别）、Clip-Internal Meaning（片内隐含含义）、Beyond-Clip Reasoning（片外社会文化推理）。并提出BCR：先预测需要推理的边界，再按需检索上下文，从而提升深层推理的准确性。
papers.method_overview_en: HarmVideoBench benchmarks harmful-video understanding for large vision-language models in moderation settings. It argues binary harmful/non-harmful evaluation misses implicit harms and lacks rationales. The benchmark contains 1,379 videos and 4,137 multiple-choice questions across three reasoning levels (observable evidence, clip-internal meaning, beyond-clip reasoning). It also proposes BCR, which predicts reasoning boundaries and retrieves context only when needed.
papers.innovation_zh: 把治理任务从‘判不判’推进到‘为什么判’与‘判的推理层级’，更贴近真实审核链路中的可解释性与审计；BCR的‘边界预测+按需检索’也为RAG式治理提供了更节省上下文的范式。
papers.innovation_en: It upgrades evaluation from coarse classification to a layered reasoning + rationale-oriented diagnostic, closer to real moderation requirements. BCR’s boundary prediction plus on-demand retrieval provides a structured way to improve deep contextual reasoning.
papers.key_metrics_zh: Benchmark规模：1379 videos / 4137 MCQs；覆盖三层推理维度。BCR将宏平均正确率从61.7%提升到84.4%。
papers.key_metrics_en: Benchmark: 1,379 videos / 4,137 MCQs; 3-level reasoning. BCR improves macro average from 61.7% to 84.4%.

papers.method_overview_zh: INSPIRE面向电商grocery的Sponsored Search召回，核心难点是query短且隐式意图强（品牌隐含无麸质、配料隐含素食等），还涉及过敏等安全约束。方法用多个teacher LLM对query与商品文本生成结构化意图属性（brand/flavor/dietary/ingredient/cuisine/product subtype/size等），用跨模型共识过滤噪声，再LoRA-SFT蒸馏到轻量student并用vLLM提供高吞吐意图推理；最后把意图属性注入双塔embedding实现意图增强召回。
papers.method_overview_en: INSPIRE improves sponsored product retrieval for grocery search where queries are short and implicit intents (dietary/allergen constraints) are crucial. It uses teacher LLMs to generate structured intent attributes from queries and product content, filters noise via cross-model consensus, distills to a lightweight student LLM via LoRA-SFT (served with vLLM), and injects predicted intents into bi-encoder embeddings for intent-augmented dense retrieval.
papers.innovation_zh: 把隐式偏好/安全约束从“靠语义相似度碰运气”变成可解释的结构化属性空间，并用‘LLM teacher→共识过滤→student蒸馏→检索注入’形成闭环；在电商治理层面，饮食/过敏类意图本质上也是风险控制的一部分，结构化建模更利于审计与策略化。
papers.innovation_en: It turns implicit preferences and safety constraints into explicit, auditable intent attributes and builds a practical weak-supervision pipeline (LLM teachers → consensus → student distillation → retrieval integration). This reduces reliance on surface-level semantic similarity and improves controllability for governance/safety-critical intents.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 论文强调通过意图增强提升NDCG@K/Precision@K，并给出可规模化部署（student + vLLM API）。摘要未披露具体提升幅度。
papers.key_metrics_en: The paper reports retrieval gains (e.g., NDCG@K / Precision@K) and a scalable production serving design (student + vLLM). No headline numbers are provided in the abstract.

papers.method_overview_zh: VCG面向电商视频feed的极端冷启动：新视频没有交互历史，watch-time等指标还存在时长/位置偏置。系统采用域内CLIP（基于约2亿图文对微调）对视频抽帧编码、平均池化成视频向量，并构建双塔把用户与视频拉到同一语义空间，实现零样本召回；同时用LVLM-as-judge做离线相关性代理评测，并比较LLM vs CLIP embedding在检索中的表现。
papers.method_overview_en: VCG targets extreme cold-start in e-commerce video feeds: new short videos have no interaction history, and engagement signals are biased by position and duration. It uses a domain-adapted CLIP to embed videos (frame sampling + mean pooling) and a two-tower retrieval system to map users and videos into a shared semantic space for zero-shot retrieval. It also proposes an LVLM-as-judge protocol and analyzes why generative embeddings may collapse for vector search.
papers.innovation_zh: 亮点是把视频feed从‘协同信号驱动’切换为‘视觉语义驱动’，并明确指出生成式模型虽然擅长属性理解，但在向量检索上容易出现表示塌缩，反而不如对比学习的CLIP稳定；另外用大模型做judge来缓解离线评测的曝光偏差。
papers.innovation_en: It reframes feed retrieval as semantic-first visual matching rather than collaborative filtering, and provides an embedding-space analysis showing that contrastive CLIP embeddings outperform generative (LLM) embeddings for retrieval due to representation collapse. LLM-as-judge is used to mitigate exposure bias in offline evaluation.

papers.key_metrics_en: Online A/B: ~50% uplift in deep video completion.

papers.method_overview_zh: AutoRelAnnotator解决离线相关性标注的成本与时效问题：先训练高准确的领域分类器（Cross-Encoder、Gemma-2B、LLaMA-8B等），再用按类校准后的置信度做级联路由：能高置信预测的样本在小模型处截断，低置信才上更大模型，并在末端做多数投票兜底。该系统用于训练数据准备、NDCG评测、根因分析、Guardrail阈值校准等离线场景。
papers.method_overview_en: AutoRelAnnotator builds a calibrated model cascade for cost-efficient offline relevance labeling in sponsored search. It first fine-tunes domain-specific classifiers (cross-encoder / 2B / 8B) and then routes examples through the cascade using per-class calibrated confidence, with majority-vote fallback for ambiguous cases. The goal is to support offline labeling use cases such as training data prep, NDCG evaluation, and root-cause analysis.
papers.innovation_zh: 核心思路不是“在低准确的off-the-shelf LLM之间路由”，而是先通过领域微调拉高准确天花板，再用校准+级联解决成本；按类isotonic校准适配5级相关性任务的classwise miscalibration。
papers.innovation_en: Instead of routing among low-accuracy off-the-shelf LLMs, it decouples accuracy (domain fine-tuning) from cost (calibrated cascading), and applies per-class isotonic calibration to improve deferral decisions under 5-class relevance.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 微调带来约+20个点准确率提升；级联在近似不损准确的情况下将计算成本减半；按类isotonic校准额外+0.6点；生产上处理150M+标注，将turnaround从约5天缩短到1–3小时。
papers.key_metrics_en: Fine-tuning contributes ~20 accuracy points; cascading is roughly accuracy-neutral while halving compute cost; per-class isotonic calibration adds +0.6 points; validated with 150M+ annotations and turnaround reduced from ~5 days to 1–3 hours.

papers.rationale_en: 创新性(24/30)：把工业相关性优化抽象成‘bad-case 驱动的闭环生态’，并用 Annotator/Optimizer/User/DeepSearch/Memory 等多智能体把挖掘-标注-诊断-修复-回归评测自动化；同时提出 harness-engineering + All-In-One relevance model + instruction-following model 的工程化落地组合。实验指标(11/15)：SBS win-rate 多个子任务提升 7%~12%+，少语种市场累计提升可达 13%（以人评为主）；实验质量(12/15)：任务拆解、对比与消融较完整，但缺少更开放的可复现实验基线；效率(7/10)：All-In-One 模型强调训练/推理统一，但系统级多 agent 仍需一定调度成本；泛化(4/5)：强调跨市场与跨 case 的持续迭代能力；相关性(24/25)：与电商搜索/内容理解/达人治理中的‘案例闭环治理’高度同构，因此给出高分并做复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文把电商搜索相关性优化看作‘坏例驱动’的闭环：从用户反馈挖掘 bad cases 开始，经标准澄清与多轮标注生成高质量数据，再由优化器诊断根因并修复模型，最后通过评测与部署回流进入下一轮。系统中用 User Agent 对话式挖掘差评案例，用 Annotator Agent 做多轮、带标准引用的标注，用 Optimizer Agent 把失败类型路由到数据/模型/规则修复动作；并引入 Deep Search Agent 专门针对“低估相关性”做检索扩展。为了可上线，作者采用 harness-engineering，把 All-In-One retrieval+ranking 模型、instruction-following relevance 模型、Global Memory（共享案例与标准更新）与运维 chatbot 组合成持续演化系统。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper reframes e-commerce search relevance optimization as a bad-case-driven closed loop: mine user-perceived failures, clarify standards and run multi-turn annotation, diagnose root causes and apply repairs, then evaluate/deploy and iterate. It instantiates a User Agent to discover bad cases via conversation, an Annotator Agent to produce standard-grounded labels, and an Optimizer Agent to analyze failures and trigger data/model/policy repairs; a Deep Search Agent targets underestimation failures via query expansion. To be production-ready, it adopts a harness-engineering paradigm and combines an All-In-One retrieval+ranking model, an instruction-following relevance model, Global Memory (shared cases and standard updates), and an ops chatbot into a continually evolving system.
papers.innovation_zh: 亮点在于：把‘相关性模型迭代’从单点建模提升为可操作的系统工程闭环，并用多智能体对齐人类多角色（用户/产品/标注/算法/评测）的协作结构；用 Global Memory 缓解多角色信息不对称，使标准更新与已解决案例可复用；Deep Search 解决 underestimation 这类工业高价值失败类型；harness-engineering 提供一套将 agent 能力稳定落到生产流水线的工程范式。
papers.innovation_en: Key highlights include: elevating relevance iteration from a single-model improvement problem to an operational closed-loop system; using multi-agent roles aligned with real industrial roles (user/PM/annotator/engineer/evaluator); Global Memory to reduce information asymmetry and reuse resolved cases/standards; and Deep Search dedicated to high-value underestimation failures, under a harness-engineering recipe for reliable production workflows.
papers.key_metrics_zh: SBS 人评：LLM Annotator 方案 win-rate +12.38%，GRM-based annotator +9.78%，Agentic Optimizer +7.28%，User–Annotator 协作 +8.9%，Automated Pipeline +10.17%；少语种市场累计 SBS win-rate +13%。All-In-One：Coarse Rank ACC 0.798→0.815。Instruction-following：总体 ACC 0.5033→0.8402（Neutral 0.3848→0.8270）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Human SBS: win-rate gains include +12.38% (LLM annotator), +9.78% (GRM-based annotator), +7.28% (agentic optimizer), +8.9% (user–annotator collaboration), +10.17% (automated pipeline); cumulative +13% SBS win-rate on low-resource markets. All-In-One: coarse rank ACC 0.798→0.815. Instruction-following: overall ACC 0.5033→0.8402 (Neutral 0.3848→0.8270).

papers.method_overview_zh: 论文指出多模态 RAG 易出现跨模态幻觉与“干预悖论”（静态规则过度干预/不干预又会级联错误）。作者提出 MODE-RAG：用 VFE（能量）与内部 attention state 估计风险，由 FE-Router 动态决定是否介入；高风险样本被路由到分阶段 agents（Perception/Retrieval/Reasoning/Generation 等），并用 MCTS 搜索构建可审计的因果推导路径，同时通过 logit perturbation 抑制 sycophancy。最后用 Correction/Overseer 做格式稳定与事后事实核验，并构建 ModeVent 作为更难的评测子集。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper argues multimodal RAG is vulnerable to cross-modal hallucinations and suffers from an intervention paradox. MODE-RAG uses Variational Free Energy (VFE) and internal attention states to estimate risk and dynamically gate interventions via an FE-Router. High-risk queries are routed to stage-specific agents (perception/retrieval/reasoning/generation) and MCTS is used to build auditable causal derivations; logit perturbations penalize sycophancy. Correction/Overseer agents enforce format stability and post-hoc factual verification, and the paper introduces ModeVent as a challenging evaluation subset.
papers.innovation_zh: 关键创新是把“是否介入”变成基于能量/不确定性的动态决策，并把 RAG 的失败拆解为九类、四阶段的可操作诊断空间；MCTS + 多 agent 让推理链更可追溯，适合治理系统的可解释与可审计诉求。
papers.innovation_en: Its core novelty is risk-aware dynamic intervention based on energy/uncertainty, coupled with a fine-grained taxonomy of hallucinations across lifecycle stages. The multi-agent + MCTS design improves traceability and auditability, which aligns well with governance requirements.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 ModeVent（从 MultiVent 派生）上，多个 hallucination 类型的综合分数显著提升，例如 Majority Text Bias Total 5.41→6.83（+1.42），Information Sparsity 3.93→5.22（+1.30），Attribute Hijacking 2.74→3.82（+1.08）。
papers.key_metrics_en: On ModeVent, overall scores improve across multiple hallucination types, e.g., Majority Text Bias Total 5.41→6.83 (+1.42), Information Sparsity 3.93→5.22 (+1.30), Attribute Hijacking 2.74→3.82 (+1.08).

papers.method_overview_zh: 论文关注小型 MLLM 做 GUI/Web agent 时规划弱、跨站泛化差的问题。PEEU 先让 agent 在网站上自主探索，构建 exploration tree 并收集“任务-轨迹-中间状态”经验；再利用 hindsight experience 把粗糙/不对齐的原始任务重写成严格对齐的高层任务分解数据，用于 SFT 或 GRPO 训练，从而提升高层规划与 OOD 泛化。作者进一步提出 TDHAF，把任务拆分成 low/mid/high 三层粒度，量化不同层级训练对组合泛化的贡献。
papers.method_overview_en: PEEU targets weak planning and poor cross-website generalization of small multimodal GUI agents. It lets an agent autonomously explore websites to build an exploration tree and collect experience, then uses hindsight utilization to rewrite misaligned tasks into strictly aligned high-level task decomposition supervision for SFT/GRPO. TDHAF is proposed to analyze compositional generalization across low/mid/high task granularities.
papers.innovation_zh: 核心亮点是把数据构建自动化：用探索把‘过程’挖出来，再用 hindsight 把过程蒸馏成可学习的高层规划监督，避免人工写复杂 task；并用 TDHAF 证明“原子技能学得好≠高层规划强”，为电商治理类的自动化操作（跨页面、多步骤合规流程）提供方法论。
papers.innovation_en: It turns planning improvement into a scalable data engine: exploration discovers procedural experience and hindsight distills it into learnable high-level planning supervision. TDHAF further shows why atomic skills alone do not guarantee high-level planning, which is useful for multi-step governance operations.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 7B 模型在真实 benchmark 上准确率 30.6%，优于 Atomic-SFT 21.7%，也超过 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 的 22.7%；仅 0.1k trajectories 的 PEEU-GRPO 也能达 19.9%（Atomic-GRPO 10.0%）。
papers.key_metrics_en: A 7B model reaches 30.6% accuracy, outperforming Atomic-SFT (21.7%) and even Qwen2.5-VL-32B (22.7%); with only 0.1k trajectories, PEEU-GRPO achieves 19.9% vs Atomic-GRPO 10.0%.
