papers.rationale_zh: 创新性(24/30)：把 T2I/局部编辑/全局编辑/CFG 等能力统一到“velocity field”视角，并提出 on-policy field distillation：在 student rollout 的状态上做 sample-wise hard routing 与单点 low-noise query，用简单的 velocity MSE 就能做能力组合蒸馏。指标(13/15)：多能力组合任务上相对强 baseline 提升 8%~16%+，并显著改善 realism reward；实验质量(11/15)：覆盖多种组合设置与消融；效率(6/10)：仍是大模型训练，但目标是减少多 teacher/多 head 复杂度；泛化(3/5)：主要在编辑与生成组合上验证；相关性(8/25)：对电商素材生成/商品图编辑有价值但非治理核心。
papers.rationale_en: 创新性(24/30)：把 T2I/局部编辑/全局编辑/CFG 等能力统一到“velocity field”视角，并提出 on-policy field distillation：在 student rollout 的状态上做 sample-wise hard routing 与单点 low-noise query，用简单的 velocity MSE 就能做能力组合蒸馏。指标(13/15)：多能力组合任务上相对强 baseline 提升 8%~16%+，并显著改善 realism reward；实验质量(11/15)：覆盖多种组合设置与消融；效率(6/10)：仍是大模型训练，但目标是减少多 teacher/多 head 复杂度；泛化(3/5)：主要在编辑与生成组合上验证；相关性(8/25)：对电商素材生成/商品图编辑有价值但非治理核心。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文关注一个模型同时具备 T2I、局部编辑、全局编辑等多能力时的“能力冲突”。DanceOPD 将每种能力视为 flow-matching 状态空间上的 velocity field，通过 sample-wise hard routing 让每个样本只学习一个能力场；训练时在 student rollout 的 on-policy 状态上向 teacher 查询一个低噪声语义点，并用 velocity MSE 蒸馏，从而让学生学会在同一状态空间内组合多种能力场。该表述还能自然吸收 operator-defined fields（如 CFG、realism field），统一处理多能力组合。
papers.method_overview_en: DanceOPD addresses capability conflicts when a single flow-matching model needs to unify T2I, local edit, and global edit. It views each capability as a velocity field over a shared flow state space, uses sample-wise hard routing so each sample learns one field, and performs on-policy distillation by querying the teacher at a single low-noise semantic state along the student rollout, optimized with a simple velocity MSE. The formulation can also absorb operator-defined fields such as CFG.
papers.innovation_zh: 主要创新是 on-policy 的 generative field 蒸馏：避免 off-policy distillation 的 student-to-teacher gap，把多能力组合问题转化为对一组 velocity fields 的可组合学习；hard routing 与单点 query 让训练目标简单但可扩展。
papers.innovation_en: It proposes on-policy generative field distillation to reduce the student-to-teacher gap and turns multi-capability composition into learning a composable set of velocity fields, with simple objectives enabled by hard routing and single-state queries.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在生成+编辑组合评测中，DanceOPD 在 GEditBench 上达到 Avg 5.347（T2I+Edit）与 5.498（Local+Global Edit），GenEval overall 约 0.848~0.849；相对最强 OPD baseline，多能力组合提升约 8.1%，local/global composition 场景相对最佳组合 baseline 提升约 16.1%。
papers.key_metrics_en: On composition benchmarks, DanceOPD reports GEditBench Avg 5.347 (T2I+Edit) and 5.498 (Local+Global Edit), with GenEval overall ~0.848–0.849; improvements are ~8.1% over strong OPD baselines and ~16.1% in local/global composition over the best competing combinations.

papers.method_overview_zh: 论文认为多模态推理的 RL scaling 关键瓶颈不是‘题更难’，而是‘奖励/答案标签必须可靠’。VeriEvol 将数据构造拆成两条轴：type-aware evolution 用路由化 operators 把简单图题演化成更难且图像可落地的 prompts；HTV-Agent 用多源反证与假设检验，只有在无法反驳时才接受答案，从而得到可审计的 verified data。最终数据可直接接入 GRPO 训练，并伴随每条样本的 verifier trace 便于审计与治理。
papers.method_overview_en: VeriEvol treats RL scaling for multimodal math as a verifiable data-construction problem. It decouples two axes: a type-aware evolution module that rewrites easy image-question seeds into harder, image-grounded prompts via route-specific operators; and HTV-Agent, which enforces answer reliability via multi-source counter-evidence and hypothesis-test falsification, accepting an answer only when it cannot be refuted. The resulting verified data plugs into GRPO-style recipes and provides full verifier traces for auditing.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新点在于把“数据扩容”做成可验证流水线：先提升难度，再对答案可靠性做严格过滤，并把全过程 trace 作为一等公民开放，便于下游做数据质量治理与回溯。
papers.innovation_en: It makes data scaling verifiable and auditable: difficulty evolution + strict answer verification, with end-to-end traces as first-class artifacts for downstream quality governance.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 五个 benchmark 上，将 evolved SFT 数据从 10K 扩到 250K，平均准确率 35.42→54.73；在同 backbone+GRPO recipe 下，VeriEvol 相比未演化 RL baseline 额外 +3.88（其中 evolved prompts +1.82，HTV-Agent +2.06）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Across five benchmarks, scaling evolved SFT data from 10K to 250K raises mean accuracy 35.42→54.73. With the same backbone and GRPO recipe, VeriEvol adds +3.88 over an un-evolved RL baseline (+1.82 from evolved prompts, +2.06 from HTV-Agent verification).

papers.method_overview_zh: 论文指出真实世界的图像生成请求往往隐含信息、依赖最新知识或交互历史，直接 T2I 会出现“Context Gap”。Qwen-Image-Agent 提出以“上下文”为中心的 agentic 框架：先做 Context-Aware Planning 识别缺失信息并规划获取方式，再通过 Context Grounding 从推理、搜索、记忆与反馈中补齐上下文，最后把完整 generation context 分配给生成/编辑模型；整体 training-free，兼容现有生成器。作者还提出 IA-Bench 来评测 Plan/Reason/Search/Memory 四种核心能力，并通过 ablation 展示各模块贡献。
papers.method_overview_en: Qwen-Image-Agent identifies a Context Gap in real-world image generation where user inputs are underspecified or depend on up-to-date knowledge and interaction history. It proposes a context-centric agentic framework: Context-Aware Planning detects missing context and plans how to acquire it, while Context Grounding gathers context from reasoning, search, memory, and feedback; the constructed generation context is then allocated to an image generator/editor. The approach is training-free and compatible with existing generators, and IA-Bench is introduced to evaluate Plan/Reason/Search/Memory capabilities.
papers.innovation_zh: 亮点在于把图像生成从‘一次性提示词’升级为可迭代构造上下文的 agentic pipeline，并将 context acquisition 结构化为 planning+grounding 两阶段；同时给出专门评测 agentic image generation 的 IA-Bench，便于诊断“工具使用/检索/记忆”对效果的贡献。
papers.innovation_en: It upgrades image generation from one-shot prompting to an iterative context construction pipeline, and formalizes context acquisition as planning + grounding. IA-Bench provides a dedicated benchmark to diagnose agentic image generation capabilities.
papers.key_metrics_zh: IA-Bench 上 IA-score 45.4（Qwen-Image-2.0 直接生成 baseline 17.4）；WISE-Verified overall 0.902，MindBench overall 0.42；相比直接生成 baseline，MindBench 提升约 82.6%。
papers.key_metrics_en: IA-Bench: IA-score 45.4 (direct Qwen-Image-2.0 baseline 17.4). WISE-Verified overall 0.902; MindBench overall 0.42; MindBench improves by ~82.6% over direct generation baseline.

papers.method_overview_zh: 论文提出在不改动生成模型权重的前提下，直接在中间层隐藏状态上训练轻量 probe（线性/MLP/双头结构）来预测安全标签，并把 probe 挂到 vLLM 的解码循环中，实现 token 级的‘边生成边审核’。关键设计包括层选择(如中后层)、检测频率(每隔若干 step 触发)、以及融合线性先验与非线性分支的 DUAL-HEAD 结构。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper trains lightweight probes (linear/MLP/dual-head) on intermediate hidden states of a frozen generator to predict safety labels, and integrates the probe into the vLLM decode loop for token-level streaming moderation. Key knobs include layer selection (mid-to-late layers), probing frequency (every few decoding steps), and a DUAL-HEAD architecture combining linear priors with an MLP branch.
papers.innovation_zh: 相较于生成后再跑 Guard 模型，streaming probe 把审核前移到生成过程，使得有害内容可以在输出完成前被拦截；同时把成本从‘跑一遍大模型’降到‘读一层隐藏状态+小MLP’，更符合线上高并发。该思路对电商客服、评论/直播间弹幕、达人内容的生成式审核都可直接复用。
papers.innovation_en: Compared to post-hoc guard models, streaming probes move moderation inside generation, enabling early interception before harmful text is fully emitted. Compute is reduced from running an extra large model to reading hidden states plus a tiny probe, making it practical for high-QPS production. The recipe is directly relevant to e-commerce assistants, comment/live-chat moderation, and creator governance workflows.

papers.key_metrics_en: ZHUYI (Chinese) F1 0.9746; tail latency ~0.1ms (claimed 3000x+ faster than post-hoc guard); compute 0.6 GFLOPs vs ~8 TFLOPs (2–4 orders reduction); consistent gains on BeaverTails (English).

papers.rationale_en: 创新性(22/30)：将审核从分类器堆叠升级为‘生成式策略感知描述(policy-aware captions)’，把可解释证据作为中间表示，并配套数据精炼解决通用VLM在敏感内容上的拒答问题；实验指标(12/15)：生产模拟中显著降低漏过/误杀，并在业务子场景给出量化收益；实验质量(12/15)：训练配方、三段式系统与 CapBench 评测拆解较完整；效率(8/10)：强调 FP8 量化与较低推理成本；泛化(3/5)：跨场景复用能力主要依赖数据与RAG工程；相关性(22/25)：与电商短视频/直播内容治理高度相关。但核心资产不开放，复现实操门槛较高，因此总分控制在 80 以下。
papers.method_overview_zh: UNIVID 将视频审核重构为‘先生成策略感知描述，再基于描述做决策’的统一框架：模型对视频生成可被人工核验的 policy-aware captions，系统再结合检索与规则/策略进行执行。整体流程包含三阶段：Risk Filter 用嵌入做高吞吐初筛，Moderation Actor 生成描述并结合 RAG 做自动处置，Trend Governance 用少量样本快速捕捉新风险趋势。
papers.method_overview_en: UNIVID reframes video moderation as an interpretable caption-driven pipeline: the model generates policy-aware captions as verifiable evidence, and downstream policy logic (with retrieval) makes the final enforcement decision. The system follows a three-stage design: a high-throughput embedding-based Risk Filter, a Moderation Actor that produces captions and uses RAG for decisions, and a Trend Governance module that adapts to emerging risks with few examples.
papers.innovation_zh: 核心亮点是把审核证据显式化（caption 作为可验证中间层），减少黑盒分类器堆叠带来的维护与归因困难；并提出面向敏感内容的数据精炼/持续微调配方，降低通用VLM的‘安全护栏拒答’；评测上用 CapBench 把描述拆成原子事件，便于做细粒度对齐与诊断。
papers.innovation_en: The key idea is to make moderation evidence explicit (captions as a verifiable intermediate), reducing the maintenance and attribution burden of large classifier ensembles. It also proposes a human-refined data recipe to mitigate refusals caused by generic safety guardrails, and introduces CapBench to evaluate captions by decomposing them into atomic verifiable events for precise alignment.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 生产模拟：违规漏过率相对降低 42.7%，误杀率相对降低 37.0%；Brand & Ads 场景匹配准确率 81%；Risk Filter 集成 UNIVID 嵌入后高热视频漏过召回提升 23.9%；结合 RAG 后漏过召回从 39.3% 提升到 53.6%。
papers.key_metrics_en: Simulated production: relative violation leakage -42.7%, overkill -37.0%; 81% matching accuracy in Brand & Ads simulations; Risk Filter leakage recall on high-view videos +23.9% with UNIVID embeddings; leakage recall 39.3% → 53.6% with RAG.

papers.method_overview_zh: VCG 面向电商视频流的‘极端冷启动’，用领域适配的 CLIP 将视频帧与商品图文映射到统一语义空间。视频侧对采样帧做编码取均值形成视频向量；用户侧对历史点击商品向量做时间衰减聚合形成用户向量，在线用 kNN 向量检索召回候选视频。为克服曝光偏置，论文引入‘LVLM-as-a-judge’用 VLM 对推荐相关性做更接近人工偏好的评估。
papers.method_overview_en: VCG tackles extreme cold-start in e-commerce video feeds by aligning videos and products in a shared semantic space using a domain-adapted CLIP. Video embeddings are averaged over sampled frames, while user embeddings are time-decayed aggregates of clicked product embeddings; candidates are retrieved via kNN vector search. To reduce exposure bias of offline metrics, it adopts an LVLM-as-a-judge protocol to assess semantic relevance beyond historical clicks.

papers.innovation_en: It shifts cold-start recommendation from behavior-based CF to a semantic-first paradigm. The paper provides an empirical analysis comparing generative MLLM embeddings vs. discriminative CLIP embeddings for retrieval, highlighting anisotropy/collapse issues of generative embeddings in kNN search. It also uses LVLM judging to better approximate human preference and avoid biased offline evaluation.

papers.key_metrics_en: Online A/B: VideoProgress@50% +50.10%, Start-to-25% conversion +30.32%; Offline: fDNA similarity +37%, CLIP similarity +22%; online retrieval P50 latency 17.5ms.

papers.method_overview_zh: 本文把短视频推荐从‘ID记忆’转向‘语义原生’：用 RQ-VAE 将多模态内容量化成 Semantic IDs，替代无限膨胀的 item ID 嵌入表，提升冷启动与泛化。为在毫秒级延迟下建模 2000+ 长序列，提出 Temporal Folding 将相邻 token 折叠成更短的‘超级token’，并用 Global Query Token 吸收全局意图，再与局部信号融合用于排序。
papers.method_overview_en: This work shifts short-form video recommendation from ID memorization to semantic-native modeling. It replaces item IDs with content-native Semantic IDs generated via RQ-VAE quantization over multimodal embeddings, improving cold-start and generalization while bounding embedding growth. To scale sequence length beyond 2000 under strict latency, it proposes Temporal Folding to compress tokens into super-tokens and a Global Query Token to capture holistic intent, fused with local signals for ranking.

papers.innovation_en: It demonstrates the industrial synergy of Semantic IDs with ultra-long sequence modeling. Bi-gram depth truncation keeps vocabulary/parameters deployable, while Temporal Folding delivers major compute savings with zero extra parameters and can even improve accuracy via expanded feature dimensionality. The paper also outlines a hybrid sync-async deployment path aligning long-sequence features with real-time ranking signals.

papers.method_overview_en: SAERec first extracts recommendation-aware text embeddings from user reviews via an LLM, then uses a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) to decompose dense embeddings into a high-dimensional sparse intent space. With mutual-information alignment and LLM-assisted filtering/labeling, it builds a set of interpretable intent atoms. At serving time, it retrieves both personal and public intent priors and injects them into a sequential recommender via multi-branch attention to produce robust and interpretable user representations.

papers.innovation_en: It introduces SAE-based semantic disentanglement to intent recommendation, addressing the opacity and hyper-parameter sensitivity of clustering/prototype intents. LLMs are used to filter and name intent atoms to make the intent space readable and operable. The dual-level intent retrieval mechanism combines offline semantic stability with online behavioral dynamics.

papers.method_overview_zh: 论文聚焦图文交互的隐喻型 meme 审核，提出三阶段训练：先用含 CoT 的 SFT 热身，再用监督式 GRPO 通过复合奖励(分类正确、格式合规、解释相似、思考长度)做后训练，最后探索一致性伪标签的自监督 GRPO。模型在输出标签的同时生成可解释推理链，便于运营侧核验与迭代。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper targets implicit hateful/propagandistic memes where harmful intent emerges from image-text interplay. It uses a 3-stage pipeline: SFT warm-up with CoT distillation and fine-grained labels, supervised GRPO with a composite reward (correctness, formatting, rationale similarity, thinking length), and a self-supervised GRPO variant using consensus pseudo-labels. papers.method_overview_zh: TimeProVe 面向小时级未剪辑长视频问答(LVQA)，提出'先提议、后验证'的高效混合框架。核心是 Action-based Candidate Evidence (ACE) 模块：先用轻量 LLM/动作定位模块把视频中时序定位到的动作转化为'查询条件下的候选答案+支撑证据时间窗'，形成答案-证据假设；随后只对这些少量候选片段调用昂贵的大 VLM 做定向验证，从而把推理复杂度与原始视频时长解耦。论文还提出开放式基准 OpenTSUBench(OTB)，评测真实日常活动(ADL)场景下的时序定位推理。
papers.method_overview_en: TimeProVe targets hours-long untrimmed Long Video Question Answering (LVQA) with a cost-efficient propose-then-verify framework. Its core Action-based Candidate Evidence (ACE) module first uses lightweight LLM/action-localization to convert temporally localized actions into query-conditioned candidate answers plus supporting evidence windows (answer-evidence hypotheses); an expensive large VLM is then invoked only for targeted verification of these few candidates, decoupling reasoning complexity from raw video duration. The paper also introduces OpenTSUBench (OTB), an open-ended benchmark for temporally grounded reasoning in real-world Activities of Daily Living (ADL).
papers.innovation_zh: 区别于'看全片'的密集 VLM 处理(成本随时长线性增长)和纯字幕/caption 稀疏推理(易漏掉时序定位与动作细节)，TimeProVe 用廉价模块生成候选、再用昂贵模型定向验证，兼顾精度与成本。ACE 把'动作定位'显式转化为可验证的答案-证据对，使长视频推理可扩展；且无需显式时序定位训练即具竞争力，创新点合理可行。
papers.innovation_en: Unlike dense 'watch-it-all' VLM processing (cost grows with duration) or caption-only sparse reasoning (misses temporally localized motion evidence), TimeProVe proposes cheap candidates then verifies them with the expensive model only when needed, balancing accuracy and cost. ACE explicitly turns action localization into verifiable answer-evidence pairs, making long-video reasoning scalable, and stays competitive without explicit grounding training.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 OpenTSUBench(OTB) 上比最强 baseline 高 7.3%，同时 VLM 调用减少 75%、推理成本降低 93%；在 Charades-STA 上无需显式定位训练即有竞争力，配合 grounding VLM 时达到 SOTA。
papers.key_metrics_en: +7.3% over the strongest baseline on OpenTSUBench (OTB), with 75% fewer VLM calls and 93% lower inference cost; competitive on Charades-STA without explicit grounding training, and SOTA when enhanced with grounding VLMs.

papers.method_overview_zh: CoD 提出训练 LLM 获得'串联线索(Connect the Dots)'的元能力：智能体部署后会连续解决一长串任务，同时持续探索环境、从自身经验学习并迭代自更新对环境的上下文，从而在后续任务上越做越好。框架包含：(1) 端到端 RL 的算法与基础设施，支持交替'解题(solve-task)'与'更新上下文(update-context)'的长 rollout 序列；(2) 为激发该元能力定制的任务与环境，以及评测协议；并给出带细粒度信用分配的 GRPO 风格 RL 实现。
papers.method_overview_en: CoD trains LLMs for a meta-capability called 'Connect the Dots': a deployed agent solves a long sequence of tasks while continuously exploring, learning from its own experience, and iteratively self-updating its context about the environment, thereby improving on future tasks. It contributes (1) algorithms and infrastructure for end-to-end RL over long rollouts that interleave solve-task and update-context episodes, and (2) tasks/environments and evaluation that elicit and measure this meta-capability, with a GRPO-style RL algorithm featuring fine-grained credit assignment.
papers.innovation_zh: 不同于按任务独立训练或仅靠固定上下文，CoD 把'随经验自更新上下文'本身作为可被 RL 优化的目标，强调训练-评测都针对元能力(而非领域特定能力)，并验证了域内、跨域乃至到 Ralph-loop 设置的分布外泛化。
papers.innovation_en: Rather than per-task RL or fixed context, CoD makes experience-driven self-updating of context itself an RL-optimizable objective, targeting the meta-capability during both training and evaluation, and validates out-of-distribution generalization within domains, across domains, and to Ralph-loop settings.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 概念验证实验证明端到端 RL 在 CoD 设定下有效，并展示了在训练域内、跨域以及向 Ralph-loop 迁移的 OOD 泛化潜力；开源实现于 Trinity-RFT。
papers.key_metrics_en: Proof-of-concept results validate end-to-end RL in the CoD setting and demonstrate OOD generalization within training domains, across domains, and from CoD to Ralph-loop settings; implementation released in Trinity-RFT.

papers.method_overview_zh: NEST 是面向完整长电影的'叙事事件结构'理解数据集与基准。包含 1005 部完整电影(平均约 98 分钟)，每部标注约 102 个多模态叙事事件，标注 grounding 于视觉、对白与音频，并通过时序顺序、层级组合、长程依赖等关系把事件连接成叙事结构。设立四个任务：事件触发检测(ETD)、事件定位(EL)、事件论元抽取(EAE)、事件关系抽取(ERE)，并给出基线。
papers.method_overview_en: NEST is a dataset and benchmark for narrative event structure understanding over full-length movies: 1005 films (avg ~98 min), each annotated with ~102 multimodal narrative events grounded in visual content, dialogue, and audio, and linked by relations capturing temporal ordering, hierarchical composition, and long-range dependencies. It defines four tasks—Event Trigger Detection (ETD), Event Localization (EL), Event Argument Extraction (EAE), and Event Relation Extraction (ERE)—with baselines.
papers.innovation_zh: 现有长视频基准多停留在'大海捞针'式检索或带选择偏置的多选题，无法评测低层动作如何组成事件、事件如何跨时间互动、叙事如何推进。NEST 以全片为单位、要求模型把早期伏笔与后期结果跨长间隔关联，填补了叙事级理解评测空白。
papers.innovation_en: Existing long-video benchmarks emphasize needle-in-a-haystack retrieval or biased multiple-choice, failing to assess how low-level actions form events, how events interact over time, and how narratives progress. NEST works at the full-movie level and requires linking early setups to later payoffs across long gaps, filling the narrative-level evaluation gap.

papers.key_metrics_en: Highly challenging for grounded discovery: ETD <8%, EL <6%, EAE <11%; relation extraction (ERE) is more tractable once events are given, reaching 35.45% F1 zero-shot and 44.42% F1 after fine-tuning. Total duration 1639.3 hours.

papers.method_overview_zh: MATM(多智能体交互记忆)面向去中心化、异构的智能体群体，提出群体级的'轨迹存取共享'框架：生产者智能体把任务执行中产生的交互轨迹(动作-观测序列等程序性知识)贡献到共享库，消费者智能体检索这些轨迹来提升自身任务效果与效率。聚焦交互式环境(ALFWorld、WebArena)，轨迹长且程序性结构丰富。还引入基于 Learning-to-Rank 的轨迹重排阶段以提升检索质量。
papers.method_overview_en: MATM (Multi-Agent Transactive Memory) provides population-level storage and retrieval of agent-generated trajectories for decentralized, heterogeneous agent populations: producer agents contribute interaction trajectories (action-observation procedural knowledge) to a shared repository, and consumer agents retrieve them to improve task effectiveness and efficiency. It focuses on interactive environments (ALFWorld, WebArena) where trajectories are long and procedurally rich, and adds a Learning-to-Rank reranking stage for retrieval quality.
papers.innovation_zh: 现有经验复用大多局限于'生产者本人'，新实例化的智能体被迫重复发现已有解法。MATM 借鉴'交互记忆(transactive memory)'概念，让异构智能体无需协调或联合训练即可共享并复用彼此经验，并支持个性化、生产者可信度建模、随群体演化更新检索器等高级功能。
papers.innovation_en: Existing experience reuse is largely limited to the original producer, forcing newly instantiated agents to rediscover solutions. Drawing on transactive memory, MATM lets heterogeneous agents share and reuse each other's experience without coordination or joint training, and enables personalization, producer trust modeling, and periodic retriever updates as the population evolves.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebArena 上，检索共享轨迹既提升下游任务成功率，又减少交互步数；LTR 重排进一步提升检索质量与步数效率；收益对弱/强智能体均成立，并随库规模增长持续改善。
papers.key_metrics_en: On ALFWorld and WebArena, retrieving shared trajectories improves downstream task success and reduces interaction steps; LTR reranking further improves retrieval quality and step efficiency; benefits hold for weaker and stronger agents and grow as the repository scales.

papers.method_overview_zh: StylisticBias 是评测 MLLM 属性级社会偏见的受控基准。生成 500 张写实基础人脸，每张产生约 50 个'单属性变体'(共约 25K 图)，在保持身份不变的前提下每次只改变一个视觉属性(年龄、体型、穿搭风格等)，从而度量特定线索如何改变模型判断。在 6 个 MLLM、25 个二元社会判断场景上评测。
papers.method_overview_en: StylisticBias is a controlled benchmark for attribute-level social bias in MLLMs. It generates 500 photorealistic base faces and ~50 single-attribute variations each (~25K images), keeping identity fixed while changing one visual attribute at a time (age, body type, fashion style, etc.) to measure how specific cues shift model judgments, evaluated across 6 MLLMs and 25 binary social judgment scenarios.
papers.innovation_zh: 以往研究常对比不同个体，难以分离'外观效应'与'身份差异'。本工作通过'固定身份+单属性扰动'实现干净的归因，揭示偏见集中在少数视觉线索上，为细粒度偏见评测提供可控工具。
papers.innovation_en: Prior work compares different individuals, conflating appearance effects with identity differences. By fixing identity and perturbing single attributes, StylisticBias enables clean attribution and shows bias is concentrated in a small set of visual cues, offering a controllable instrument for fine-grained bias evaluation.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 年龄与体型主导身份级效应，穿搭风格等视觉线索带来最大的属性级偏移；约 15 个属性解释近 80% 的总变化；偏见在与外观语义对齐的判断(社会经济地位、风格相关)上最强。
papers.key_metrics_en: Age and body type dominate identity-level effects, while fashion style and other cues drive the largest attribute-level shifts; ~15 attributes account for nearly 80% of total variation; sensitivity is strongest for appearance-aligned judgments (socioeconomic, style-related).

papers.method_overview_zh: NAMESAKES 研究文生图(T2I)模型对真实人物的'身份记忆'问题：当以名字为提示时，模型可能生成可辨识的真人肖像，带来隐私风险。论文提出完全黑盒的行为探测方法，无需参考照片、训练数据或模型内部访问，即可区分生成人脸是'被记忆'还是'被虚构'。并构建 NAMESAKES 数据集(1269 个名字-人脸)用于基准评测。
papers.method_overview_en: NAMESAKES studies identity memorization in text-to-image (T2I) models: prompting with a person's name can yield recognizable likenesses, raising privacy concerns. It introduces a fully black-box behavioral probe that distinguishes memorized vs. fabricated faces without reference photos, training-data access, or model internals, and builds the NAMESAKES dataset (1,269 name-face pairs) for benchmarking.
papers.innovation_zh: 以往判断是否记忆需要真值照片、训练数据或白盒访问，适用性受限。本方法仅靠模型对'名字/扰动名'的黑盒行为差异即可推断记忆，且数据集覆盖从高知名度到低知名度、含扰动名对照，使评测更严谨。
papers.innovation_en: Distinguishing memorization previously required ground-truth photos, training data, or white-box access, limiting applicability. This probe infers memorization purely from black-box behavioral differences across names and perturbed names, with a dataset spanning fame levels and perturbed-name controls for rigorous evaluation.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 在多款 SOTA T2I 模型上，该探测能显著预测身份记忆并把'被记忆'与'未识别'的名字分离开，并给出不同模型族之间差异的洞见;数据集含 1269 个名字-人脸对。
papers.key_metrics_en: Across state-of-the-art T2I models, the probe substantially predicts identity memorization and separates memorized from unrecognized names, with insights into differences across model families; dataset contains 1,269 name-face pairs.

papers.method_overview_zh: PerceptionDLM 是面向高效并行区域感知的多模态扩散语言模型。它先构建 PerceptionDLM-Base（SigLIP-2 视觉编码器 + LLaDA-8B 扩散语言骨干 + 4 阶段视觉指令微调），是当前最强的开源扩散 VLM；在其之上引入三个组件——区域提示（为每个区域配可学习嵌入）、RoI 对齐特征回放、以及结构化（块状）注意力掩码——使模型可在单次扩散去噪过程中同时为多个掩码区域生成描述，而不像自回归模型逐区域、逐 token 串行解码。
papers.method_overview_en: PerceptionDLM is a multimodal diffusion language model for efficient parallel region perception. It first builds PerceptionDLM-Base (SigLIP-2 vision encoder + LLaDA-8B diffusion backbone, 4-stage visual instruction tuning), the strongest open diffusion VLM. On top, region prompting (a learnable embedding per region), RoI-aligned feature replay and a structured (block-wise) attention masking mechanism let the model denoise captions for multiple masked regions simultaneously within a single diffusion process, instead of decoding each region sequentially as autoregressive (AR) models do.
papers.innovation_zh: 故事线：现有 MLLM 大多依赖自回归解码，区域级密集描述时区域越多延迟线性暴涨；扩散语言模型天生并行但直接用于细粒度感知会出现感知弱、多区域相互串扰。作者用区域提示绑定区域身份、用结构化注意力掩码限定每个区域只关注全局视觉 token、共享文本提示、自身 RoI 特征与自身描述 span，从而在保留全局上下文的同时强制区域独立，把区域感知从串行变并行。这是首个利用扩散 LM 并行性实现并行区域描述/感知的工作，创新合理、工程价值高，并贡献了同时评测质量与效率的 ParaDLC-Bench。
papers.innovation_en: Story: most MLLMs rely on AR decoding, so dense region captioning grows linearly in latency with region count; diffusion LMs are inherently parallel but, applied naively to fine-grained perception, suffer weak perception and cross-region interference. PerceptionDLM binds region identity via region prompts and restricts each region's tokens (through structured attention masking) to global visual tokens, shared text prompt, its own RoI features and its own caption span, enforcing region independence while preserving global context. It is the first to achieve parallel region captioning/perception by exploiting diffusion-LM parallelism, with a reasonable, deployable design, and contributes ParaDLC-Bench measuring both quality and efficiency.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 亮眼实验：PerceptionDLM-Base 在 16 个多模态基准中 15 个超过 LLaDA-V；ParaDLC-Bench 平均准确率 62.4%，近乎翻倍超过 LLaDA-V(35.2%)、SDAR-VL(31.3%)；TPF 达 2.9（AR/扩散基线均为 1），整 benchmark 推理时间从 GAR 的 479s 降至 276s（PixelRefer 718s）；密集区域（5 masks/图）吞吐最高 3.5×，4 masks 满并行时单图延迟从 10.04s 降到 2.92s（3.44×）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Highlights: PerceptionDLM-Base beats LLaDA-V on 15 of 16 multimodal benchmarks; on ParaDLC-Bench it reaches 62.4% average accuracy, nearly doubling LLaDA-V (35.2%) and SDAR-VL (31.3%); TPF reaches 2.9 (AR/diffusion baselines are 1), cutting total benchmark inference time from 479s (GAR) to 276s (PixelRefer 718s); dense-region throughput speeds up to 3.5x, and at 4-mask full parallelism single-image latency drops from 10.04s to 2.92s (3.44x).

papers.method_overview_zh: NNN（非负弹性网络）解码把检索从“各文档独立内积打分”重构成“联合解码”：选出一组文档，使其嵌入以稀疏、非负的线性组合（弹性网正则）联合重建查询嵌入，从而让选择具备“语料感知”，减少冗余近重复结果。它可在测试期直接作用于冻结嵌入（仅 2 个超参），也可通过展开的 FISTA 求解器端到端优化嵌入。
papers.method_overview_en: NNN (Non-Negative elastic Net) decoding reformulates retrieval from independent inner-product scoring into a joint decoding problem: it selects a set of documents whose embeddings jointly reconstruct the query embedding as a sparse, non-negative linear combination (elastic-net regularized), making selection corpus-aware and reducing redundant near-duplicates. It works on frozen embeddings at test time (only 2 hyperparameters) and can be trained end-to-end via an unrolled FISTA solver.
papers.innovation_zh: 故事线：稠密检索中每个文档分数只取决于查询与它自身的嵌入，对整个语料“盲视”，因而易选出语义相似、冗余重复的集合。NNN 把检索建成对查询嵌入的稀疏非负重建，引入文档间的相互竞争与互补，在保持相关性的同时提升多样性与完整性。作者还证明了严格分离：NNN 能处理稠密检索能处理的所有查询，外加相关语料上稠密检索无法处理的查询。创新性较强、理论扎实。
papers.innovation_en: Story: in dense retrieval each document score depends only on the query and its own embedding, blind to the rest of the corpus, so it tends to pick semantically similar, redundant sets. NNN casts retrieval as sparse non-negative reconstruction of the query embedding, introducing competition and complementarity among documents to improve diversity/completeness while preserving relevance. The authors prove a strict separation: NNN handles every query dense retrieval handles, plus correlated-corpus queries it cannot. Strong novelty with solid theory.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 亮眼实验：对冻结的内积训练嵌入直接套用 NNN，在多个基准上一致提升，完整性(completeness)指标最高 +36%，且差距随相关文档数量增加而扩大；端到端训练版本在全部基准、全部指标上均超过稠密检索。
papers.key_metrics_en: Highlights: applying NNN to frozen inner-product-trained embeddings yields consistent gains across benchmarks, up to +36% on the completeness metric, with the gap widening as the number of relevant documents grows; the end-to-end-trained version surpasses dense retrieval on all metrics and benchmarks.

papers.title: Visuals Lie, Consistency Speaks: Disentangling Spatial Attention from Reliability in Vision-Language Models

papers.rationale_zh: 创新性较好（22/30）：用跨模型族证据系统性证伪“注意力即接地/可靠性”这一主流假设（R≈0.001），并指出生成期自一致性与隐状态探针才是真正可靠性信号（R=0.429）；属于有价值的洞见型工作但非新算法。实验（9/15）：以相关性/因果分析为主，非 SOTA 准确率。实验质量（12/15）：跨模型族+因果层消融+逐层动态分析。效率（6/10）：分析型工作。泛化（5/5）：覆盖多模型族。相关性（17/25）：VLM 可靠性/幻觉检测对内容治理有用，但偏机理分析。<80，不复现。
papers.rationale_en: 创新性较好（22/30）：用跨模型族证据系统性证伪“注意力即接地/可靠性”这一主流假设（R≈0.001），并指出生成期自一致性与隐状态探针才是真正可靠性信号（R=0.429）；属于有价值的洞见型工作但非新算法。实验（9/15）：以相关性/因果分析为主，非 SOTA 准确率。实验质量（12/15）：跨模型族+因果层消融+逐层动态分析。效率（6/10）：分析型工作。泛化（5/5）：覆盖多模型族。相关性（17/25）：VLM 可靠性/幻觉检测对内容治理有用，但偏机理分析。<80，不复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: 这是一篇分析型论文（VLM 可靠性探针 VRP），挑战“注意力-置信度假设”。它提出结构化注意力指标（簇数 Ck、空间熵 Hs、跨层注意力演化 ΔHs），发现“符号脱节/早锁定”现象，并证明空间注意力与准确率近乎零相关（R≈0.001，“簇失效”）；相反，自一致性（多采样推理路径的一致率）才是真值的主导预测因子（R=0.429）。因果层消融显示 LLaVA 把预测锁死在脆弱的后期瓶颈层，而 PaliGemma/Qwen2-VL 把可靠性全局分布、即使破坏约 50% 最关键层仍极具韧性。
papers.method_overview_en: An analysis paper (VLM Reliability Probe, VRP) that challenges the Attention-Confidence Assumption. It introduces structural-attention metrics (cluster counts Ck, spatial entropy Hs, cross-layer attention evolution Delta-Hs), finds Symbolic Detachment / Early Locking, and shows spatial attention has near-zero correlation (R~0.001) with accuracy (Cluster Failure). Instead, Self-Consistency (agreement across sampled reasoning paths) is the dominant truth predictor (R=0.429). Causal layer ablation shows LLaVA locks predictions in a fragile late-stage bottleneck, while PaliGemma/Qwen2-VL distribute reliability globally and stay robust even when ~50% of the most predictive layer is destroyed.
papers.innovation_zh: 故事线：大家普遍假设“注意力越聚焦于相关区域、回答越可靠”，并据此判断幻觉。作者跨模型族系统验证后发现该假设站不住脚——空间注意力与正确率几乎无关，真正的可靠性信号来自生成动态（自一致性）与隐状态分布。这为幻觉检测/可靠性评估指明了新方向：与其看注意力图，不如看生成一致性与隐状态探针。洞见有价值，但非新算法。
papers.innovation_en: Story: the field assumes tighter attention on relevant regions implies more reliable answers, and uses it to judge hallucination. Cross-family experiments debunk this: spatial attention is essentially uncorrelated with accuracy, and the real reliability signal comes from generation dynamics (self-consistency) and hidden-state distributions. This redirects hallucination detection/reliability estimation away from attention maps toward generation consistency and hidden-state probes. Valuable insight, but not a new algorithm.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 亮眼实验：空间注意力结构指标与准确率相关性 R≈0.001（几乎无关）；自一致性与真值相关性 R=0.429（最强预测因子）；激进层消融下 Qwen2-VL/PaliGemma 即使破坏约 50%+ 最具预测力的层仍稳健，LLaVA 则迅速崩溃，揭示可靠性的架构性差异。
papers.key_metrics_en: Highlights: structural-attention metrics correlate with accuracy at R~0.001 (essentially none); self-consistency correlates with truth at R=0.429 (the strongest predictor); under aggressive layer ablation, Qwen2-VL/PaliGemma stay robust even when ~50%+ of the most predictive layer is destroyed, while LLaVA collapses quickly, revealing architectural divergence in where reliability lives.

papers.method_overview_zh: Looped World Models（LoopWM）是首个用于世界建模的“循环”架构。它不靠堆叠深层网络，而是反复施加同一个参数共享的 Transformer 块来迭代精炼潜在环境状态，并用自适应计算根据每一步预测的复杂度动态调整循环次数（有效深度）。这把“迭代潜在深度”确立为与模型规模、训练数据正交的新扩展轴。
papers.method_overview_en: Looped World Models (LoopWM) are the first looped architectures for world modelling. Instead of stacking deep layers, they iteratively refine latent environment states by repeatedly applying a single parameter-shared transformer block, with adaptive computation that scales the number of loops (effective depth) to each prediction step's complexity. This establishes iterative latent depth as a new scaling axis, orthogonal to model size and training data.
papers.innovation_zh: 故事线：世界模型面临根本矛盾——忠实的长程模拟需要深层计算，但更深的模型部署昂贵且易累积误差。LoopWM 用参数共享循环块按需扩展有效深度，在大幅压缩参数量的同时按预测难度自适应分配算力，从而缓解“深度 vs 成本/误差累积”的张力。想法新颖、是热门方向，但与电商内容治理直接关联较弱。
papers.innovation_en: Story: world models face a fundamental tension, faithful long-horizon simulation needs deep computation, but deeper models are costly to deploy and prone to compounding errors. LoopWM uses a parameter-shared looped block to expand effective depth on demand, drastically cutting parameters while adaptively allocating compute by prediction difficulty. A novel idea in a hot direction, but only weakly tied to e-commerce content governance.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 亮眼实验：相比常规方法最高 100× 参数效率；在 AlfWorld 等世界建模任务（基于连续 5 个动作预测计分）上超过 Hyperloop Transformer 等多个基线；极端类别如 Lifespan 分数从 0% 提升到 100%，展示参数共享循环块的强表达力。
papers.key_metrics_en: Highlights: up to 100x parameter efficiency over conventional approaches; on world-modelling tasks like AlfWorld (scored by predicting five consecutive actions) it beats baselines including Hyperloop Transformers; on extreme categories such as Lifespan it lifts the score from 0% to 100%, showing the expressive power of the parameter-shared looped block.

papers.rationale_en: 创新性极高（27/30）：首个端到端原生全模态主动感知 Agent，把视频理解建模为 POMDP 的 Observation-Thought-Action 循环，并提出 TAURA 解决 GRPO 多轮训练的优势同质化问题。实验指标强（14/15）：开源模型十项基准 SOTA，7B 在 LVBench 上以更少帧数反超 10× 大的 Qwen2.5-VL-72B。实验质量高（13/15）：十基准+test-time scaling 分析+消融。效率好（9/10）：推理复杂度与视频时长解耦，帧数 −73%。泛化强（5/5）。相关性（18/25）：视频/全模态内容理解与达人内容治理强相关，但非电商场景直击。原文已提供官方代码与权重，按规则无需复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: OmniAgent 把长视频/全模态理解从被动的“看完全部帧”范式，改造为主动感知的推理过程。它将探索建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），通过 Observation-Thought-Action（OTA）循环按需地浏览帧、收听音频、观看音视频片段，并把高维瞬时感知蒸馏进一段持久的文本记忆，使内部状态只取决于推理轨迹复杂度而非视频时长。训练分两阶段：先用 best-of-N 轨迹合成+双阶段质控做 Agentic SFT 引导主动感知；再用 Agentic RL 中的 TAURA（按轮自适应不确定性重标定优势）把信用分配引向关键发现轮。模型在十个基准上取得开源 SOTA，并展现“推理轮数越多、性能越好”的 test-time scaling 特性。
papers.method_overview_en: OmniAgent reframes long-video / omni-modal understanding from a passive watch-it-all paradigm into an active-perception reasoning process. It formulates exploration as a POMDP and, via an Observation-Thought-Action (OTA) cycle, on-demand browses frames, listens to audio, and watches audio-visual clips, distilling high-dimensional transient percepts into a persistent textual memory so that internal state depends only on reasoning-trace complexity rather than raw video duration. Training has two stages: Agentic SFT (best-of-N trajectory synthesis with dual-stage quality control) to bootstrap active perception, then Agentic RL with TAURA (Turn-aware Adaptive Uncertainty Rescaled Advantage) to steer credit toward pivotal discovery turns. It achieves open-source SOTA across ten benchmarks and shows positive test-time scaling.
papers.innovation_zh: 亮点在于“感知即推理、推理即行动”统一在单个原生模型内，而不是把多模态感知外包给工具模块导致梯度断裂。核心创新有二：(1) 用 POMDP+持久文本记忆把推理复杂度与视频时长解耦，从而能在小时级视频上扩展；(2) TAURA 通过轮级熵识别关键轮，修正 GRPO 把关键发现轮与琐碎动作混为一谈的“优势同质化”。相较“thinking with images”等半被动方法（仍需全局预扫或维持稠密视觉缓存），它真正实现按需取证。
papers.innovation_en: The key novelty is unifying perception, reasoning and action inside a single native model instead of outsourcing perception to external tools (which severs gradient flow). Two contributions stand out: (1) a POMDP + persistent textual memory that decouples reasoning complexity from video length, enabling hour-long scaling; (2) TAURA, which uses turn-level entropy to fix GRPO's advantage homogenization that conflates pivotal turns with trivial actions. Unlike semi-passive thinking-with-images methods that still pre-scan or keep dense visual buffers, OmniAgent truly gathers evidence on demand.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 亮眼实验：在 10 个基准上全面超过 Qwen2.5-Omni 直接基线，取得开源模型 SOTA。长视频：LVBench 50.5%、MLVU 71.1%；全模态：DailyOmni +4.7%、OmniVideo +7.8%；时序定位：LongVALE 绝对 +33.4%。效率/能力联合证据：7B Agent 在 LVBench 上 50.5% vs Qwen2.5-VL-72B 47.3%（参数小 10×、帧数少 73%）。Test-time scaling：VideoMME-Long 随推理轮数增加 +6.2%。
papers.key_metrics_en: Highlights: beats the Qwen2.5-Omni baseline on all 10 benchmarks (open-source SOTA). Long video: LVBench 50.5%, MLVU 71.1%; omni-modal: DailyOmni +4.7%, OmniVideo +7.8%; temporal grounding: LongVALE +33.4% absolute. Capability-efficiency: 7B agent reaches 50.5% on LVBench vs 47.3% for the 10x larger Qwen2.5-VL-72B with 73% fewer frames. Test-time scaling: +6.2% on VideoMME-Long as reasoning turns increase.

papers.method_overview_zh: ProductConsistency 面向电商/广告中的指令式商品图编辑：现有开源与闭源编辑器在改背景、换场景时常常扭曲商品几何、篡改 Logo、拼错或幻觉商品上的文字。作者首先用全自动管线合成带唯一品牌标识与可验证渲染文字的商品图，构建 87k 的 SFT 数据、869 张图的 RL 数据以及 174 图/870 样例的人审基准。训练上，SFT 让模型学会保身份编辑；RL 阶段提出 Cyclic Consistency 奖励——对编辑后图重新生成 caption，与原始商品描述做相似度比较，作为“商品身份是否保持”的语义代理奖励，并叠加指令遵从、视觉一致、文字保真等子奖励。在 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 与 Flux.1-Kontext-dev 上微调，商品一致性、文字渲染与整体观感均一致提升。
papers.method_overview_en: ProductConsistency targets instruction-based product image editing for e-commerce/advertising, where existing open and closed editors distort product geometry, alter logos, or misspell/hallucinate on-object text when changing scenes. The authors build a fully automated pipeline that synthesizes product images with unique branding and verifiable rendered text, yielding an 87k SFT set, an 869-image RL set, and a human-verified benchmark of 174 images / 870 samples. SFT teaches identity-preserving edits; the RL stage introduces a Cyclic Consistency reward that re-captions the edited image and compares it with the original product description as a semantic proxy for identity preservation, combined with instruction-adherence, visual-consistency and text-fidelity sub-rewards. Fine-tuning Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 and Flux.1-Kontext-dev yields consistent gains.
papers.innovation_zh: 核心创新是把“商品身份保真”这一难以直接监督的目标，转化为一个可计算、可优化的循环一致性奖励：原描述→编辑图→再 caption→与原描述比相似度，形成语义闭环，避免了像素级强约束带来的编辑僵化。配套的合成数据管线生成“带唯一品牌+可验证文字”的商品图，使大规模可控监督成为可能；并首次给出聚焦品牌/文字保真的商品编辑基准（此前基准要么忽略渲染文字、要么只看文档版式）。创新点合理且工程可落地，主要局限是奖励依赖 caption 模型与 OCR 的质量。
papers.innovation_en: The core idea turns the hard-to-supervise goal of product identity preservation into a computable, optimizable cyclic-consistency reward: description -> edited image -> re-caption -> similarity to the original description, forming a semantic loop that avoids the rigidity of pixel-level spatial constraints. A synthetic data pipeline that injects unique brands and verifiable text enables scalable, controllable supervision, and the paper provides the first benchmark focused on brand/text fidelity in product editing. The design is reasonable and deployable; its main limitation is dependence on the quality of the captioner and OCR.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 亮眼实验：在 ProductConsistency Benchmark（174 图、8 类、870 样例）上，相对基线全面提升。Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 在文字保真上字符错误率（CER）下降约 5×；分割区域内的 Seg CLIP-I、Seg DINO-I（商品身份保持）与 OCR 指标均提升；闭源 MLLM 三维裁判（商品一致性 / OCR 保真 / 美观）一致占优。两套底座（Qwen-Image-Edit-2511、Flux.1-Kontext-dev）均观察到一致收益。
papers.key_metrics_en: Highlights: on the ProductConsistency Benchmark (174 images, 8 categories, 870 samples) it improves over baselines across the board. Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 cuts the OCR character error rate (CER) by about 5x; Seg CLIP-I, Seg DINO-I (identity preservation) and OCR metrics all improve; a closed-source MLLM judge (product consistency / OCR fidelity / aesthetics) consistently favors the trained models. Gains hold for both Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 and Flux.1-Kontext-dev.

papers.title: APT: Atomic Physical Transitions for Causal Video-Language Understanding
papers.authors: ["Shang Wu", "Haoran Lu", "Songling Liu", "Chenwei Xu", "Lie Lu", "Pranav Maneriker", "Fan Du", "Manling Li", "Zhaoran Wang", "Han Liu"]

papers.rationale_zh: 创新性好（24/30）：提出 Atomic Physical Transitions（APT）——把视频从单一事件标签拆成有序、带时间戳的“机制化状态变迁链”，作为事件识别与物理仿真之间缺失的中间表示。实验（12/15）：APT recall 10%→38.1%（+28.1pp），并迁移到 PhysBench、SSv2 多选 +15pp。实验质量（13/15）：8 个零样本 VLM 评测+消融+迁移。效率（9/10）：Qwen3-VL-2B 仅 11M LoRA。泛化（5/5）。相关性（14/25）：视频-语言因果理解对内容理解有借鉴，但聚焦物理机制，与电商达人治理关联较弱。<80，不复现。
papers.rationale_en: 创新性好（24/30）：提出 Atomic Physical Transitions（APT）——把视频从单一事件标签拆成有序、带时间戳的“机制化状态变迁链”，作为事件识别与物理仿真之间缺失的中间表示。实验（12/15）：APT recall 10%→38.1%（+28.1pp），并迁移到 PhysBench、SSv2 多选 +15pp。实验质量（13/15）：8 个零样本 VLM 评测+消融+迁移。效率（9/10）：Qwen3-VL-2B 仅 11M LoRA。泛化（5/5）。相关性（14/25）：视频-语言因果理解对内容理解有借鉴，但聚焦物理机制，与电商达人治理关联较弱。<80，不复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: APT 认为物理事件不能只用名字（如“bounce”）理解，而应还原其因果状态变化。作者定义 Atomic Physical Transitions（原子物理变迁）：最小、时间局部化的状态变化，把一个可见线索绑定到一个激活的物理机制与前/后动力学状态；一段视频被表示为有序的 APT 链，回答“为什么发生”。他们用人工标注+仿真真值构建混合数据（14 类变迁、1246 个 trial、27303 个带时间实例）。发现当前 VLM 几乎抓不到变迁级物理（零样本 recall ≤14%），而直接微调又导致事件级遗忘。于是提出 APT-Tune：图像-pad 感知监督、格式条件协同训练、机制条件的域到类型解码，在 Qwen3-VL-2B 上仅用 11M LoRA 参数即可在不遗忘常规问答的前提下学会因果变迁。
papers.method_overview_en: APT argues physical events should be understood by their causal state changes, not by names like 'bounce'. It defines Atomic Physical Transitions: minimal, temporally localized state changes binding a visible cue to an active physical mechanism and before/after dynamical regimes; a video is represented as an ordered APT chain that explains why an event happened. The authors build mixed-source data from human annotation and simulator ground truth (14 transition types, 1,246 trials, 27,303 timed instances). They find current VLMs largely miss transition-level physics (zero-shot recall <=14%), while direct fine-tuning causes event-level forgetting. APT-Tune fixes this with image-pad-aware supervision, format-conditional co-training, and mechanism-conditioned domain-to-type decoding, using only 11M LoRA params on Qwen3-VL-2B.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新在于提出一种“人类对齐的因果监督信号”，把视频理解的监督单位从 clip 级标签下沉到机制化、可迁移的状态变迁链；这是事件识别与完整物理仿真之间缺失的中间表示，且因按机制（而非外观）定义，可同时用于标注、评测、仿真规格与训练。APT-Tune 用格式条件协同训练化解“学会一种答案格式而非可复用物理表征”的过拟合问题。创新合理、数据构建扎实，主要面向物理视频，泛化到更广内容理解尚需验证。
papers.innovation_en: The novelty is a human-aligned causal supervision signal that moves the supervision unit from clip-level labels to mechanism-typed, transferable transition chains, a missing intermediate representation between event recognition and full physical simulation; because it is defined by mechanism rather than appearance, one schema supports annotation, evaluation, simulation specs and training. APT-Tune's format-conditional co-training resolves overfitting to a single answer format. The design is sound with solid data construction, though it targets physical video and broader transfer needs more validation.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 亮眼实验：8 个零样本 VLM 在 14 类设置下 recall 仅 10–14%，错误主要来自漏检变迁，说明 clip 级能力≠变迁级物理理解。APT-Tune 在 Qwen3-VL-2B（11M LoRA）上把 APT recall 从 10.0% 提到 38.1%（+28.1pp），无需在 PhysBench 上训练即可迁移，且把 Something-Something v2 多选准确率较底座 +15pp。
papers.key_metrics_en: Highlights: eight zero-shot VLMs achieve only 10-14% recall in the 14-type setting, dominated by missed transitions, showing clip-level competence != transition-level physics. APT-Tune on Qwen3-VL-2B (11M LoRA) raises APT recall from 10.0% to 38.1% (+28.1pp), transfers to PhysBench without training on it, and improves Something-Something v2 multiple-choice accuracy by +15pp over the base model.

papers.title: SAMA: Semantic Anchor-aligned Augmentation for Unified Low-Resource Multimodal Information Extraction

papers.rationale_en: 创新性好（24/30）：统一框架同时服务 MNER/MRE/MEE，用从标签构造的“语义锚点”对齐跨模态，配 CME-MLLM（通用 Adapter+任务 Adapter）与锚点保持扩散，再用双约束过滤免人工核验。实验（12/15）：在多个骨干上一致超过 mixGen/GMDA/CAMIM 等增强基线，低资源更明显。实验质量（13/15）：三任务+全/低资源+消融。效率（5/10）：MLLM+扩散，生成开销大。泛化（5/5）：跨三任务统一。相关性（18/25）：多模态内容理解、数据增强与大规模打标，与内容生态数据质量相关，但偏社媒 IE 而非电商直击。<80，不复现，原文亦已开源。
papers.method_overview_zh: SAMA 针对多模态信息抽取（MNER 命名实体识别、MRE 关系抽取、MEE 事件抽取）在低资源下数据稀缺、跨模态对齐粗糙、且各任务架构割裂的问题，提出统一的数据增强框架。它从真值标签构造结构化“语义锚点”，用一个协作多专家多模态大模型 CME-MLLM（共享语义的通用 Adapter + 各任务专属 Adapter）生成多样但符合约束的文本样本；图像侧用“锚点保持扩散”——以锚点加权提示与隐变量条件，在多样化视觉背景的同时保住关键语义锚点。最后用“双约束过滤”按跨模态一致性与锚点保真自动筛选合成样本，免去人工核验。
papers.method_overview_en: SAMA is a unified data-augmentation framework for multimodal information extraction (MNER, MRE, MEE) under low-resource settings, addressing data scarcity, coarse cross-modal alignment, and fragmented per-task designs. It builds structured semantic anchors from ground-truth labels and uses a Collaborative Multi-Experts MLLM (CME-MLLM: a Universal Adapter for shared semantics plus Task-Specific Adapters) to generate diverse yet constraint-compliant text; for images it uses Anchor-Preserving Diffusion with anchor-weighted prompts and latent conditioning to diversify visual context while retaining critical anchors. A Dual-Constraint Filtering module then auto-selects synthetic samples by cross-modal consistency and anchor fidelity, removing manual verification.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新在于用“语义锚点”作为跨模态对齐与多任务共享的统一中介：既约束文本生成不偏离标签语义，又约束图像生成不丢关键对象，从而修复传统按模态独立增强导致的跨模态语义鸿沟。多专家共享语义的设计让 MNER/MRE/MEE 互相受益，打破任务专用架构的壁垒；双约束过滤把“生成-筛选”闭环自动化，降低对人工的依赖。整体是合理且可复用的数据增强范式，代价是依赖 MLLM 与扩散的生成成本。
papers.innovation_en: The novelty is using semantic anchors as a unified medium for both cross-modal alignment and multi-task sharing: they constrain text generation to stay faithful to label semantics and constrain image generation to keep key objects, repairing the cross-modal gap caused by per-modality augmentation. The multi-expert shared-semantics design lets MNER/MRE/MEE benefit each other, breaking task-specific silos, while dual-constraint filtering automates the generate-then-select loop. It is a reasonable, reusable augmentation paradigm, at the cost of MLLM + diffusion generation overhead.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 亮眼实验：在 MNER/MRE/MEE 多个基准、多种骨干（MMT5、PGIM、HVPNeT、TMR 等）上叠加 SAMA 后 F1 一致提升，且优于 mixGen、GMDA、CAMIM 等增强基线。例如 HVPNeT 骨干上 SAMA 将 F1 提升到 78.2/81.9/80.9/83.4（各列对应不同设置），普遍较次优基线 +1~3 F1；低资源设置下增益更明显，验证了合成数据质量与泛化性。
papers.key_metrics_en: Highlights: across MNER/MRE/MEE benchmarks and multiple backbones (MMT5, PGIM, HVPNeT, TMR, ...), adding SAMA consistently raises F1 and beats augmentation baselines (mixGen, GMDA, CAMIM). For example, on the HVPNeT backbone SAMA reaches F1 of 78.2/81.9/80.9/83.4 across settings, typically +1-3 F1 over the second-best baseline, with larger gains in low-resource regimes.

papers.method_overview_zh: DSG（Decoupled Search Grounding）针对生产级 LLM Agent 的实时搜索接地问题：原生搜索把检索策略、提供商选择、证据注入、成本、时延与生成行为都捆在模型厂商边界后面，难以审查、调参、复用与迁移，还会引发“搜索诱导的啰嗦”破坏严格输出契约。作者提出一个厂商无关、兼容 MCP 的网关，把接地移出推理模型之外，将提供商路由、来源感知上下文渲染、可配置回退、检索深度控制与精确+语义缓存暴露为一等公民控制。这样推理模型可随意替换，而检索成为可优化的接口边界。
papers.method_overview_en: DSG (Decoupled Search Grounding) tackles real-time search grounding for production LLM agents: native search bundles retrieval policy, provider choice, evidence injection, cost, latency and generation behavior behind a model-provider boundary, making grounding hard to inspect, tune, reuse or port, and can trigger Search-Induced Verbosity that breaks strict output contracts. The authors propose a vendor-agnostic, MCP-compatible gateway that moves grounding outside the reasoning model and exposes provider routing, source-aware context rendering, configured fallback, retrieval-depth control, and exact + semantic caching as first-class controls, keeping the reasoning model interchangeable while retrieval becomes an optimizable interface boundary.
papers.innovation_zh: 创新主要是系统抽象与工程权衡，而非新算法：把“搜索接地”从模型的固定特性重新定义为可控接口边界，是其核心贡献。它识别并缓解了 native search 的“搜索诱导啰嗦”这一提示遵从风险，并通过缓存网关在准确率几乎不降的前提下大幅压成本与时延。局限是算法新颖性有限、收益依赖具体提供商与负载，更多是面向落地的最佳实践。
papers.innovation_en: The contribution is mainly a systems abstraction and engineering trade-off rather than a new algorithm: redefining search grounding from a fixed model feature into a controllable interface boundary is the core idea. It identifies and mitigates Search-Induced Verbosity (a prompt-compliance risk of native search) and, via a caching gateway, cuts cost and latency dramatically at near-parity accuracy. Limitations are limited algorithmic novelty and provider/workload-dependent gains; it is best read as deployment best practice.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 亮眼实验：跨 5 个前沿模型（GPT-4o/4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro、Claude Sonnet 4）与 SimpleQA/FreshQA/HotpotQA。SimpleQA 上 DSG 86.1% 接近原生 87.7%，但搜索成本降 91%；暖缓存命中 99.4%、时延降 68%；在电商 Query 意图理解（QIU）生产负载上准确率追平或略超原生搜索，同时搜索成本下降 98% 以上。FreshQA 这类时效敏感任务原生搜索仍占优。
papers.key_metrics_en: Highlights: across 5 frontier models (GPT-4o/4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro, Claude Sonnet 4) and SimpleQA/FreshQA/HotpotQA. On SimpleQA, DSG reaches 86.1% vs native 87.7% at 91% lower search cost; 99.4% warm-cache hit rate, 68% lower latency; on a production e-commerce Query Intent Understanding (QIU) workload it matches or slightly exceeds native search while cutting search cost by over 98%. Native search still leads on recency-sensitive FreshQA.

papers.rationale_zh: 以基准/评测为主、无新方法（创新 12/30、实验 7/15）：构建 GPT-Image-2 生成的“文本密集型”图像多域基准（8602 图、6 类：商业海报/信息图/学术海报/收据/表格/UI 截图），零样本评测 5 个检测器+1 个 VLM。实验质量（11/15）：含分类目与后处理鲁棒性分析。相关性（17/25）：AI 生成内容检测、内容真实性与治理相关，但偏文档型图像、非达人内容直击。价值在于揭示检测器域依赖与对 JPEG 压缩的脆弱性。<80，不复现。
papers.rationale_en: 以基准/评测为主、无新方法（创新 12/30、实验 7/15）：构建 GPT-Image-2 生成的“文本密集型”图像多域基准（8602 图、6 类：商业海报/信息图/学术海报/收据/表格/UI 截图），零样本评测 5 个检测器+1 个 VLM。实验质量（11/15）：含分类目与后处理鲁棒性分析。相关性（17/25）：AI 生成内容检测、内容真实性与治理相关，但偏文档型图像、非达人内容直击。价值在于揭示检测器域依赖与对 JPEG 压缩的脆弱性。<80，不复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: 随着 GPT-Image-2 等多模态生成模型能稳定渲染连贯文字与结构化版式，检测“文本密集型”AI 生成图像（海报、信息图、收据、表格、UI 截图等，常含隐私/交易/决策信息）成为内容真实性与数字信任的新挑战。作者构建一个多域基准：8602 张 GPT-Image-2 生成图，覆盖商业海报、信息图、学术海报、收据、表格、UI 截图 6 类，并提出基于“文本-版式规整度×功能语境”的二维刻画与隐私保护的提示合成管线（不使用原始文字或身份）。基于该基准，零样本评测 5 个代表性 AI 生成图检测器与 1 个多模态 VLM，做整体、分类目与后处理鲁棒性分析。
papers.method_overview_en: As multimodal generators like GPT-Image-2 reliably render coherent text and structured layouts, detecting AI-generated text-rich images (posters, infographics, receipts, tables, UI screenshots, often carrying privacy/transactional/decision-relevant info) becomes a key challenge for content authenticity and digital trust. The authors build a multi-domain benchmark of 8,602 GPT-Image-2 images across six categories (commercial posters, infographics, academic posters, receipts, tables, UI screenshots), with a two-dimensional formulation (text-layout regularity x functional context) and a privacy-preserving prompt-synthesis pipeline (no original text or identities). They then evaluate five representative AI-image detectors and one multimodal VLM zero-shot, with overall, per-category and post-processing robustness analyses.
papers.innovation_zh: 本文不提新检测方法，价值在于补齐“文本密集型 + 现代生成模型”这一被忽视的评测空白，并给出二维问题刻画与隐私保护合成管线。核心发现是：检测器性能高度依赖类目（在某些类好、换类目就失效），且即便最强的传统检测器对 JPEG 压缩也极其敏感；VLM 能提升整体检测但在结构化文本图上仍不可靠。提示了需要“文本/版式感知”的检测方法。作为资源型工作合理，但方法创新与 SOTA 推进有限。
papers.innovation_en: The paper proposes no new detector; its value is filling the overlooked evaluation gap of text-rich images from modern generators, plus a two-dimensional problem formulation and a privacy-preserving synthesis pipeline. Key findings: detector performance is highly category-dependent (good on some, failing on others), even the strongest conventional detector is very sensitive to JPEG compression, and a VLM improves overall detection but remains unreliable on structured text-rich images, motivating text-/layout-aware detection. A reasonable resource paper, but limited methodological novelty.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 亮眼实验：基准含 8602 图、6 类。零样本评测显示检测性能强烈依赖域——某类表现好的方法在另一类常失败；即便最强传统检测器在 JPEG 压缩下也出现严重性能下降（鲁棒性脆弱）。探索性引入多模态 VLM 后整体检测有提升，但在收据/表格/UI 等结构化文本图上仍不可靠，凸显对文本-版式感知检测的需求。
papers.key_metrics_en: Highlights: the benchmark has 8,602 images across 6 categories. Zero-shot evaluation shows performance is strongly domain-dependent (a method strong on one category often fails on another); even the strongest conventional detector degrades severely under JPEG compression. Adding a multimodal VLM improves overall detection but remains unreliable on structured text-rich images (receipts/tables/UI), highlighting the need for text- and layout-aware detection.

papers.title: OneRank: Unified Transformer-Native Ranking Architecture for Multi-Task Recommendation
papers.authors: ["Jiakai Tang", "Sunhao Dai", "Kun Wang", "Zhiluohan Guo", "Yu Zhao", "Cong Fu", "Kangle Wu", "Yabo Ni", "Anxiang Zeng", "Xu Chen", "Jun Xu"]
papers.affiliations: ["Renmin University of China", "Shopee Pte. Ltd.", "Nanyang Technological University"]

papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 27, "results": 12, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 3, "relevance": 16, "total": 80, "rationale_zh": "强电商工业排序场景（Shopee 主排序），范式创新扎实（Transformer-native 多任务、任务私有通道、梯度脱钩、匹配式打分），且有真实线上 A/B 收益与高效率证据。扣分主要在：仅单一专有数据集、未开源、与‘内容理解/创作者治理’仅间接相关。达到复现阈值且无代码，故进行复现。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 强电商工业排序场景（Shopee 主排序），范式创新扎实（Transformer-native 多任务、任务私有通道、梯度脱钩、匹配式打分），且有真实线上 A/B 收益与高效率证据。扣分主要在：仅单一专有数据集、未开源、与‘内容理解/创作者治理’仅间接相关。达到复现阈值且无代码，故进行复现。
papers.rationale_en: 强电商工业排序场景（Shopee 主排序），范式创新扎实（Transformer-native 多任务、任务私有通道、梯度脱钩、匹配式打分），且有真实线上 A/B 收益与高效率证据。扣分主要在：仅单一专有数据集、未开源、与‘内容理解/创作者治理’仅间接相关。达到复现阈值且无代码，故进行复现。
papers.method_overview_zh: OneRank 是一个 Transformer-native 多任务排序框架，取消传统‘编码器 F → 预测器 G’的分离，把多任务推理内置进 Transformer 栈内。前向自底向上构建任务私有通道：输入级注入相互不可见的任务 token 实现早期专精，中间级用情境描述符（Situational Descriptor）做候选感知的上下文聚合，预测级用可配置掩码的跨任务关系注意力做受控知识迁移。反向用‘梯度脱钩’只允许对角线梯度回传，使跨任务注意力成为只读记忆，避免负迁移。最后用基于内积匹配的动态打分替换静态 MLP 打分头。
papers.method_overview_en: OneRank is a Transformer-native multi-task ranking framework that removes the encoder–predictor split by internalizing multi-task reasoning inside the Transformer stack. The forward pass builds task-private channels bottom-up: mutually-invisible task tokens for early specialization, situational-descriptor-based candidate-aware contextualization, and configurable cross-task relational attention. The backward pass uses strategic gradient detachment (diagonal-only gradients), turning cross-task attention into read-only memory to avoid negative transfer. Static MLP scorers are replaced by dynamic inner-product matching scoring.
papers.story_zh: 现有 Transformer 排序仍沿用‘编码器-预测器’分离，导致任务无关的信息瓶颈、梯度冲突（跷跷板效应）、以及注意力到静态 MLP 的范式断裂 → OneRank 用任务专属 token + 候选感知上下文化 + 跨任务受控注意力 + 梯度脱钩 + 动态匹配打分，把多任务推理内化进 Transformer 统一解决。
papers.innovation_zh: 1）识别并形式化 Transformer-MTL 编码器-预测器分离的三大缺陷；2）自底向上的任务感知计算范式（相互不可见任务 token、候选感知上下文化、可配置跨任务掩码）；3）策略性梯度脱钩，前向共享、后向隔离；4）用 Transformer-native 内积匹配打分替换静态 MLP 头，实现上下文/任务自适应排序。创新合理、工程可落地。
papers.innovation_en: A unified Transformer-native MTL ranker that internalizes multi-task reasoning via mutually-invisible task tokens, candidate-aware contextualization, gradient-detached cross-task attention, and matching-based dynamic scoring—eliminating the encoder–predictor split.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 离线（Shopee，33M 用户 / 118M 商品 / 26.6B 曝光）：OneRank C-AUC=0.7910、A-AUC=0.8463、O-AUC=0.9024（参数仅 4.9M，FLOPs 1.0G），相对最强基线 OneTrans/PLE 的 C-AUC +0.0137、A-AUC +0.0092、O-AUC +0.0028。线上 A/B（主排序，7 天，各 10% 流量）：GMV/UU +1.01%、Paid GMV/UU +1.17%、AR/UU +0.81%，Bad Query Rate −2.29%。
papers.key_metrics_en: Offline (Shopee, 33M users / 118M items / 26.6B impressions): C-AUC=0.7910, A-AUC=0.8463, O-AUC=0.9024 with only 4.9M params / 1.0G FLOPs; +0.0137/+0.0092/+0.0028 AUC over the strongest OneTrans/PLE baselines. Online A/B (main ranking, 7 days, 10% traffic each): GMV/UU +1.01%, Paid GMV/UU +1.17%, AR/UU +0.81%, Bad Query Rate −2.29%.

papers.title: Harmonizing Semantic and Collaborative in LLMs: Reasoning-based Embedding Generator for Sequential Recommendation
papers.authors: ["Qidong Liu", "Mingyao Huang", "Moranxin Wang", "Wenxuan Yang", "Haiping Zhu"]
papers.tags: ["推荐系统", "序列推荐", "LLM", "表征学习", "强化学习"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 25, "results": 13, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 5, "relevance": 12, "total": 77, "rationale_zh": "把 LLM 改造为序列推荐物品向量生成器，潜在推理 + 共现奖励 RL 组合新颖，长尾收益突出、离线预计算零在线开销、跨 backbone/LLM 泛化稳定；但模块多为已有技术拼装，与‘创作者治理’需二次迁移。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 把 LLM 改造为序列推荐物品向量生成器，潜在推理 + 共现奖励 RL 组合新颖，长尾收益突出、离线预计算零在线开销、跨 backbone/LLM 泛化稳定；但模块多为已有技术拼装，与‘创作者治理’需二次迁移。
papers.rationale_en: 把 LLM 改造为序列推荐物品向量生成器，潜在推理 + 共现奖励 RL 组合新颖，长尾收益突出、离线预计算零在线开销、跨 backbone/LLM 泛化稳定；但模块多为已有技术拼装，与‘创作者治理’需二次迁移。
papers.method_overview_zh: ReaEmb 是把（冻结的）LLM 改造为序列推荐物品向量生成器的两阶段框架。第一阶段 LRCL 通过‘两次前向 + 轻量注意力模块’产生潜在推理 token，挖掘 LLM 内在推理能力增强物品语义，并配合属性级对比学习。第二阶段 CRRL 用 GRPO 式强化学习、以物品共现为奖励（并提出批级相对优势 BRPO），显式拉近高共现物品的嵌入距离以注入协同信号。训练后离线预计算物品向量，用于初始化下游 SRS backbone，推理时无需在线 LLM 计算。
papers.method_overview_en: ReaEmb turns a frozen LLM into an item-embedding generator for SRS in two stages. Stage 1 (LRCL) uses a two-forward-pass process with a lightweight attention module to create latent reasoning tokens that enrich item semantics, trained via attribute-level contrastive learning. Stage 2 (CRRL) applies GRPO-style RL with a co-occurrence-based reward (and batch-relative advantage, BRPO) to explicitly pull frequently co-occurring items closer. Item embeddings are precomputed offline to initialize the SRS backbone, adding no online inference cost.
papers.story_zh: 现有 LLM 嵌入方法语义理解不足（仅单次前向当文本编码器）、且协同信号注入隐式低效 → 设计 LRCL 两次前向 + 注意力潜在推理模块补语义，再用 CRRL 共现奖励强化学习显式注入协同信号。
papers.innovation_zh: 1）两阶段 LLM 嵌入生成框架 ReaEmb，统一‘语义+协同’；2）LRCL 用 k 个推理占位符 + 额外注意力层做隐式潜在推理（两次前向），突破‘语言链’限制；3）CRRL 设计基于物品共现的奖励显式注入协同信号；4）在连续推理向量上加高斯扰动模拟采样，并用批级相对优势 BRPO 稳定训练。
papers.innovation_en: A two-stage LLM-embedding framework harmonizing semantics and collaboration: latent reasoning via reasoning placeholders + an extra attention layer (two-pass), a co-occurrence reward to explicitly inject collaborative signals, and Gaussian perturbation + batch-relative policy optimization (BRPO) for stable RL.
papers.key_metrics_zh: Yelp + SASRec：Overall H@10=0.7862 / N@10=0.5036（最佳基线 TSLRec 0.7608/0.4969，H@10 约 +3.3%）；Tail H@10=0.6504（vs 次优 0.6157，+5.6%）。Yelp + GRU4Rec：Overall H@10=0.7566 相对最佳基线 LLM2Vec 0.6155 提升约 +22.9%，Tail H@10 0.5663 vs 0.3877（约 +46%），长尾增益显著。
papers.key_metrics_en: Yelp + SASRec: Overall H@10=0.7862 / N@10=0.5036 (best baseline TSLRec 0.7608/0.4969, ~+3.3% H@10); Tail H@10=0.6504 (+5.6%). Yelp + GRU4Rec: Overall H@10=0.7566 vs best baseline LLM2Vec 0.6155 (~+22.9%); Tail H@10 0.5663 vs 0.3877 (~+46%).

papers.title: One Sequential Recommendation Model Pretrained from Synthetic Priors Predicts Multiple Datasets
papers.authors: ["Woosung Kang", "Jiwon Jeong", "Jonghyeok Shin", "Jeongwhan Choi", "Noseong Park"]
papers.tags: ["推荐系统", "序列推荐", "PFN", "零样本", "效率"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 27, "results": 12, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 10, "generalization": 5, "relevance": 9, "total": 76, "rationale_zh": "首次将 PFN/后验预测范式引入序列推荐，合成先验预训练一次即可 update-free 单次前向适配新域，效率（1 分钟 vs 15 小时）与未见类目零样本泛化极突出；但纯 ID-交互序列，无内容理解/创作者治理元素，主题契合度有限。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 首次将 PFN/后验预测范式引入序列推荐，合成先验预训练一次即可 update-free 单次前向适配新域，效率（1 分钟 vs 15 小时）与未见类目零样本泛化极突出；但纯 ID-交互序列，无内容理解/创作者治理元素，主题契合度有限。
papers.rationale_en: 首次将 PFN/后验预测范式引入序列推荐，合成先验预训练一次即可 update-free 单次前向适配新域，效率（1 分钟 vs 15 小时）与未见类目零样本泛化极突出；但纯 ID-交互序列，无内容理解/创作者治理元素，主题契合度有限。
papers.method_overview_zh: SRPFN 把序列推荐重构为‘条件推断 / 后验预测分布（PPD）’问题，采用 Prior-data Fitted Network（PFN）。模型在 2560 万条合成序列上离线预训练一次，合成数据来自分层度修正随机块模型（hDCSBM）生成的物品图 + 随机游走，覆盖多样的物品转移模式。推理时无需任何梯度更新，仅以目标域的‘item-item 转移样本’作为 support set，通过交叉注意力在单次前向中给出 next-item 分布。输入用 PPMI + 截断随机 SVD 得到低秩协同/转移嵌入，编码器保留源/目的方向性并用门控残差更新。
papers.method_overview_en: SRPFN reformulates sequential recommendation as conditional posterior-predictive inference via a Prior-data Fitted Network. It is pretrained once offline on 25.6M synthetic sequences generated by random walks over hDCSBM item graphs spanning diverse transition regimes. At inference it performs update-free prediction: conditioning on a support set of target-domain item-item transitions through cross-attention in a single forward pass. Inputs are low-rank PPMI+SVD collaborative/transition embeddings; the encoder preserves source/destination asymmetry with a gated residual update.
papers.story_zh: 现有序列推荐需对每个数据集从头训练、难以跨域泛化（参数被固化到特定 item catalog 与转移分布）→ 用合成先验预训练一个 PFN，把转移统计作为 support set 输入，单次前向、无需重训即可适配新域。
papers.innovation_zh: 1）首次将 PFN / 后验预测范式引入序列推荐，实现 update-free 单次前向推理；2）基于 hDCSBM 的合成先验（分层社区 + 幂律热度 + 核心-边缘），随机游走生成多样转移模式；3）support-set 交叉注意力把多条转移样本上下文化聚合；4）PPMI + 截断 SVD 低秩表示 + 源/目的方向性编码 + 门控残差更新。
papers.innovation_en: First PFN-style, posterior-predictive, update-free inference for sequential recommendation, with an hDCSBM-based synthetic prior, support-set cross-attention, and directional low-rank PPMI+SVD inputs with a gated encoder.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 主结果（Table 1）相对次优方法平均提升 7.53%：Beauty HR@10=0.5394（FEARec 0.4879）、NDCG@10=0.3770；Yelp HR@10=0.7924。未见类目零样本（Table 2，HR@1）：Arts 0.3038 vs UniSRec 0.1141 / RecFormer 0.0688（较最强统计基线 ItemKNN 0.1722 约 +76%）。效率：每数据集约 1 分钟（预处理 14s + 推理 45s）vs SASRec ~10min、FEARec ~15h。
papers.key_metrics_en: Avg +7.53% over the runner-up (Table 1): Beauty HR@10=0.5394 (FEARec 0.4879), NDCG@10=0.3770; Yelp HR@10=0.7924. Unseen-category zero-shot (Table 2, HR@1): Arts 0.3038 vs UniSRec 0.1141 / RecFormer 0.0688. Efficiency: ~1 min/dataset (14s preprocess + 45s inference) vs SASRec ~10 min and FEARec ~15h.

papers.rationale_zh: 首次系统量化 LLM 生成式推荐的‘一跳记忆’现象，并提出即插即用的多任务训练 IIRG（协同邻居 + 语义邻居生成）补足非记忆受益用户；洞察清晰、实验扎实（17 基线 + SID/TID），但效率证据缺失、与创作者治理直接相关性弱。
papers.rationale_en: 首次系统量化 LLM 生成式推荐的‘一跳记忆’现象，并提出即插即用的多任务训练 IIRG（协同邻居 + 语义邻居生成）补足非记忆受益用户；洞察清晰、实验扎实（17 基线 + SID/TID），但效率证据缺失、与创作者治理直接相关性弱。
papers.method_overview_zh: 该工作首次系统研究 LLM 在生成式推荐（GR）中的‘一跳记忆（one-hop memorization）’现象：模型记住训练序列中相邻物品的转移关系，推理时直接推荐输入物品的‘已记忆后继’。作者发现 LLM 比非 LLM 模型（TIGER）更依赖一跳记忆，且其相对增益主要集中在‘目标物品被一跳转移覆盖’的用户上。为此提出 IIRG（Item–Item Relation Generation），在 next-item 预测之外联合训练两个辅助生成任务：协同邻居生成（多跳共现）与语义邻居生成（文本相似），让 LLM 学到超越一跳转移的更丰富物品关系。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper studies one-hop memorization in LLM-based generative recommendation, where the model memorizes consecutive item transitions and recommends memorized successors. LLMs rely on this more than non-LLM TIGER, and their gains concentrate on users whose targets are covered by such transitions. They propose IIRG, which jointly trains the LLM on next-item prediction plus collaborative-neighbor generation (multi-hop co-occurrence) and semantic-neighbor generation (text similarity), teaching richer item-item relations beyond one-hop transitions.
papers.story_zh: 现有 LLM-GR 仅用 next-item 预测训练，过度依赖一跳记忆、对目标不在记忆转移内的用户帮助有限 → 设计 IIRG，通过‘协同邻居生成 + 语义邻居生成’两个辅助任务，教模型学习多跳协同与语义物品关系，补足非记忆受益用户的推荐信号。
papers.innovation_zh: 1）首次提出并量化 LLM-GR 中的‘一跳记忆’行为，并证明其无法用模型规模或过拟合解释；2）揭示 LLM 相对 TIGER 的增益主要来自记忆受益用户；3）提出 identifier 无关、即插即用的多任务训练 IIRG（协同邻居 + 语义邻居生成），且邻居信号与一跳转移重叠低、信息互补。
papers.innovation_en: First to quantify one-hop memorization in LLM-GR (not explained by scale or overfitting) and to propose an identifier-agnostic, plug-and-play multi-task training (IIRG) that supervises multi-hop collaborative and semantic item-item relations.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 主表（Qwen-3.5-4B 骨干，TID，full-item ranking）：Sports R@5 IIRG=0.0406 vs Naive 0.0337（+20.5%）；Toys R@5=0.0780 vs 0.0634（+23%）；Beauty R@5=0.0726 vs 0.0606（+19.8%）。相对仅 next-item 的 Naive 平均 +21% Recall@5，且在全部 3 数据集 ×4 指标上优于全部 17 基线。分组增益：非记忆受益用户 +40% vs 记忆受益用户 +16%。
papers.key_metrics_en: Qwen-3.5-4B/TID full-item ranking: Sports R@5 0.0406 vs Naive 0.0337 (+20.5%); Toys 0.0780 vs 0.0634 (+23%); Beauty 0.0726 vs 0.0606 (+19.8%); ~+21% avg Recall@5 over Naive and best across 3 datasets x 4 metrics vs 17 baselines. Group split: +40% (non-memorization users) vs +16% (memorization users).

papers.title: Unified Multimodal Autoregressive Modeling with Shared Context-Visual Tokenizer is Key to Unification
papers.authors: ["Wujian Peng", "Lingchen Meng", "Yuxuan Cai", "Xianwei Zhuang", "Yuhuan Yang", "Rongyao Fang", "Chenfei Wu", "Junyang Lin", "Zuxuan Wu", "Shuai Bai"]
papers.affiliations: ["Fudan University", "Shanghai Innovation Institute", "Qwen Team, Alibaba Inc."]
papers.tags: ["多模态", "统一模型", "图像生成", "Tokenizer", "自回归"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 27, "results": 12, "exp_quality": 13, "efficiency": 9, "generalization": 4, "relevance": 9, "total": 74, "rationale_zh": "高热度统一多模态工作（复旦 + Qwen Team）：单一离散 tokenizer + 二值量化 + 并行 bitwise 自回归，生成/编辑/文本渲染多项超 GPT-4o 且高效；但与电商内容生态/创作者治理仅弱相关。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 高热度统一多模态工作（复旦 + Qwen Team）：单一离散 tokenizer + 二值量化 + 并行 bitwise 自回归，生成/编辑/文本渲染多项超 GPT-4o 且高效；但与电商内容生态/创作者治理仅弱相关。
papers.rationale_en: 高热度统一多模态工作（复旦 + Qwen Team）：单一离散 tokenizer + 二值量化 + 并行 bitwise 自回归，生成/编辑/文本渲染多项超 GPT-4o 且高效；但与电商内容生态/创作者治理仅弱相关。
papers.method_overview_zh: UniAR 用单一离散视觉 tokenizer 作为理解与生成的桥梁，在共享上下文中让模型直接解读自己生成的视觉 token，无需重新编码。tokenizer 基于预训练视觉编码器，融合多层特征（保留浅层细节 + 深层语义），并用 lookup-free 的二值球面量化（BSQ，64 位 → 2^64 码本）替代显式码本。自回归主干用 next-token prediction 联合建模理解/生成/编辑，并用 parallel-bitwise-prediction 对 2×2 空间网格的多层视觉码并行预测，实现 32× 压缩。最后用 DiT 视觉解码器（仅依赖视觉 token、不接收文本）解码高保真图像。训练分预训练→SFT→RL 三阶段，tokenizer 与解码器全程冻结。
papers.method_overview_en: UniAR uses a single discrete visual tokenizer as the bridge between understanding and generation, enabling a shared context where the model interprets its own generated tokens without re-encoding. It adapts a pretrained vision encoder with multi-level feature fusion and lookup-free Binary Spherical Quantization (64-bit, 2^64 codes). A unified AR backbone (next-token prediction) jointly models understanding/generation/editing with parallel-bitwise-prediction over 2x2 grids (32x compression), and a text-free DiT decoder with resolution upsampling reconstructs images.
papers.story_zh: 现有统一多模态模型依赖两个独立视觉 tokenizer，理解与生成处于不同表征空间、生成图像须重新编码才能被理解，破坏‘共享上下文’ → UniAR 用‘多层特征融合 + lookup-free 二值量化的单一 tokenizer + 并行 bitwise 自回归 + 无文本 DiT 解码器’实现真正统一。
papers.innovation_zh: 1）单一离散视觉 tokenizer：多层特征融合兼顾生成与理解，lookup-free 二值量化极低成本扩大词表；2）parallel-bitwise-prediction 自回归范式，32× 压缩、推理步数大减（相对 X-Omni 提速约 4 倍）；3）配 resolution-upsampling 的 DiT 解码器，1024² 图像仅需预测 256 token；4）随机 bitwise index flipping 稳定高温采样，利于 RL；5）涌现的交错‘生成-理解’能力。
papers.innovation_en: A single discrete tokenizer with multi-level fusion + lookup-free BSQ, a parallel-bitwise-prediction AR paradigm (32x compression, ~4x faster), a text-free DiT decoder with upsampling, and random index flipping for stable high-temperature sampling/RL.
papers.key_metrics_zh: GenEval Overall 0.85（UniAR† 0.86，>GPT-4o 0.84、>FLUX.1-dev 0.82）；文本渲染 OneIG-EN 0.873（>GPT-4o 0.857）、LongText-EN 0.917；图像编辑 ImgEdit Overall 3.73（>FLUX.1 Kontext 3.71）；理解 OCRBench 833、DocVQA 91.4。效率：生成 1024² 图仅 256 token、13.0s（vs Janus-Pro 101.9s、X-Omni 119.7s）。
papers.key_metrics_en: GenEval Overall 0.85 (UniAR† 0.86, > GPT-4o 0.84); text rendering OneIG-EN 0.873 (> GPT-4o 0.857), LongText-EN 0.917; ImgEdit Overall 3.73 (> FLUX.1 Kontext 3.71); OCRBench 833, DocVQA 91.4. Efficiency: 256 tokens / 13.0s for a 1024^2 image (vs Janus-Pro 101.9s, X-Omni 119.7s).

papers.title: Do Generative Recommenders Deepen the Information Cocoon? A Closed-Loop Simulation with LLM-powered User Simulators
papers.authors: ["Jiyuan Yang", "Gengxin Sun", "Mengqi Zhang", "Lingjie Wang", "Yuanzi Li", "Hongxi Cui", "Xin Xin", "Pengjie Ren"]
papers.tags: ["推荐系统", "生成式推荐", "信息茧房", "治理", "LLM仿真"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 25, "results": 9, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 6, "generalization": 2, "relevance": 19, "total": 73, "rationale_zh": "选题与电商内容多样性治理高度契合（曝光多样性、长尾/头部集中、创作者公平），首次用 LLM-agent 闭环仿真系统比较生成式 vs 传统推荐的信息茧房，并原创 code 空间结构茧房指标；但属诊断/分析型、缺准确率 SOTA 与真实用户校准，泛化范围有限。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 选题与电商内容多样性治理高度契合（曝光多样性、长尾/头部集中、创作者公平），首次用 LLM-agent 闭环仿真系统比较生成式 vs 传统推荐的信息茧房，并原创 code 空间结构茧房指标；但属诊断/分析型、缺准确率 SOTA 与真实用户校准，泛化范围有限。
papers.rationale_en: 选题与电商内容多样性治理高度契合（曝光多样性、长尾/头部集中、创作者公平），首次用 LLM-agent 闭环仿真系统比较生成式 vs 传统推荐的信息茧房，并原创 code 空间结构茧房指标；但属诊断/分析型、缺准确率 SOTA 与真实用户校准，泛化范围有限。
papers.method_overview_zh: 作者构建 RecLoop——一个由 LLM 用户智能体（Qwen3-8B）驱动的大规模闭环仿真框架，让推荐器经历‘曝光→用户选择→数据更新→周期重训’共 15 个循环（Office 5K agents、Toys 20K agents）。每个 agent 含动态画像、长短期双记忆、周期反思与动作模块，既保留历史偏好又随交互演化。除曝光层指标（类目熵、Jaccard、覆盖率、Gini），还原创提出 Code-Space Structural Cocoon（分层 code 熵 + Top-κ 集中度），刻画生成式推荐内部 code 空间的收窄。
papers.method_overview_en: RecLoop is a large-scale closed-loop simulator where LLM-powered user agents (Qwen3-8B) interact with recommenders over 15 retraining cycles on two Amazon datasets (5K / 20K agents). Each agent has a dynamic profile, dual (short/long-term) memory, periodic reflection, and an action module. Beyond standard exposure-level cocoon metrics, it introduces a model-level Code-Space Structural Cocoon metric (layer-wise code entropy + Top-k concentration).
papers.story_zh: 现有信息茧房研究只针对传统 ID 序列推荐、且依赖静态离线评估，无法刻画生成式推荐在长期反馈循环中的茧房演化 → 设计 LLM-agent 闭环仿真 RecLoop + 新增 code 空间结构茧房指标来填补该空白。
papers.innovation_zh: 1）首个面向生成式推荐信息茧房的 LLM-agent 闭环仿真框架（含周期重训）；2）原创‘Code-Space Structural Cocoon’模型级指标，从学习到的离散 code 层级衡量收窄；3）系统性结论：生成式更抗曝光层茧房；茧房集中在粗粒度 code 层；CID 比 SID 更易加剧；更大模型更抗茧房。
papers.innovation_en: The first closed-loop LLM-agent simulation for information cocoons in generative recommendation, plus a novel layer-wise code-space cocoon metric and systematic findings (generative is more cocoon-resistant at exposure level; cocoons concentrate at coarse code layers; collaborative-ID tokenization is worse; larger models help).
papers.key_metrics_zh: Inter-user Jaccard@Cycle15（Office）：SASRec 0.223 > Mamba4Rec 0.138 > TIGER 0.108 > OneRec 0.064（生成式同质化最低，OneRec 比 SASRec 低约 71%）。分层 code 熵下降（TIGER, Office）：Layer0 53.6% / Layer1 40.4% / Layer2 仅 13.4%（茧房集中在粗层）。模型规模（Toys, Cycle15）：3B 最细层活跃 code 233/256 vs 0.5B 仅 70。
papers.key_metrics_en: Inter-user Jaccard@Cycle15 (Office): SASRec 0.223 > Mamba4Rec 0.138 > TIGER 0.108 > OneRec 0.064 (~71% lower than SASRec). Layer-wise code-entropy drop (TIGER, Office): Layer0 53.6% / Layer1 40.4% / Layer2 13.4%. Model scale (Toys, Cycle15): 3B keeps 233/256 active codes at the finest layer vs 70 for 0.5B.

papers.title: MODE-RAG: Manifold Outlier Diagnosis and Energy-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation Evaluation
papers.authors: ["Zehang Wei", "Jiaxin Dai", "Jiamin Yan", "Xiang Xiang"]
papers.tags: ["多模态RAG", "幻觉治理", "多智能体", "内容质量"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 24, "results": 10, "exp_quality": 11, "efficiency": 7, "generalization": 2, "relevance": 16, "total": 70, "rationale_zh": "机制驱动的动态门控（变分自由能 + 注意力）+ 多智能体治理思路，对多模态内容质量/幻觉治理有借鉴价值；但实证覆盖窄（单一 7B kernel / 自建基准）、SOTA 优势不稳、无开源与电商落地验证。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 机制驱动的动态门控（变分自由能 + 注意力）+ 多智能体治理思路，对多模态内容质量/幻觉治理有借鉴价值；但实证覆盖窄（单一 7B kernel / 自建基准）、SOTA 优势不稳、无开源与电商落地验证。
papers.rationale_en: 机制驱动的动态门控（变分自由能 + 注意力）+ 多智能体治理思路，对多模态内容质量/幻觉治理有借鉴价值；但实证覆盖窄（单一 7B kernel / 自建基准）、SOTA 优势不稳、无开源与电商落地验证。
papers.method_overview_zh: MODE-RAG 是一个由变分自由能（VFE）和内部注意力状态驱动的多智能体框架，用于量化并动态缓解多模态 RAG 的幻觉。核心 FE-Router 作为‘热力学门控’，先评估查询的认知不确定性：低风险查询绕过流程避免过度纠正，高风险（F̄>γ）则触发五智能体解耦流水线（Per/Cor/Ret/Rea/Gen-Agent）。Rea-Agent 用 MCTS 构建因果有向无环图，Gen-Agent 用 logit 扰动抑制谄媚，由 PORAG 驱动的 Overseer 做三重一致性核查并触发递归回退。
papers.method_overview_en: MODE-RAG is a VFE- and attention-driven multi-agent framework that quantifies and dynamically gates interventions to mitigate multimodal RAG hallucinations. A central FE-Router (thermodynamic gate) routes low-risk queries to bypass intervention and high-risk queries into a decoupled five-agent pipeline; Rea-Agent runs MCTS to build causal DAGs, Gen-Agent applies logit perturbation against sycophancy, and a PORAG Overseer performs triple-consistency checks with a recursive fallback.
papers.story_zh: 现有多模态 RAG 受跨模态幻觉/谄媚困扰，且缓解策略陷入‘干预悖论’（静态规则过度纠正 vs 放任级联编造）→ 设计 VFE/注意力驱动的 FE-Router 做动态门控，并用五智能体（含 MCTS 因果推理、logit 扰动、Overseer 回退）按需精准干预。
papers.innovation_zh: 1）FE-Router：基于变分自由能 + 注意力的自适应门控，化解干预悖论；2）五智能体解耦流水线，分阶段处理多类幻觉/RAG 触发；3）将 MCTS 引入因果 DAG 推理 + logit 扰动抑制谄媚 + Overseer 双奖励校验与递归回退；4）构建 ModeVent 基准（VFE 极值 500 离群 + 500 稳定）。
papers.innovation_en: A VFE+attention adaptive FE-Router resolving the intervention paradox, a decoupled five-agent pipeline, MCTS causal DAGs + logit perturbation + a dual-reward Overseer, and the new ModeVent benchmark.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 全局 Average Total：Baseline 4.40 → MODE-RAG 5.45（+1.04，ΔFidelity +0.89）；Outliers 平均 4.50 → 5.98（+1.48）；Majority Text Bias（Outliers）5.04 → 7.36（+2.31）。五方法对比 Overall Total：MODE-RAG 5.45 > Self-RAG 5.21 > Woodpecker 4.93 > Baseline 4.40。效率约 1.42×、26.2s/query（4×RTX 4090，Qwen-2.5-VL-7B）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Global Average Total: 4.40 -> 5.45 (+1.04, dFidelity +0.89); Outliers 4.50 -> 5.98 (+1.48); Majority Text Bias (Outliers) 5.04 -> 7.36 (+2.31). Overall Total: MODE-RAG 5.45 > Self-RAG 5.21 > Woodpecker 4.93 > Baseline 4.40. ~1.42x cost, 26.2s/query (4xRTX 4090, Qwen-2.5-VL-7B).

papers.title: Leveraging Code-Mixed Product Metadata and User Feedback for Personalized Recommendation on Daraz Bangladesh
papers.authors: ["KM Fahim A Bari", "Muhammad Abdullah Adnan", "Nafis Sadeq"]
papers.affiliations: ["East West University", "Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology"]
papers.tags: ["电商", "推荐", "混合语", "内容理解", "低资源"]
papers.score_breakdown: {"innovation": 12, "results": 6, "exp_quality": 12, "efficiency": 6, "generalization": 3, "relevance": 8, "total": 47, "rationale_zh": "首个孟加拉电商（Daraz/BanglishRev）可复现 Top-N 推荐基准，实证量化了混合语（Banglish）词表碎片化对推荐的损害；方法论严谨但无算法创新、绝对指标低、与‘创作者治理’几乎无关。"}
papers.rationale_zh: 首个孟加拉电商（Daraz/BanglishRev）可复现 Top-N 推荐基准，实证量化了混合语（Banglish）词表碎片化对推荐的损害；方法论严谨但无算法创新、绝对指标低、与‘创作者治理’几乎无关。
papers.rationale_en: 首个孟加拉电商（Daraz/BanglishRev）可复现 Top-N 推荐基准，实证量化了混合语（Banglish）词表碎片化对推荐的损害；方法论严谨但无算法创新、绝对指标低、与‘创作者治理’几乎无关。
papers.method_overview_zh: 本文是首个面向孟加拉 Daraz 电商评论数据（BanglishRev，含孟加拉语 Unicode、英语及拉丁字母转写的 Banglish 混合语）的 Top-N 推荐基准。作者在‘按用户时间排序、留最后一个交互’协议下评测六类模型（GlobalPop、CatPop、UserCF、ItemCF、ExplicitMF-SVD、ImplicitMF-ALS、CBF）。针对极端长尾稀疏做了五档 k-core 阈值消融，并用字符 1–2gram TF-IDF 的内容过滤做按主导书写体系（孟加拉语/英语/Banglish/空）分层评测，量化混合语对推荐质量的影响。属基准/实证类工作，无新模型。
papers.method_overview_en: This is the first reproducible Top-N recommendation benchmark on Bangladeshi Daraz e-commerce reviews (BanglishRev, mixing Bengali Unicode, English, and Latin-script Banglish). Six model families are evaluated under a per-user chronological leave-last-out protocol; a five-level k-core threshold ablation probes extreme sparsity, and a language-stratified content-based filtering study (character 1-2 gram TF-IDF) quantifies how code-mixing degrades recommendation. No new model is proposed.
papers.story_zh: 代码混合（Banglish）电商评论对推荐的影响此前完全未被研究、且无现成基准 → 作者构建首个可复现 Top-N 基准 + k-core 稀疏消融 + 按语言分层的内容过滤评测来系统刻画这一影响。
papers.innovation_zh: 1）首个孟加拉电商（Daraz/BanglishRev）可复现 Top-N 推荐基准，评测六类模型；2）首次实证测量 Banglish 词表碎片化对推荐质量的损害；3）五档 k-core 密度消融，揭示不同算法对稀疏度的差异化敏感性，对稀疏场景模型选型有指导意义。
papers.innovation_en: The first reproducible Bangla e-commerce recommendation benchmark, the first empirical quantification of Banglish vocabulary fragmentation harming recommendation, and a five-level k-core density ablation revealing algorithm-specific sparsity sensitivity.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 数据集 BanglishRev：324 万评分 / 934,949 用户 / 128,494 商品，密度 0.0022%，59.3% 用户仅 1 次交互。主基准(10,3)：ItemCF 最优 NDCG@10=0.0270、Hit@10=0.0525；CBF 仅 0.0077。分层 CBF：Banglish 用户 NDCG@10=0.0050，相对孟加拉语用户下降 46.8%（英语 −34.0%）。k-core 消融：ImplicitMF 最受损（Δ−0.0138），ItemCF 最稳健（Δ−0.0047）。
papers.key_metrics_en: BanglishRev: 3.24M ratings / 934,949 users / 128,494 items, density 0.0022%, 59.3% single-interaction users. papers.rationale_zh: 强电商检索相关，且把‘运营可编辑/新词小时级注入’作为结构性目标，给出离线检索指标与线上 A/B 的闭环证据。缺点是生成式召回推理开销偏重、系统实现更偏工业工程。
papers.rationale_en: 强电商检索相关，且把‘运营可编辑/新词小时级注入’作为结构性目标，给出离线检索指标与线上 A/B 的闭环证据。缺点是生成式召回推理开销偏重、系统实现更偏工业工程。
papers.method_overview_zh: OneRetrieval 用一个生成式检索模型统一电商多路召回（稀疏/稠密/协同等），但将‘上线后仍可小时级运营干预/新词注入’作为一等约束。核心是 Keyword-Aligned Encoding（KAE）：把 identifier 的各位置绑定到可解释属性词，并在 codebook 预留 reserved slots；推理期提供干预 bypass，命中新词时强制改写对应槽位 token，实现无需 retrain 的可控路由。训练上用多阶段 SFT 兼顾深召回质量与可编辑性，并在真实流量中逐步替换召回分支验证可落地收益。
papers.method_overview_en: OneRetrieval unifies multi-branch e-commerce retrieval with a single generative retriever while preserving hour-level operational editability (e.g., emerging keywords). It introduces Keyword-Aligned Encoding (KAE) with reserved slots and an inference-time bypass so new terms can be routed without retraining, plus a multi-stage SFT pipeline to retain deep-retrieval quality.
papers.story_zh: 多分支召回中，倒排可运营但语义弱、深召回质量高却难以快速注入新词。本文将可编辑性显式化：KAE 让 token 语义可控 → reserved slot 把新词绑定变成可执行接口 → 训练把深召回做上来，从而让单模型能从替换倒排开始逐步覆盖更多分支。
papers.innovation_zh: 1）把运营可编辑性作为 generative retrieval 的核心约束，而不是依赖模型泛化；2）KAE 将 identifier 槽位与可解释属性词对齐，使新词路由可控；3）reserved slots + 推理期 bypass 支持小时级干预；4）离线 + 线上 A/B 双证据展示可落地路径。
papers.innovation_en: Editability-first generative retrieval: KAE aligns identifier slots with interpretable attribute words, and reserved-slot binding makes keyword interventions an explicit, controllable interface.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 离线（Order/Click, HR@350）：Order HR@350=0.5482、Click HR@350=0.6055（接近强基线）；可编辑性（IAR@350）：Total IAR@350=0.553。线上 A/B：仅替换倒排分支时 Order +0.710%（显著）、Buyer +0.450%、CTR +0.074%；进一步替换几乎全部召回分支时 CTR +0.821%（显著）。
papers.key_metrics_en: Offline: Order HR@350=0.5482, Click HR@350=0.6055; editability Total IAR@350=0.553. Online A/B: replacing the lexical branch yields Order +0.710% (sig.), Buyer +0.450%, CTR +0.074%; replacing almost all recall branches yields CTR +0.821% (sig.).

papers.method_overview_en: Shopping Reasoning Bench is an expert-authored benchmark for multi-turn conversational shopping assistants. It decomposes shopping reasoning into a taxonomy with binary, auditable rubrics, and uses a validated LLM-as-judge to score rubric-level pass/fail with importance weighting.

papers.innovation_en: Auditable, expert-written rubrics + validated LLM judging turn open-ended shopping dialogues into reproducible, diagnostic evaluation signals.

papers.method_overview_en: CFALR targets personalized outfit recommendation by reframing it into generation-friendly tasks (P-FITB and outfit generation). It injects CF embeddings and multimodal features as projected non-text tokens into the LLM, and fuses CF signals with LLM logits at the output to stabilize combinatorial search.
papers.story_zh: 传统 CF 难以应对组合爆炸与语义理解，纯 LLM 又缺交互信号。本文通过‘把 CF 特征 token 化注入 LLM + 输出侧融合’补齐协同信号，使生成式穿搭既懂语义又个性化。
papers.innovation_zh: 1）将穿搭推荐统一成 P-FITB + 生成式组合；2）用投影把 CF/视觉等非文本特征对齐到 LLM 输入空间；3）提出 CF-augmented generation 的输出融合，让协同信号直接影响生成概率。
papers.innovation_en: Tokenizing CF interaction signals and aligning them to the LLM space enables controllable, personalized combinatorial generation beyond pure semantic prompting.

papers.rationale_en: 多模态可解释与可控性很强（推理期通过 gaze heads 重定向描述区域），对多模态内容理解/治理有启发，但与电商业务为弱相关。
papers.method_overview_zh: 论文发现 VLM 语言骨干里存在少量 attention heads（gaze heads）专门追踪当前描述的图像区域。通过相关性打分可定位这些 heads；更关键的是，推理时将 gaze heads 的注意力重定向到指定区域，就能强制模型转而描述该区域，实现无需重训的区域级可控生成。
papers.method_overview_en: The paper identifies a small set of attention heads (gaze heads) in VLMs that track the visual region being described. By redirecting the attention of these heads at inference time, the model can be forced to describe a chosen region without retraining.
papers.story_zh: VLM ‘在看哪里’不透明，难以治理和控制。本文找到具备因果控制力的 gaze heads，并用 attention redirect 在推理期直接操控描述焦点。
papers.innovation_zh: 1）从机制层面定位功能性 head 集合；2）证明其因果性与可控性（重定向注意力即可改变输出）；3）跨数据与跨模型规模复现。
papers.innovation_en: A causal, inference-time control lever: manipulating a small subset of attention heads yields region-level controllability in VLM descriptions.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 对 top-100 gaze heads（<9% heads）做一次 attention-mask 干预，可将描述重定向到指定漫画分镜，准确率 83.1%；该机制在 COCO 自然图像上也有效。
papers.key_metrics_en: Redirecting the top-100 gaze heads (<9% of heads) achieves 83.1% accuracy in steering descriptions to specified comic panels; the effect also transfers to COCO images.

papers.rationale_zh: 与推荐治理（概念遗忘/隐私/合规）强相关，提出 token reassignment 避免 SID 共享导致的忘记-保留冲突；但摘要未给出可引用的明确数值，是否开源代码需回原文进一步确认。
papers.rationale_en: 与推荐治理（概念遗忘/隐私/合规）强相关，提出 token reassignment 避免 SID 共享导致的忘记-保留冲突；但摘要未给出可引用的明确数值，是否开源代码需回原文进一步确认。
papers.method_overview_zh: TRACER 面向生成式推荐中的概念遗忘（unlearning）：语义 ID（SID）是抽象 token，常被 forget 与 retain item 共享，直接抑制 token 会造成严重副作用。TRACER 的核心是 token reassignment：将与目标概念相关的 item 重新分配到更适合遗忘的新 token 上，并加入 coherence regularizer 维持 retain item 的语义一致性，从而在移除概念的同时尽量保留推荐效用。
papers.method_overview_en: TRACER studies concept unlearning for generative recommendation where semantic IDs (SIDs) are abstract tokens shared across forget/retain items. Instead of suppressing shared SIDs directly, TRACER reassigns concept-related items to alternative tokens and adds a coherence regularizer to preserve semantic consistency among retained items.
papers.story_zh: 生成式推荐里 token 共享导致‘忘记概念’与‘保留效用’发生硬冲突。TRACER 通过把概念相关 item 迁移到替代 token，避免在共享 token 上做硬抑制，从结构上缓解冲突。
papers.innovation_zh: 1）针对 SID 抽象性与共享性提出端到端 token reassignment；2）coherence regularizer 保护 retain 语义结构；3）将 unlearning 适配到生成式推荐的特殊 token 语义。
papers.innovation_en: Token reassignment resolves SID-sharing conflicts in unlearning, enabling concept erasure with less collateral damage to retained recommendation utility.
papers.key_metrics_zh: 摘要仅说明在真实推荐数据集上能更好移除概念且更好保留效用，未给出明确数值（需回论文实验表核对）。
papers.key_metrics_en: The abstract reports better concept removal with improved utility preservation than baselines, but does not provide exact numbers (needs table verification).
